introVariants.en: Industrial equipment harnesses connect control cabinets, sensors, actuators, motors, I/O modules and field devices inside a machine or production line. The harness is defined by the equipment layout and electrical drawing rather than by a universal model.
introVariants.zh: 工业设备线束用于连接控制柜、传感器、执行器、电机、I/O模块和现场设备。它不是通用固定型号，而是依据设备布局、电气图和安装路径定义。

introVariants.en: Power, control and sensitive signal circuits may require different routing, conductor, shielding and identification strategies. Branch position, service loop, bend allowance and strain relief affect whether the harness can be installed and maintained correctly.
introVariants.zh: 动力、控制与敏感信号回路可能需要不同的布线、导体、屏蔽和标识方案。分支位置、检修余量、弯曲空间和应力消除会直接影响安装与维护。

text.en: PLC cabinets, distributed I/O, conveyors, actuators, safety switches and assembly cells.
text.zh: PLC控制柜、分布式I/O、输送线、执行器、安全开关与装配单元。

text.en: Spindle auxiliaries, sensors, lubrication, cooling, doors and internal control connections.
text.zh: 主轴附件、传感器、润滑、冷却、安全门和机内控制连接。

text.en: Motors, photoelectric sensors, heaters, valves, weighing modules and replaceable machine sections.
text.zh: 电机、光电传感器、加热元件、阀组、称重模块与可更换机组。

text.en: Conveyors, sorters, lifts, mobile modules, proximity detection and field communication.
text.zh: 输送机、分拣机、升降模组、移动单元、接近检测与现场通信。

text.en: Low-voltage controls, pumps, fans, sensors and auxiliary systems in storage, treatment and monitoring equipment.
text.zh: 储能、处理与监测设备中的低压控制、泵、风机、传感器和辅助系统。

text.en: Instrument panels, acquisition modules, test fixtures, internal interconnects and replaceable interface leads.
text.zh: 仪表面板、采集模块、测试工装、机内互连和可更换接口线。

title.en: Build from drawing or pin table

text.en: We review circuit mapping, branch datum, connector direction, labels and installation constraints before a first article is released.
text.zh: 在首件制作前审核回路对应、分支基准、接口方向、标识和安装限制。

text.en: A reference harness can be measured and mapped, but electrical function, mating interfaces and any hidden components still require customer confirmation.
text.zh: 可对参考线束进行尺寸与回路整理，但电气功能、对插接口及隐藏元件仍需客户确认。

text.en: When the original part is difficult to source, alternatives are compared by fit, terminal system, electrical rating, sealing and documented approval, not by appearance alone.
text.zh: 原物料供应困难时，从装配、端子系统、电气额定、密封和书面批准等方面比较替代方案，不只比外观。

label.zh: 设备模块与接口分配
label.en: Equipment modules and interface allocation

value.zh: 按控制柜、传感器、驱动与辅助模块分配接入点。
value.en: Allocate connection points among cabinets, sensors, drives and auxiliary modules.

label.zh: 各支路起止点、尺寸基准及公差
label.en: Branch endpoints, length datums and tolerances

value.zh: 从设备固定点量取主干与分支，并记录公差。
value.en: Measure trunk and branches from equipment fixing datums and record tolerances.

label.zh: 电源与控制回路负载表
label.en: Power and control circuit load table

value.zh: 分别列出动力、控制和敏感信号的电路负载。
value.en: List power, control and sensitive-signal loads separately.

label.zh: 线束固定点、管槽与防磨布置
label.en: Fixing points, ducts and abrasion protection

value.zh: 结合线槽、穿线孔与维护路径选配固定和防护。
value.en: Choose fixing and protection around ducts, openings and service routes.

label.zh: 电路与版本依据
label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Confirm the equipment layout, connector or terminal-block models, pin or terminal numbers, voltage and current, cable path, ambient temperature, oil or abrasion exposure and maintenance method.
value.zh: 需要确认设备布局、连接器或端子排型号、针脚或端子编号、电压电流、布线路径、环境温度、油污与磨损情况以及维护方式。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: Engineering first reviews the drawing, BOM and routing constraints, then confirms materials and builds a sample. Branch dimensions, labels, connector orientation and continuity are checked against the approved sample before repeat production.
value.zh: 先审核图纸、BOM和布线限制，再确认物料并制作样品；经确认的分支尺寸、标签、接口方向和导通关系将作为后续重复生产的依据。

question.en: Does industrial equipment harness mean one standard product?
question.zh: 工业设备线束是一个固定产品吗？

answer.en: No. It is a family covering cabinet, motor, sensor, I/O, sealed, internal and moving harnesses. The actual assembly is defined by your electrical and mechanical data.
answer.zh: 不是。它覆盖控制柜、电机、传感器、I/O、密封、机内及运动线束等多种结构，最终产品依据项目的电气与机械资料定义。

question.en: What can I send if I do not have a complete drawing?
question.zh: 没有完整图纸时可以提供什么？

answer.en: A sample, connector photos, mating-part references, pin table, equipment layout and required lengths can start the review. Unknown electrical functions must still be confirmed before production.
answer.zh: 可先提供样品、接口照片、对插型号、针脚表、设备布局和长度要求；不确定的电气功能仍需在生产前确认。

question.en: Can you make prototypes and small batches?
question.zh: 可以做样品和小批量吗？

answer.en: Yes. Prototype and small-batch builds can be used to check fit, routing and electrical mapping before a controlled repeat order.
answer.zh: 可以。可先通过样品或小批量确认装配、布线和电气对应，再转入受控的重复生产。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 分支在设备上有独立安装基准
avoidMisidentification.en: Use identifiable installation datums for every branch

avoidMisidentification.zh: 电源与敏感信号的间距及屏蔽路径需确认
avoidMisidentification.en: Confirm separation and shielding for power and sensitive signals

avoidMisidentification.zh: 样品安装不挤压端子或阻碍维修拆卸
avoidMisidentification.en: Check that installation does not load terminals or block service removal

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。
contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: Control panel harnesses organize the connections between switches, indicator lamps, relays, PLC or HMI modules, terminal blocks and external equipment. They are designed around the panel layout and service method.
introVariants.zh: 控制面板线束用于组织开关、指示灯、继电器、PLC或HMI模块、端子排与外部设备之间的连接，结构围绕面板布局和检修方式设计。

introVariants.en: Panel depth, component spacing, door movement and terminal access determine branch length and exit direction. Clear wire numbers, terminal labels and defined connector keying reduce assembly and maintenance errors.
introVariants.zh: 面板深度、器件间距、柜门运动和端子操作空间决定分支长度与出线方向。清晰的线号、端子标识和防错接口有助于减少装配与检修错误。

text.en: PLC cabinets, assembly cells, conveyors, robot peripherals, safety circuits and distributed I/O panels.
text.zh: PLC控制柜、装配单元、输送线、机器人外围、安全回路与分布式I/O面板。

text.en: Operator stations, heater controls, drives, sensors, valves and replaceable process modules.
text.zh: 操作站、加热控制、驱动器、传感器、阀组和可更换工艺模组。

text.en: Control panels for fans, pumps, dampers, thermostats, sensors and building automation interfaces.
text.zh: 用于风机、泵、风阀、温控器、传感器和楼宇自动化接口的控制面板。

text.en: Fixture panels, production cells, inspection stations, material handling and line-side service interfaces.
text.zh: 工装面板、生产单元、检测工位、物料搬运及线边检修接口。

text.en: Low-voltage monitoring, auxiliary power, pump control, distribution and equipment-room panels.
text.zh: 低压监测、辅助供电、泵控制、配电和设备间控制面板。

text.en: Instrument racks, acquisition panels, test fixtures, safety interlocks and replaceable test interfaces.
text.zh: 仪器机架、采集面板、测试工装、安全联锁和可更换测试接口。

title.en: Build from panel drawing and connection table
title.zh: 依据面板图与接线表制作

text.en: We review component positions, terminal references, branch datum, door movement, wire numbering and connector orientation before releasing the first assembly.
text.zh: 首件制作前审核器件位置、端子编号、分支基准、柜门运动、线号规则和接口方向。

title.en: Develop from an existing panel or sample
title.zh: 依据现有面板或样品开发

text.en: An existing harness or cabinet can provide routing and interface references, while electrical function and any hidden jumpers still require confirmation.
text.zh: 现有线束或控制柜可用于整理布线路径与接口资料，但电气功能及隐藏跳接仍需确认。

text.en: Defined labels, color coding, keyed connectors and branch grouping reduce terminal mistakes during panel assembly and later service work.
text.zh: 通过明确标签、颜色规则、防错接口和分支归组，减少面板装配及后续检修中的接线错误。

label.zh: 面板开孔、元件位置与端子图
label.en: Panel cutouts, device positions and terminal diagram

value.zh: 元件位置、门板运动与开孔共同决定支路布置。
value.en: Device positions, door movement and cutouts define branch routing.

label.zh: 按钮、继电器和指示灯触点定义
label.en: Switch, relay and indicator contact functions

value.zh: 按开关触点、线圈和灯具公共端分别接线。
value.en: Define switch contacts, coils and lamp common terminals separately.

label.zh: 各回路保险丝与导线保护关系
label.en: Circuit fuse selection and conductor protection

value.zh: 将保险、导体与实际负载作为一个回路审核。
value.en: Review fusing, conductors and the actual load as one circuit.

label.zh: 端子排编号、线号和线槽尺寸
label.en: Terminal-block numbering, wire IDs and duct dimensions

value.zh: 线号与端子排编号对应，并预留线槽和拆装空间。
value.en: Map wire IDs to terminal numbers and allow duct and service space.

label.zh: 电路与版本依据
label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Provide the panel drawing, component model list, terminal schedule, door or hinge movement, wire-number rules and connection table.
value.zh: 建议提供面板图、器件型号清单、端子表、柜门或铰链运动范围、线号规则和接线表，并确认线束是散装交付、面板预装还是连同指定附件交付。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: After a layout and terminal review, a first assembly is checked on the actual panel or an agreed fixture. Terminal positions, labels, branch lengths and continuity are recorded before batch assembly.
value.zh: 完成布局与端子审核后，首件可在实际面板或约定工装上核对；端子位置、标签、分支长度和导通结果确认后再进行批量装配。

question.en: Is a control panel harness one standard product?
question.zh: 控制面板线束是固定标准产品吗？

answer.en: No. It is a category covering door looms, controller interconnects, terminal wiring, panel-to-machine interfaces, pre-installed sets and service branches. The finished assembly follows the actual panel data.
answer.zh: 不是。它覆盖柜门线束、控制器互连、端子布线、面板至设备接口、预装套件和检修分支等结构，最终成品依据实际面板资料定义。

question.en: What information should be provided first?
question.zh: 首先需要提供哪些资料？

answer.en: A panel layout, circuit or connection table, component models, terminal schedule, wire-number rule, hinge movement and delivery boundary are the most useful starting materials.
answer.zh: 面板布局、回路或接线表、器件型号、端子表、线号规则、铰链运动范围和交付边界，是最有帮助的起始资料。

question.en: Can you match an existing panel harness?
question.zh: 可以匹配现有面板线束吗？

answer.en: Yes. A sample or existing panel can be measured and mapped, but hidden jumpers, electrical function and mating references still require confirmation before production.
answer.zh: 可以。可对样品或现有面板进行测量和回路整理，但隐藏跳接、电气功能及对插资料仍需在生产前确认。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 常开常闭与灯具公共端不能按颜色推断
avoidMisidentification.en: Do not infer NO/NC contacts or lamp common terminals from color

avoidMisidentification.zh: 端子排桥接、供电和安全回路分开核对
avoidMisidentification.en: Check bridging, power distribution and safety circuits separately

avoidMisidentification.zh: 柜门活动处预留弯曲空间并固定应力
avoidMisidentification.en: Provide bend space and strain support at moving cabinet doors

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。
contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: Robotic harnesses carry power, control or sensor signals through moving axes, robot arms or end-of-arm tooling. Static cable construction is not automatically suitable for repeated bending or torsion.
introVariants.zh: 机器人线束用于在运动轴、机械臂或末端工具之间传输电源、控制或传感信号。适用于固定安装的线材，不一定适合持续弯折或扭转。

introVariants.en: Repeated bending, torsion and drag-chain travel create different mechanical loads. Bend radius, torsion angle, travel length, acceleration, clamping position and connector strain relief must be considered as one routing system.
introVariants.zh: 往复弯折、扭转和拖链运动产生的机械载荷不同。弯曲半径、扭转角度、行程、加速度、固定位置和接口应力消除需要作为一套运动系统共同评估。

text.en: Axis power, encoders, sensors, grippers, valves and safety interfaces on automated lines.
text.zh: 自动化产线中的轴动力、编码器、传感器、夹具、阀组和安全接口。

text.en: Dress packs and tool circuits exposed to repeated motion, heat, sparks and shop-floor contact.
text.zh: 承受重复运动、热量、飞溅和车间接触的随动线束与工具回路。

text.en: Compact lightweight routing for fast axes, end effectors, sensors and machine interfaces.
text.zh: 面向高速运动轴、末端执行器、传感器和设备接口的紧凑轻量化布线。

text.en: Low-voltage power, control, sensing and communication inside compact articulated systems.
text.zh: 紧凑多关节系统内部的低压电源、控制、传感与通信连接。

text.en: Carrier-guided power, signal and feedback assemblies for long repetitive travel.
text.zh: 用于长距离往复行程的拖链动力、信号与反馈组件。

text.en: Robot-to-machine interfaces for doors, grippers, presence sensing and production control.
text.zh: 用于柜门、夹具、到位检测和生产控制的机器人至机床接口。

title.en: Develop from drawings and motion data
title.zh: 依据图纸与运动资料开发

text.en: Review pin definitions, axis layout, motion path, stroke, torsion, bend radius, clamp locations, electrical load and installation sequence before sampling.
text.zh: 打样前审核针脚定义、轴布局、运动路径、行程、扭转、弯曲半径、固定位置、电气负载与安装顺序。

title.en: Match an existing robot or sample
title.zh: 匹配现有机器人或样品

text.en: A reference assembly can establish interfaces and routing, but hidden electrical functions and the real motion profile still require customer confirmation.
text.zh: 参考组件可用于确认接口与路径，但隐藏的电气功能和真实运动曲线仍需客户确认。

text.en: Tool-side, arm-side and cabinet-side segments can use agreed interface boundaries so one serviced branch does not require replacing the full dress pack.
text.zh: 工具端、臂端与柜端可设置约定接口边界，使单个检修分支无需更换整套随动线束。

label.zh: 各轴运动路径、行程与扭转角
label.en: Axis motion path, travel and torsion angle

value.zh: 按实际轴路径区分弯折、拖链和扭转工况。
value.en: Distinguish bending, carrier motion and torsion by the real axis path.

label.zh: 动态弯曲半径、速度及循环目标
label.en: Dynamic bend radius, speed and target cycles

value.zh: 半径、速度、行程与循环目标放在同一验证条件中。
value.en: Define radius, speed, travel and cycle targets within one validation profile.

label.zh: 伺服动力、编码器与通信电路配置
label.en: Servo power, encoder and communication circuits

value.zh: 动力、制动、编码器与通信按驱动定义分区。
value.en: Allocate power, brake, encoder and communication paths to the drive definition.

label.zh: 夹持位置、服务环与关节穿线空间
label.en: Clamp positions, service loops and joint routing space

value.zh: 夹持、服务环和穿线口随完整运动包络安排。
value.en: Place clamps, service loops and passages around the full motion envelope.

label.zh: 电路与版本依据
label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Do not select only by conductor count.
value.zh: 不能只按芯数选型。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: The sample stage confirms routing length, clamp points and connector orientation before motion testing by the customer or an agreed method. Production specifications are frozen only after the sample and motion conditions are accepted.
value.zh: 样品阶段先确认布线长度、固定点和接口方向，再由客户或按约定方法进行运动验证；样品与运动条件确认后，才冻结量产规格。

question.en: Is a drag-chain cable automatically suitable for a robot arm?
question.zh: 拖链电缆可以直接用于机器人手臂吗？

answer.en: Not necessarily. Linear bending and multi-axis torsion impose different loads. The actual path, bend radius, torsion and clamp layout must be reviewed.
answer.zh: 不一定。直线弯折与多轴扭转产生的载荷不同，必须审核真实路径、弯曲半径、扭转和固定布局。

question.en: What information is needed for a quotation?
question.zh: 报价需要提供哪些资料？

answer.en: Provide drawings or samples, pin definitions, circuit functions, robot or axis layout, motion path or video, stroke, bend radius, torsion, environment, quantity and testing needs.
answer.zh: 建议提供图纸或样品、针脚定义、回路功能、机器人或运动轴布局、运动路径或视频、行程、弯曲半径、扭转、环境、数量和测试需求。

question.en: Can you match an existing robotic harness?
question.zh: 可以匹配现有机器人线束吗？

answer.en: A sample can establish dimensions, interfaces and visible construction. Electrical function, hidden components and the real motion profile still require customer confirmation.
answer.zh: 样品可用于确认尺寸、接口和可见结构，但电气功能、隐藏元件与真实运动曲线仍需客户确认。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 直线拖链额定不能替代机器人扭转验证
avoidMisidentification.en: Drag-chain ratings do not establish robot torsion suitability

avoidMisidentification.zh: 动力与反馈屏蔽和接地分开确认
avoidMisidentification.en: Review power and feedback shielding and grounding separately

avoidMisidentification.zh: 寿命数据需对应实际运动路径和试验条件
avoidMisidentification.en: Life data must identify the actual motion profile and test conditions

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。
contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: Instrument and sensor harnesses connect sensing elements, transmitters, gauges, acquisition modules and controllers. They may carry low-level analog signals, digital communication, excitation power or mixed circuits.
introVariants.zh: 仪表与传感器线束连接传感元件、变送器、仪表、采集模块和控制器，可能承载低电平模拟信号、数字通信、激励电源或混合回路。

introVariants.en: Signal type determines whether twisted pairs, shielding, drain wires or controlled grounding are needed. Shield termination, reference ground and separation from noisy power circuits must follow the equipment design rather than a generic rule.
introVariants.zh: 信号类型决定是否需要双绞、屏蔽、排流线或特定接地方式。屏蔽端接、参考地以及与干扰性动力回路的间距，应依据设备设计确定，不能套用单一规则。

text.en: Bench instruments, DAQ modules, test fixtures, reference sensors and replaceable test leads.
text.zh: 台式仪表、DAQ采集模块、测试工装、参考传感器和可更换测试线。

text.en: Photoelectric, proximity, temperature, pressure, position and weighing sensors distributed across a production machine.
text.zh: 分布在生产设备中的光电、接近、温度、压力、位置和称重传感器。

title.zh: 水处理、能源与环境监测

text.en: Level, flow, pressure, conductivity and condition-monitoring instruments installed around pumps, tanks and treatment systems.
text.zh: 安装在泵、储罐与处理系统周围的液位、流量、压力、电导率及状态监测仪表。

text.en: Encoders, limit sensors, tool probes, temperature points and condition-monitoring devices inside machines.
text.zh: 机床内部的编码器、限位传感器、对刀探头、温度测点与状态监测装置。

text.en: Internal sensor interconnects, pumps, valves, detectors, acquisition boards and front-panel instruments.
text.zh: 连接内部传感器、泵、阀、检测器、采集板与前面板仪表。

text.en: Position, force, vision-trigger, safety and process sensors linked to local I/O and controllers.
text.zh: 将位置、力、视觉触发、安全与工艺传感器连接至现场I/O和控制器。

title.en: Build from sensor and instrument data
title.zh: 依据传感器与仪表资料开发

text.en: Model numbers, manuals, pin tables, signal type, supply, measurement range and connector drawings are converted into a reviewed interconnect definition.
text.zh: 把型号、手册、针脚表、信号类型、供电、测量范围和接口图转化为经过审核的互连定义。

title.en: Match an existing cable or sample

text.en: A sample can establish dimensions, visible construction and mating interfaces, while hidden circuits, compensation materials and calibration responsibility still require confirmation.
text.zh: 样品可用于确认尺寸、可见结构和对插接口，但隐藏回路、补偿材料与校准责任仍需另行确认。

title.zh: 将敏感信号与动力回路分开

text.en: Routing, spacing, pair layout, shield termination and branch points are coordinated with the machine to reduce avoidable coupling into low-level circuits.
text.zh: 结合设备协调路径、间距、线对布局、屏蔽端接和分支点，减少动力回路对低电平信号的不必要耦合。

label.zh: 传感器型号、输出方式与接口定义
label.en: Sensor model, output type and interface definition

value.zh: 按传感器型号区分模拟量、开关量或数字输出。
value.en: Distinguish analog, switching and digital outputs by sensor model.

label.zh: 供电电压、电流及极性
label.en: Supply voltage, current and polarity

value.zh: 供电、参考地和信号极性按设备图定义。
value.en: Define supply, reference ground and signal polarity from device drawings.

label.zh: 模拟量、脉冲或数字信号接线方式
label.en: Analog, pulse or digital signal wiring

value.zh: 电压、电流、脉冲与通信回路采用各自接线定义。
value.en: Use separate wiring definitions for voltage, current, pulse and communication circuits.

label.zh: 屏蔽排流线和仪表接地方式
label.en: Shield drain and instrument grounding

value.zh: 屏蔽端接与仪器参考地遵从系统接地方案。
value.en: Follow the system grounding scheme for shields and instrument references.

label.zh: 电路与版本依据
label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Provide the sensor and controller models, signal type, pin definition, supply voltage, connector orientation, required shielding and installation environment.
value.zh: 需要提供传感器与控制器型号、信号类型、针脚定义、供电电压、接口方向、屏蔽要求和安装环境；涉及校准的系统，还应明确哪些校准或功能验证由客户完成。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: Pin routing, conductor and shield construction are reviewed before sampling. Continuity, insulation where specified, shield termination and labels are checked to the approved drawing; signal performance testing is agreed separately when required.
value.zh: 打样前审核针脚路径、导体与屏蔽结构；依据确认图纸检查导通、约定的绝缘项目、屏蔽端接和标签，若需要信号性能测试则另行约定。

question.en: Is an instrument and sensor harness a fixed product model?
question.zh: 仪表与传感器线束是固定型号吗？

answer.en: No. It is a family covering many sensors, instruments, signal types, interfaces and environments. The final harness is defined by the actual measurement system.
answer.zh: 不是。它覆盖多种传感器、仪表、信号类型、接口与环境，最终结构由真实测量系统定义。

question.en: What information is needed for a quotation?
question.zh: 报价需要提供哪些资料？

answer.en: Provide sensor and instrument models, manuals or drawings, signal type, supply, pin map, connector data, route, length, environment, quantity and required inspections.
answer.zh: 建议提供传感器与仪表型号、手册或图纸、信号类型、供电、针脚表、接口资料、路径、长度、环境、数量和检验要求。

question.en: Can you copy an existing sensor cable?
question.zh: 可以按现有传感器线缆复制吗？

answer.en: A sample can define dimensions and visible construction, but signal function, hidden components, compensation material and calibration responsibility must still be confirmed.
answer.zh: 样品可用于确认尺寸和可见结构，但信号功能、隐藏元件、补偿材料与校准责任仍需确认。

zh: 水处理、能源与环境监测

avoidMisidentification.zh: PNP、NPN、电压与电流输出必须区别
avoidMisidentification.en: Distinguish PNP, NPN, voltage and current outputs

avoidMisidentification.zh: 低电平信号与动力回路隔离审核
avoidMisidentification.en: Review separation between low-level signals and power circuits

avoidMisidentification.zh: 插合面与线侧针号视图要一致
avoidMisidentification.en: Align mating-face and wire-side pin-number views

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。
contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: Appliance harnesses distribute power and control signals among switches, heaters, motors, sensors, displays and control boards inside electrical equipment. Space, heat sources and assembly sequence strongly influence the design.
introVariants.zh: 电器设备线束在开关、加热器、电机、传感器、显示器和控制板之间分配电源与控制信号。内部空间、热源位置和装配顺序会明显影响结构。

introVariants.en: Conductor size, insulation, terminals and protection are selected from the actual current, temperature, movement and applicable product requirements. Routing near sharp edges or heat sources may require clips, sleeves, grommets or additional separation.
introVariants.zh: 导体规格、绝缘、端子和防护方式需要根据实际电流、温度、运动情况及适用产品要求确定。靠近锐边或热源的布线可能需要卡扣、套管、护线圈或额外隔离。

text.en: Ovens, cookers, coffee equipment, water heaters and warming devices with heaters, thermostats, thermal protection, pumps and control boards.
text.zh: 烤箱、炊具、咖啡设备、热水设备与保温装置，内部包含加热器、温控、热保护、泵和控制板。

text.en: Washing machines, dryers, refrigerators and freezers using motors, valves, pumps, compressors, fans, sensors, door switches and displays.
text.zh: 洗衣机、干衣机、冰箱与冷柜，连接电机、阀、泵、压缩机、风机、传感器、门开关与显示器。

text.en: Air handlers, fan coils, ventilation units, dehumidifiers and climate-control equipment with blowers, dampers, sensors and control modules.
text.zh: 空气处理机、风机盘管、通风设备、除湿机与温控设备，连接风机、风阀、传感器和控制模块。

text.en: Water dispensers, beverage machines, pumps and treatment appliances with level, flow, pressure, heating and valve-control circuits.
text.zh: 饮水设备、饮料机、泵和处理电器，内部包含液位、流量、压力、加热与阀控制回路。

text.en: Vending machines, food-service equipment, commercial dryers and unattended devices requiring organized branches, replaceable modules and clear service identification.
text.zh: 自动售卖机、餐饮设备、商用干燥设备与无人值守装置，需要有序分支、可更换模块和清晰检修标识。

title.zh: 紧凑型电器与办公设备

text.en: Printers, purifiers, small fans, countertop devices and compact electronics where connector direction, bend radius and internal space are tightly constrained.
text.zh: 打印设备、净化设备、小型风机、台面电器和紧凑型电子设备，其接口方向、弯曲半径和内部空间通常受到严格限制。

title.en: Build from drawings and appliance layout
title.zh: 依据图纸与设备布局开发

text.en: Circuit diagrams, pin tables, board drawings, component specifications and installation views are converted into a reviewed harness drawing with branch datums, lengths, interfaces, labels and inspection points.
text.zh: 把电路图、针脚表、板卡图、器件规格和安装视图转化为经过审核的线束图纸，明确分支基准、长度、接口、标签与检验点。

title.en: Develop from an appliance or reference sample
title.zh: 依据设备或参考样品开发

text.en: An appliance or existing loom can establish fit, route and visible interfaces. Hidden circuits, current, temperature rating, safety parts and acceptance requirements still need customer confirmation before replication.
text.zh: 设备实物或现有线束可以帮助确认装配、路径和可见接口，但隐藏回路、电流、温度等级、安全件和验收要求仍需客户确认后才能复制。

title.en: Separate power, heat and sensitive control circuits
title.zh: 区分动力、热区与敏感控制回路

text.en: Branch layout, spacing, sleeves, routing and connector grouping are coordinated so higher-current or heated circuits do not create avoidable risk for low-level sensing and communication paths.
text.zh: 协调分支布局、间距、套管、路径和接口分组，避免较大电流或热区回路给低电平感知与通信路径带来不必要风险。

label.zh: 整机型号与元件接线图
label.en: Appliance model and component wiring diagram

value.zh: 依据整机元件位置与接线图安排各接入点。
value.en: Arrange connections from the appliance wiring diagram and device positions.

label.zh: 市电、低压和接地回路定义
label.en: Mains, low-voltage and protective-earth circuits

value.zh: 市电、低压与保护接地分别标识和审核。
value.en: Identify and review mains, low-voltage and protective-earth paths separately.

label.zh: 导线温度等级与热源距离
label.en: Wire temperature specification and heat-source clearance

value.zh: 线材、套管及热源距离结合局部温度选配。
value.en: Select wire, sleeves and heat-source clearance for local temperatures.

label.zh: 端接件、套管与机壳固定方式
label.en: Terminations, sleeves and enclosure fixing

value.zh: 端头、卡扣与机壳固定配合装配顺序。
value.en: Coordinate terminations, clips and enclosure fixing with assembly order.

label.zh: 电路与版本依据
label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Provide the appliance model or internal layout, circuit diagram, component interfaces, current and temperature information, assembly sequence and required standard or document.
value.zh: 建议提供设备型号或内部布局、电路图、器件接口、电流与温度信息、装配顺序以及适用标准或文件。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: The engineering sample confirms fit, routing, terminal retention, labels and assembly sequence. Agreed electrical checks and workmanship criteria are recorded before repeat orders.
value.zh: 工程样品用于确认装配适配、布线、端子保持、标签和安装顺序；约定的电气检查与工艺验收标准会在重复订单前记录确认。

question.en: Is an appliance harness a fixed product model?
question.zh: 电器设备线束是固定型号吗？

answer.en: No. It is a broad family covering different appliances, loads, temperature zones, connectors, branches and assembly methods. The final harness is defined by the actual appliance and approved documents.
answer.zh: 不是。它覆盖不同电器、负载、温区、接口、分支与装配方式，最终结构由真实设备和批准文件确定。

question.en: What information is needed for a quotation?
question.zh: 报价需要提供哪些资料？

answer.en: Provide the circuit diagram or pin table, appliance layout, component and mating-interface data, current and temperature information, branch dimensions, assembly restrictions, quantity and required inspections. A physical sample can supplement incomplete drawings.
answer.zh: 建议提供电路图或针脚表、设备布局、器件与对插资料、电流和温度信息、分支尺寸、装配限制、数量与检验要求。图纸不完整时可补充实物样品。

question.en: Can you reproduce an existing appliance harness from a sample?
question.zh: 可以按现有电器线束样品复制吗？

answer.en: A sample can define visible materials, dimensions and interfaces, but hidden circuits, conductor ratings, safety components and acceptance criteria still require confirmation before production.
answer.zh: 样品可以用于确认可见材料、尺寸和接口，但隐藏回路、导体额定、安全件与验收标准仍需在生产前确认。

zh: 紧凑型电器与办公设备

avoidMisidentification.zh: 接地颜色与连接点需按整机要求确认
avoidMisidentification.en: Confirm earth identification and connection points against equipment requirements

avoidMisidentification.zh: 电机启动或加热负载不能只看额定稳态电流
avoidMisidentification.en: Review starting or heating loads beyond steady current

avoidMisidentification.zh: 线材标志不能替代整机批准
avoidMisidentification.en: Wire markings do not establish finished-appliance approval

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。
contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: Jumper harnesses are short interconnects used between boards, modules, terminal points or adjacent devices. Their simple appearance can hide different pin routes, orientation and current requirements.
introVariants.zh: 跳线线束通常用于电路板、模块、端子点或相邻设备之间的短距离连接。外观虽然简单，但针脚路径、方向和电流要求可能完全不同。

introVariants.en: A jumper may be straight-through, crossed, split or combined with specified components. Connector pitch, keying, terminal plating, conductor size and pull direction affect compatibility.
introVariants.zh: 跳线可能是直通、交叉、分支，也可能按要求集成指定元件。接口间距、防错结构、端子镀层、导体规格和受力方向都会影响兼容性。

text.en: Short links between control boards, displays, motors, switches, sensors and local power points where enclosure space and assembly order are limited.
text.zh: 连接控制板、显示器、电机、开关、传感器与局部电源点，适用于壳体空间和装配顺序受限的设备。

text.en: Module jumpers, panel links and replacement adapters for sensors, relays, actuators, I/O points and machine subassemblies.
text.zh: 用于传感器、继电器、执行器、I/O点和设备子组件的模块跳线、面板连接与替换转接。

text.en: Defined patch leads and breakout jumpers for development benches, fixtures, measurement modules and engineering validation, with pin mapping that can be reproduced later.
text.zh: 为开发台、工装、测量模块与工程验证提供受控连接线和引出跳线，并保留可复现的针脚定义。

text.en: Pre-terminated jumpers between terminal blocks, breakers, relays, switches, door components and cabinet modules, prepared to the panel numbering and routing plan.
text.zh: 按照面板编号和路径计划，预制端子排、断路器、继电器、开关、柜门器件与柜内模块之间的跳线。

text.en: Low-level signal, excitation, communication and local power jumpers between instruments, acquisition boards, sensor interfaces and internal modules.
text.zh: 连接仪器、采集板、传感接口与内部模块的低电平信号、激励、通信和局部电源跳线。

text.en: Adapter and service jumpers that bridge an available replacement module to an existing machine interface while keeping the approved electrical function traceable.
text.zh: 用转接或检修跳线把可获得的替换模块接入现有设备接口，同时保持已确认电气功能可追踪。

text.en: The approved table records cavity numbers, wire colours, conductor sizes, circuit names, shields, polarity and any crossed route. The harness drawing adds length datums, connector views, labels and inspection points.
text.zh: 批准的针脚表记录孔位、线色、导体规格、回路名称、屏蔽、极性与交叉路径；线束图纸再补充长度基准、接口视图、标签和检验点。

title.zh: 依据样品开发但不猜测

text.en: A reference jumper helps confirm dimensions, connector orientation and visible materials. Hidden pin routes, ratings, plating, internal splices and acceptance requirements are verified separately before the sample is copied.
text.zh: 参考样品可以帮助确认尺寸、接口方向与可见材料，但隐藏针脚路径、额定、镀层、内部接点和验收要求，需要单独核实后再复制。

text.en: When two modules use different connector families, the jumper is designed as a controlled adapter. Pin function, signal pairing, grounding, shield continuity, voltage and current compatibility are reviewed before defining the mechanical conversion.
text.zh: 两个模块采用不同连接器系列时，跳线应作为受控转接件开发。先审核针脚功能、信号配对、接地、屏蔽连续性、电压与电流兼容，再定义机械转接。

label.zh: 两端端子系列、针位与配对关系
label.en: Terminal series, positions and end-to-end pairing

value.zh: 明确每端端子与对插关系，再定义线序。
value.en: Define terminals and mating relationships before assigning wire order.

label.zh: 跨接长度、剥皮长度与公差
label.en: Jumper length, strip length and tolerance

value.zh: 短线长度包含端接定位与剥皮基准。
value.en: Include termination and stripping datums in short-lead dimensions.

label.zh: 线径、绞合与颜色配置
label.en: Conductor size, stranding and colors

value.zh: 导体截面、绞合和颜色随电路与端子选配。
value.en: Select conductor area, stranding and colors for circuits and terminals.

label.zh: 插接、压接或焊接端接工艺
label.en: Plug, crimp or solder termination process

value.zh: 压接、焊接或插接按实际端头选择工艺。
value.en: Choose crimp, solder or plug processes for the actual ends.

label.zh: 电路与版本依据
label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Confirm both mating interfaces, pin-to-pin table, insertion direction, length reference, current or signal function and whether a sample must be matched.
value.zh: 需要确认两端对插接口、针脚对应表、插入方向、长度基准、电流或信号功能以及是否需要匹配样品，不能因为两端芯数相同就默认直通。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: A first article is built to the approved pin table and dimensional reference. Continuity, polarity where applicable, terminal retention and appearance are checked before the batch is released.
value.zh: 首件依据确认的针脚表和尺寸基准制作，并检查导通、适用时的极性、端子保持与外观，确认后再放行批量生产。

question.en: Is a jumper harness always wired straight through?
question.zh: 跳线线束一定是直通的吗？

answer.en: No. A jumper can be straight-through, crossed, reversed, split or combined with shields and specified components. The approved pin-to-pin table is the production and test reference.
answer.zh: 不一定。跳线可以直通、交叉、反向、分支，也可能包含屏蔽或指定元件。批准的针脚对应表才是生产与测试依据。

question.en: What information is needed for a quotation?
question.zh: 报价需要提供哪些资料？

answer.en: Provide both connector and mating part numbers, a pin table, circuit function, voltage and current, length datum, wire and colour requirements, environment, quantity and inspection requirements. Photos or samples can supplement missing drawings.
answer.zh: 建议提供两端连接器及对插件型号、针脚表、回路功能、电压与电流、长度基准、线材与颜色要求、环境、数量和检验要求。照片或样品可以补充不完整的图纸。

question.en: Can a jumper be developed from an existing sample?
question.zh: 可以依据现有样品开发跳线吗？

answer.en: Yes, but a sample cannot reveal every rating or hidden circuit reliably. Pin mapping, conductor specification, terminal system, plating, polarity and acceptance criteria still need confirmation before repeat production.
answer.zh: 可以，但样品不能可靠展示全部额定或隐藏回路。重复生产前仍需确认针脚、导体规格、端子系统、镀层、极性与验收标准。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 针号视角与通断矩阵逐根对应
avoidMisidentification.en: Match pin views to the continuity matrix conductor by conductor

avoidMisidentification.zh: 双线压接仅在端子与工艺允许范围内
avoidMisidentification.en: Use double-wire crimps only within terminal and process limits

avoidMisidentification.zh: 短线公差应包含端接定位基准
avoidMisidentification.en: Include termination datums in short-lead tolerances

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。
contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: Pigtail and branch harnesses divide one main connection into multiple tails or provide a service lead from an existing circuit. Branch geometry and splice construction are central to the design.
introVariants.zh: 尾线与分支线束把一个主连接分成多个尾端，或从现有回路引出维修与功能支路。分支几何尺寸和接点结构是设计核心。

introVariants.en: Branch current, conductor combination, splice location, sealing and strain relief must be reviewed together. The joint method must suit the conductor construction and project acceptance criteria.
introVariants.zh: 分支电流、导体组合、接点位置、密封和应力防护需要一起审核。接点方式必须适配导体结构和项目验收标准。

title.zh: 工业设备与分布式传感器

text.en: Multi-drop branches connect proximity switches, valves, indicator lamps and local I/O along machines and conveyor systems.
text.zh: 多路分支沿设备与输送系统连接接近开关、阀、指示灯和局部I/O。

text.en: Connector tails link motors, pumps, heaters, thermostats, switches and control boards while allowing selected components to be serviced independently.
text.zh: 连接器尾线用于电机、泵、加热器、温控、开关和控制板，使指定器件可以独立检修。

text.en: Ring-lug, ferrule and terminal pigtails organize connections among breakers, busbars, relays, switches and terminal blocks.
text.zh: 环形端子、冷压端头和端子尾线用于整理断路器、母排、继电器、开关与端子排之间的连接。

text.en: Sealed sensor tails, lighting branches and repair connectors are developed for heat, vibration, fluids and restricted service access.
text.zh: 密封传感器尾线、灯具分支和维修接口针对热、振动、液体与受限检修空间开发。

text.en: Breakout tails expose individual circuits for measurement, simulation and fixture connection while preserving an approved interface at the equipment side.
text.zh: 引出尾线把独立回路提供给测量、模拟与工装，同时在设备侧保留批准接口。

title.zh: 自动化单元与机器人末端工具

text.en: Compact branches distribute power and signals among grippers, sensors, valves and tool changers where branch geometry and repeated movement must be coordinated.
text.zh: 紧凑分支在线爪、传感器、阀和换工具系统之间分配电源与信号，需要协调分支几何与重复运动。

title.en: Develop from branch drawings and pin tables
title.zh: 依据分支图与针脚表开发

text.en: The drawing defines a main datum, every branch length, connector view, cavity routing, splice position, protection and labels. Dimensions state whether the harness is straight, naturally laid or formed.
text.zh: 图纸明确主基准、每条支路长度、接口视图、孔位路径、接点位置、防护和标签，并说明尺寸是在拉直、自然放置还是成型状态下测量。

title.en: Reverse an existing pigtail without hidden assumptions
title.zh: 依据样品开发但不保留隐藏假设

text.en: A sample establishes visible dimensions and interfaces, while circuit function, ratings, internal joints, plating and sealing are verified separately. The result becomes a controlled part rather than an undocumented copy.
text.zh: 样品用于确认可见尺寸和接口，回路功能、额定、内部接点、镀层与密封则单独核实，使结果成为受控零件，而不是无记录复制品。

title.zh: 制作便于维修的替换分支

text.en: Damaged ends can be replaced with defined overlap, staggered joints, labels and protective sleeves. The repair position, access space and joint method are planned so the repaired section can be inspected and supported.
text.zh: 损坏尾端可通过明确搭接、错位接点、标签和防护套管替换。维修位置、操作空间和接点方式需要提前规划，使修复段可以检查并获得支撑。

label.zh: 尾线接口、未端接端处理与线序
label.en: Pigtail interface, open-end preparation and wire order

value.zh: 尾线端和开放端分别定义接口与末端处理。
value.en: Define pigtail interfaces separately from open-end preparation.

label.zh: 分支位置、共同节点与电路图
label.en: Breakout positions, common nodes and circuit diagram

value.zh: 分支位置和共同节点以电路图及安装图对应。
value.en: Map breakout positions and common nodes to circuit and routing drawings.

label.zh: 接续方式、截面积组合与绝缘结构
label.en: Splice method, conductor-size combination and insulation

value.zh: 接续方法匹配导体材质、截面组合和绝缘空间。
value.en: Match splice methods to conductor materials, sizes and insulation space.

label.zh: 分支应力固定与防潮方式
label.en: Branch strain support and moisture protection

value.zh: 接头支撑与防潮配置跟随局部暴露位置。
value.en: Set splice support and moisture protection for local exposure.

label.zh: 电路与版本依据
label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Provide a branch drawing with datum points, each tail length, conductor sizes, load information, mandatory splice method, sealing requirement and connector orientation.
value.zh: 应提供带基准点的分支图、各尾端长度、导体规格、负载信息、指定的接点方式、密封要求和接口方向，并明确尺寸是在成型前还是成型后测量。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: The sample is checked on a branch board or dimensional template. Continuity, branch dimensions, splice protection, labels and mechanical checks are performed to the agreed project plan.
value.zh: 样品可在分支板或尺寸模板上核对；导通、分支尺寸、接点防护、标签以及机械项目按双方确认的项目计划执行。

question.en: What is the difference between a pigtail and a branch harness?
question.zh: 尾线和分支线束有什么区别？

answer.en: A pigtail usually has a connector or terminal system at one end and free or prepared leads at the other. A branch harness divides one or more circuits into two or more controlled tails. Some products combine both structures.
answer.zh: 尾线通常一端带连接器或端子系统，另一端为开口或已处理引线；分支线束把一个或多个回路分成两条以上受控尾端，有些产品会同时包含两种结构。

question.en: What information is needed for a quotation?
question.zh: 报价需要提供哪些资料？

answer.en: Provide connector and mating part numbers, pin table, branch drawing with datums, each tail length, conductor sizes, loads, splice and sealing requirements, environment, quantity and inspections.
answer.zh: 建议提供连接器与对插件型号、针脚表、带基准的分支图、各尾端长度、导体规格、负载、接点与密封要求、环境、数量和检验项目。

question.en: Can you reproduce a pigtail from a sample?
question.zh: 可以依据样品复制尾线吗？

answer.en: Yes, but hidden pin routes, conductor ratings, plating, internal splices and acceptance criteria still require confirmation. A sample is evidence, not a complete specification.
answer.zh: 可以，但隐藏针脚、导体额定、镀层、内部接点与验收标准仍需确认。样品是开发依据，不是完整规格。

zh: 工业设备与分布式传感器
自动化单元与机器人末端工具

avoidMisidentification.zh: 分支电流之和与主干导体分别核对
avoidMisidentification.en: Check total branch current against the trunk conductor

avoidMisidentification.zh: 隐蔽接续点需要工艺与检验依据
avoidMisidentification.en: Require process and inspection evidence for hidden splices

avoidMisidentification.zh: 线色不等于功能定义
avoidMisidentification.en: Wire color is not a functional definition

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。
contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: A turnkey harness project covers a more complete supply scope: material sourcing, connector and accessory preparation, assembly, labeling, inspection and packed delivery to an agreed drawing and BOM.
introVariants.zh: 交钥匙线束项目覆盖更完整的供货范围，包括物料采购、连接器与附件准备、线束装配、标签、检验以及依据约定图纸和BOM包装交付。

introVariants.en: The key difference is configuration control. Drawings, BOM revisions, approved sources, substitutions, tooling, test methods, labels and packing instructions must stay aligned so a repeat order reproduces the approved assembly.
introVariants.zh: 交钥匙项目的关键是配置管理。图纸、BOM版本、认可来源、替代规则、工装、测试方法、标签和包装说明必须保持一致，才能让重复订单复现确认样品。

text.en: Complete machine looms and installation kits covering panels, sensors, motors, actuators and distributed modules.
text.zh: 覆盖面板、传感器、电机、执行器与分布式模块的完整设备线束与安装套件。

text.en: Station-specific harness sets for robots, tooling, conveyors, safety devices and control cabinets, labeled to the cell build sequence.
text.zh: 为机器人、末端工具、输送、安全器件与控制柜提供按单元装配顺序标识的工位线束套件。

text.en: Pre-terminated panel wiring, grounding leads, jumpers and fuse or relay subassemblies supplied to drawings and terminal schedules.
text.zh: 依据图纸与端子表交付预制面板线、接地线、跳线以及保险或继电器子组件。

text.en: Internal harness kits joining control boards, motors, heaters, switches and user interfaces with appliance-specific routing and labels.
text.zh: 按照设备特定路径与标签连接控制板、电机、加热器、开关和人机界面的内部线束套件。

text.en: Source-controlled harnesses and field connection kits for pumps, treatment modules, monitoring devices and auxiliary systems.
text.zh: 为泵、处理模块、监测器件与辅助系统提供来源受控线束和现场连接套件。

text.en: Low-volume cable and harness sets with fixtures, identifiers and documented inspections for benches, instruments and specialized equipment.
text.zh: 为测试台、仪器和专用设备提供含工装、标识与记录检验的小批量线缆线束套件。

title.en: Turn incomplete data into a controlled package
title.zh: 把不完整资料转化为受控包

text.en: Drawings, pin tables, samples, equipment photos and component data are reviewed for gaps. Assumptions and open points are recorded before the drawing, BOM and inspection plan are released.
text.zh: 审核图纸、针脚表、样品、设备照片与器件资料中的缺口，在放行图纸、BOM与检验计划前记录假设和待确认项。

title.en: Convert a legacy sample into repeat production
title.zh: 把旧样品转化为重复生产

text.en: An existing assembly is measured and electrically mapped, while hidden ratings, unavailable parts and undocumented processes are identified for customer review before a repeatable specification is frozen.
text.zh: 对现有组件进行测量和电气映射，同时识别隐藏额定、停产物料与未记录工艺，在冻结可重复规格前交由客户审核。

title.zh: 管理难采购物料与替代

text.en: Long-lead or unavailable items are flagged early. Alternatives are compared by mating, rating, material, tooling, approval documents, installation impact and customer authorization before release.
text.zh: 提前识别长交期或停供物料。替代件从对插、额定、材料、工装、认可文件、安装影响与客户授权等方面比较后放行。

label.zh: 整套物料BOM与供料责任
label.en: Complete BOM and material-supply responsibility

value.zh: BOM列明采购件、客户供料与装配附件。
value.en: Separate procured parts, customer-supplied items and accessories in the BOM.

label.zh: 配套控制件、机电件与安装范围
label.en: Included controls, electromechanical parts and installation scope

value.zh: 配套元件及安装范围按模块边界说明。
value.en: Define included devices and installation scope by module boundaries.

label.zh: 装配层级、安装顺序与工具需求
label.en: Assembly hierarchy, installation sequence and tools

value.zh: 安装层级、顺序和工具由整套结构确定。
value.en: Define assembly levels, sequence and tools for the complete structure.

label.zh: 模块验收与整套功能边界
label.en: Module acceptance and system-function boundaries

value.zh: 模块检查与整机功能验证的责任分别约定。
value.en: Agree responsibilities for module checks and system-function validation separately.

label.zh: 电路与版本依据
label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Define the exact supply boundary, customer-supplied parts, approved manufacturers, substitution approval process, inspection records, packing unit and revision authority.
value.zh: 需要明确供货边界、客供物料、认可制造商、替代审批流程、检验记录、包装单位和版本批准权限。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: The project normally passes through DFM review, BOM and source confirmation, first-article build, customer approval and controlled production release. Future changes are handled through a recorded revision process.
value.zh: 项目通常经过可制造性审核、BOM与来源确认、首件制作、客户批准和受控量产放行；后续变更通过可追踪的版本流程处理。

question.en: What does turnkey supply include?
question.zh: 交钥匙供货包含什么？

answer.en: The exact scope is project-specific. It can include engineering review, sourcing, customer-supplied parts, harness assembly, accessories, labels, inspection, records, kitting and packaging. The quotation and approved documents define the boundary.
answer.zh: 准确范围按项目确定，可以包含工程审核、采购、客供件、线束组装、附件、标签、检验、记录、配套与包装。报价与批准文件定义边界。

question.en: Can you work with customer-supplied parts?
question.zh: 可以使用客户提供的物料吗？

answer.en: Yes, when receiving condition, quantities, ownership, shortage handling, unused return, traceability and responsibility for part suitability are agreed before production.
answer.zh: 可以，但生产前需约定收料状态、数量、所有权、短缺处理、余料退回、追踪与物料适用责任。

question.en: How are substitutions handled?
question.zh: 替代件怎样管理？

answer.en: Alternatives are compared technically and commercially, then released only through the agreed customer approval route. A temporary deviation is recorded separately from the standard BOM.
answer.zh: 替代件经过技术与商务比较，只能通过约定客户审批路径放行；临时偏差与标准BOM分开记录。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 客户供料和工厂采购件分别确认
avoidMisidentification.en: Distinguish customer-supplied and factory-procured parts

avoidMisidentification.zh: 成套交付不自动包含整机设计责任
avoidMisidentification.en: Turnkey delivery does not automatically include full-equipment design responsibility

avoidMisidentification.zh: 版本变更需覆盖所有关联子件
avoidMisidentification.en: Revision changes must cover all affected subassemblies

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。
contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: Braided protection harnesses use textile, expandable, metal or other specified braiding to protect or organize a cable bundle. Protective braid and conductive shielding braid serve different functions and are not interchangeable.
introVariants.zh: 编织防护线束使用纺织、扩张、金属或其他指定编织层保护和整理线束。机械防护编织层与导电屏蔽编织层用途不同，不能混为一谈。

introVariants.en: Material, coverage, expansion range, abrasion behavior, temperature, cut-edge treatment and branch transitions determine whether the braid can be assembled and maintained. Shielding braid additionally requires a defined termination and grounding approach.
introVariants.zh: 材料、覆盖率、扩张范围、耐磨表现、温度、切口处理和分支过渡决定编织层是否便于装配与维护；屏蔽编织层还必须明确端接和接地方式。

title.zh: 机器人与重复运动设备

text.en: Flexible protective braid organizes cables around moving arms and tooling while branch, bend and attachment points remain matched to the motion path.
text.zh: 柔性防护编织整理运动臂与工具周围电缆，分支、弯曲和固定点仍需匹配运动路径。

text.en: Abrasion, chips, oil and service contact drive braid, conduit and transition choices around cabinets, spindles, sensors and auxiliary systems.
text.zh: 机柜、主轴、传感器与辅助系统周围的磨损、切屑、油污和检修接触决定编织、波纹管与过渡结构。

text.en: Glass fibre, aramid or specified high-temperature braid protects cable surfaces near heaters, ovens and thermal equipment when the full temperature profile is known.
text.zh: 在掌握完整温度曲线后，玻纤、芳纶或指定耐高温编织可用于加热器、炉体与热设备附近的线缆表面防护。

text.en: Conductive braid and controlled terminations can support shielding for measurement, sensor and communication circuits where the grounding scheme is defined.
text.zh: 在接地方案明确时，导电编织与受控端接可支持测量、传感与通信回路的屏蔽。

text.en: Moisture, salt, chemicals and sunlight require braid material and underlying cable jackets that are compatible with the complete exposure, not just an attractive outer weave.
text.zh: 湿气、盐分、化学品与日照要求编织材料和内部电缆护套共同适配完整环境，而不仅是外层织物看起来耐用。

text.en: Neat abrasion-resistant braid supports organized, serviceable visible cable runs in kiosks, appliances, packaging equipment and production fixtures.
text.zh: 整洁耐磨编织适用于售卖设备、电器、包装设备与生产工装中可见且需要检修的布线路径。

title.en: Select braid from the real protection goal
title.zh: 从真实防护目标选择编织

text.en: The project first separates abrasion, bundle management, appearance, heat exposure and electrical shielding. Material and construction are then chosen for the required functions instead of treating every braid as equivalent.
text.zh: 项目首先区分耐磨、束线管理、外观、热暴露与电气屏蔽，再针对所需功能选择材料和结构，避免把所有编织视为同一种产品。

text.en: For EMI projects, braid coverage, overlap, branch continuity, connector backshell, drain path and grounding location are recorded. Shielding performance requires a defined test method and complete installed configuration.
text.zh: EMI项目记录编织覆盖、搭接、分支连续、接口尾壳、排流路径与接地点。屏蔽性能需要明确测试方法和完整装机配置。

text.en: Braid size, branch breakout, overlap, end fixation and bend path are coordinated so the covering follows movement without bunching, opening or loading the connector exit.
text.zh: 协调编织规格、分支引出、搭接、端部固定与弯曲路径，使防护层随运动变化而不堆积、张开或拉扯接口出线。

label.zh: 编织材料、直径与覆盖要求
label.en: Braid material, diameter and coverage requirement

value.zh: 先分清束线、耐磨、热防护与导电屏蔽目标。
value.en: Separate bundle management, abrasion, heat protection and conductive shielding goals.

label.zh: 各段编织长度与分支出口
label.en: Braid segment lengths and branch exits

value.zh: 分段覆盖围绕摩擦区、分支出口和维修空间布置。
value.en: Set segmented coverage around abrasion zones, breakouts and service clearance.

label.zh: 编织端口收尾与热缩固定
label.en: Braid-end finishing and heat-shrink retention

value.zh: 端口收尾可结合热缩、束扎或适用的机械固定。
value.en: Use suitable heat shrink, ties or mechanical retention at sleeve ends.

label.zh: 耐磨、温度与可弯曲要求
label.en: Abrasion, temperature and bending requirements

value.zh: 弯曲与温度条件用于选择编织材料和支撑结构。
value.en: Use bending and temperature conditions to select braid and support.

label.zh: 电路与版本依据
label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: State whether the goal is abrasion protection, appearance, bundle management or electrical shielding.
value.zh: 应说明目标是耐磨、外观、束线管理还是电气屏蔽，并提供最大束径、分支位置、温度与化学环境、端接方式以及要求的覆盖率或测试依据。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: Material and braid size are confirmed on a representative sample. Cut edges, branch transitions, end fixation, flexibility and appearance are reviewed before the protection process is released for production.
value.zh: 通过代表性样品确认编织材料与规格，再核对切口、分支过渡、端部固定、柔性和外观，确认后放行防护工序。

question.en: Does every braided harness provide EMI shielding?
question.zh: 所有编织线束都能提供EMI屏蔽吗？

answer.en: No. PET, nylon and other textile braids mainly provide organization and mechanical protection. EMI shielding requires conductive material, defined coverage, termination, grounding and an agreed validation method.
answer.zh: 不能。PET、尼龙等纺织编织主要提供束线与机械防护。EMI屏蔽需要导电材料、明确覆盖、端接、接地和约定验证方法。

question.en: What information is needed for a quotation?
question.zh: 报价需要提供哪些资料？

answer.en: State the protection goal, braid material if mandatory, minimum and maximum bundle diameters, branches, temperature, chemicals, movement, termination, colour, quantity and required tests.
answer.zh: 请说明防护目标、指定编织材料、最小与最大束径、分支、温度、化学、运动、端接、颜色、数量与所需测试。

question.en: Can braid be added to an existing harness?
question.zh: 可以给现有线束增加编织吗？

answer.en: Often yes, when connector dimensions, removable parts, branch geometry and installation access allow the selected braid to pass and terminate correctly. A representative sample should be reviewed.
answer.zh: 通常可以，但接口尺寸、可拆部件、分支几何与安装空间必须允许所选编织正确通过并端接，建议审核代表性样品。

zh: 机器人与重复运动设备

avoidMisidentification.zh: 绝缘编织套与金属屏蔽编织必须区分
avoidMisidentification.en: Distinguish insulating braid from metallic shielding braid

avoidMisidentification.zh: 切口或金属丝不能伤及绝缘层
avoidMisidentification.en: Prevent cut edges or strands from damaging insulation

avoidMisidentification.zh: 套管外径与实际安装通道核对
avoidMisidentification.en: Check finished sleeve diameter against routing space

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。
contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: Prototype and small-batch harnesses support engineering validation, replacement trials, pilot equipment and low-volume projects where the design may still change. The objective is to learn quickly without losing configuration control.
introVariants.zh: 样品与小批量线束适用于工程验证、替代试验、试制设备和低用量项目，设计在这一阶段可能仍会调整，重点是在快速验证的同时保持版本受控。

introVariants.en: Prototype materials and manual processes may differ from the final production route. Temporary substitutions, hand-built features and unvalidated assumptions should be identified so a functional sample is not mistaken for a frozen mass-production specification.
introVariants.zh: 样品物料和手工作业方式可能与最终量产工艺不同。临时替代、手工结构或尚未验证的假设应明确记录，避免把通过功能试验的样品误认为已经冻结的量产规格。

text.en: Validates cabinet, sensor, actuator, motor and safety connections while the equipment layout is still being adjusted.
text.zh: 在设备布局仍调整时验证机柜、传感器、执行器、电机与安全连接。

text.en: Supports initial stations, packaging equipment and process modules before quantities and final routing are stable.
text.zh: 支持初始工位、包装设备与工艺模块，在数量和最终布线路径稳定前完成验证。

text.en: Connects instruments, fixtures, sensors and data-acquisition hardware for a defined experiment or verification setup.
text.zh: 为明确的实验或验证配置连接仪器、工装、传感器与数据采集硬件。

text.en: Checks internal routing, motors, heaters, controls and service connections before enclosure and assembly details are finalized.
text.zh: 在外壳与装配细节定型前检查内部布线、电机、加热、控制与维修连接。

text.en: Supports new end effectors, motion modules, sensors and controller interfaces through successive engineering revisions.
text.zh: 支持新末端工具、运动模块、传感器与控制器接口的连续工程迭代。

text.en: Suitable for treatment, monitoring, field-service and custom machines whose annual demand remains below conventional mass production.
text.zh: 适用于处理、监测、现场服务与定制设备，其年度需求低于常规大批量生产。

title.zh: 从不完整工程资料启动

text.en: We can organize drawings, pin tables, photos, marked samples and equipment layouts into a review list that separates confirmed requirements from assumptions.
text.zh: 可把图纸、针脚表、照片、标记样品与设备布局整理为审核清单，区分已确认要求与工程假设。

title.en: Build for one defined test purpose
title.zh: 围绕单一明确测试目的制作

text.en: Fit, function, environmental and production-process samples answer different questions. Defining the purpose avoids unnecessary cost and misleading acceptance.
text.zh: 装配、功能、环境与生产工艺样品回答的问题不同，先定义目的可避免无效成本和错误验收。

title.zh: 把反馈转化为受控版本

text.en: Every approved change updates the applicable drawing, BOM, pin map, label or inspection requirement so the next build does not depend on memory.
text.zh: 每项批准变更同步更新适用图纸、BOM、针脚、标签或检验要求，使下一次制作不依赖口头记忆。

label.zh: 样品版本、数量与目标用途
label.en: Sample revision, quantity and intended use

value.zh: 样品编号区分版本、数量与验证用途。
value.en: Use sample references to distinguish revision, quantity and validation purpose.

label.zh: 尚未冻结的接口、尺寸和材料项
label.en: Unfrozen interfaces, dimensions and materials

value.zh: 未冻结接口、尺寸或替代材料单独记录。
value.en: Record unfrozen interfaces, dimensions and substitute materials separately.

label.zh: 试制工装与临时工艺适用范围
label.en: Prototype tooling and temporary process limits

value.zh: 临时工装与批量工艺分别确认适用范围。
value.en: Confirm prototype-tool and production-process applicability separately.

label.zh: 样品检查记录与批产转移要求
label.en: Sample inspection records and production-transfer requirements

value.zh: 将试制反馈转成图纸、BOM与量产检查点。
value.en: Convert prototype feedback into drawing, BOM and production checks.

label.zh: 电路与版本依据
label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Provide the current drawing revision, test purpose, must-use parts, acceptable temporary substitutions, quantity, target date and expected next revision.
value.zh: 建议提供当前图纸版本、测试目的、必须使用的物料、可接受的临时替代、数量、目标日期和下一版计划，并说明哪些尺寸或功能仍在验证。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: A review record identifies assumptions and open points before the sample is built. Feedback is converted into a revised drawing or BOM, and repeat production starts only from the customer-approved revision.
value.zh: 打样前通过审核记录列出假设与待确认项；样品反馈转化为新版图纸或BOM，重复生产只依据客户批准的版本启动。

question.en: How much information is needed to start a prototype?
question.zh: 开始打样需要多少资料？

answer.en: A drawing is helpful but not mandatory. A sample, pin table, connector references, photos and equipment layout can start review when the intended test purpose and open points are stated.
answer.zh: 图纸最有帮助但不是必须。只要说明测试目的与待确认项，样品、针脚表、接口资料、照片和设备布局也可启动审核。

question.en: Can temporary materials be used?
question.zh: 可以使用临时物料吗？

answer.en: They may be used when the customer accepts the substitution and its effect on fit, function or testing is recorded. Temporary parts are not silently converted into the production BOM.
answer.zh: 客户接受且记录其对装配、功能或测试的影响后可以使用，但临时物料不会未经确认直接进入量产BOM。

question.en: Does a working sample mean the design is ready for mass production?
question.zh: 样品能工作就代表可以量产吗？

answer.en: No. A functional sample may still use manual methods, provisional dimensions or unqualified materials. Production release requires a controlled design, repeatable process and agreed inspection plan.
answer.zh: 不代表。功能样品可能仍使用手工方法、临时尺寸或未完成验证的物料，量产放行需要受控设计、可重复工艺与约定检验计划。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 试制替代件需显式记录
avoidMisidentification.en: Record prototype substitutions explicitly

avoidMisidentification.zh: 样品可工作不能替代批产工艺确认
avoidMisidentification.en: A working sample does not validate the production process

avoidMisidentification.zh: 改版样品与旧版照片不得混用
avoidMisidentification.en: Do not mix revised samples with old-revision photos

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。
contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: Outdoor waterproof harnesses are designed for equipment exposed to rain, splash, dust, condensation or other defined environments. Waterproof performance belongs to the complete mated connection and cable-entry system, not to the cable alone.
introVariants.zh: 户外防水线束面向雨水、飞溅、灰尘、冷凝或其他明确环境。防水性能属于完整的插合接口、密封件与出线系统，不能只看线材本身。

introVariants.en: Housing seals, individual wire seals, cavity plugs, connector locks, cable jackets, backshells, branch joints and strain relief all influence ingress protection. Bend loading or an incorrect cable diameter can disturb a rear seal.
introVariants.zh: 壳体密封、单线密封塞、堵孔件、锁止、线缆护套、尾壳、分支接点和应力消除都会影响防护效果；弯曲受力或线径不匹配也可能破坏尾部密封。

title.zh: 户外自动化与生产设备

text.en: Connects sensors, actuators, controls and field modules around exposed production or material-handling systems.
text.zh: 连接暴露生产或物料输送系统周围的传感器、执行器、控制与现场模块。

title.zh: 工程与移动机械辅助系统

text.en: Supports defined low-voltage controls, lighting, sensors and attachments exposed to vibration, mud and service handling.
text.zh: 支持受振动、泥污与检修操作影响的低压控制、照明、传感器和附件。

title.zh: 户外机器人与运动机构

text.en: Combines sealing with controlled movement, bend radius, fixation and rear-seal strain relief.
text.zh: 把密封与运动路径、弯曲半径、固定和尾封应力消除结合设计。

text.en: Addresses washdown, dust, moisture and replaceable field connections on handling and processing equipment when specifically defined.
text.zh: 针对搬运与加工设备明确的冲洗、粉尘、湿气与可更换现场接口需求。

text.en: Routes power and controls between motors, switches, sensors and enclosures with sealed cable entries.
text.zh: 通过密封出线连接电机、开关、传感器与外壳之间的供电和控制。

text.en: Connects probes, instruments, communication nodes and service ports where signal integrity and environmental sealing must coexist.
text.zh: 连接探头、仪器、通信节点与服务接口，使信号完整性与环境密封同时满足。

title.en: Define the actual exposure before selecting parts
title.zh: 选件前先定义真实暴露

text.en: Rain, immersion, pressure wash, mud, salt, chemicals, UV and condensation are different duties. The project states which conditions and test references apply.
text.zh: 雨淋、浸水、压力冲洗、泥污、盐、化学、紫外与冷凝属于不同工况，项目需要明确适用条件和测试依据。

text.en: Both halves, seals, terminals, cavity plugs, locks, backshells and cable entry are reviewed together, including responsibility for the equipment-side connector.
text.zh: 对插两端、密封、端子、堵孔、锁止、尾壳与出线共同审核，并明确设备端接口责任。

title.en: Control branch joints and low points
title.zh: 控制分支接点与积水低点

text.en: Splices, breakouts and label positions are arranged so capillary paths, unsupported bends and water collection do not undermine the sealed interfaces.
text.zh: 安排接点、分支与标签位置，避免毛细路径、无支撑弯曲与积水破坏密封接口。

label.zh: 目标进水条件、安装姿态与对插状态
label.en: Ingress conditions, installed orientation and mating state

value.zh: 进水目标结合完整组件、插合状态与安装姿态。
value.en: Define ingress targets for the complete assembly, mating state and orientation.

label.zh: 连接器密封件、线封适用外径
label.en: Connector seals and wire-seal diameter range

value.zh: 线封与密封件匹配实际绝缘及护套外径。
value.en: Match seals to actual insulation and jacket diameters.

label.zh: 接续、出线口和未使用孔位密封
label.en: Sealing of splices, cable exits and unused cavities

value.zh: 出线口、接续和空孔作为独立密封路径审核。
value.en: Review cable exits, splices and unused cavities as separate sealing paths.

label.zh: 户外温度、紫外线与化学暴露
label.en: Outdoor temperature, UV and chemical exposure

value.zh: 材料同时考虑日照、温度、液体与运动。
value.en: Select materials for sunlight, temperature, fluids and movement together.

label.zh: 电路与版本依据
label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Define the actual exposure, target protection level or test method, mated connector system, cable diameter, unused cavities, mounting direction, branch treatment and responsibility for final installed validation.
value.zh: 需要明确实际暴露环境、目标防护等级或测试方法、完整对插系统、线缆外径、空腔处理、安装方向、分支防护以及最终装机验证责任。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: The sealing stack and cable-entry dimensions are reviewed before the sample. Assembly controls, continuity and any agreed ingress test are recorded for the project; no universal waterproof claim is made outside that validated configuration.
value.zh: 打样前审核密封组合和出线尺寸，项目中记录装配控制、导通和约定的防护测试；未经该配置验证，不作通用防水承诺。

question.en: Is a waterproof connector enough to make the harness waterproof?
question.zh: 使用防水连接器就代表整条线束防水吗？

answer.en: No. Both mated halves, seals, cavity plugs, wire diameters, cable entries, branches, strain relief and installed orientation affect the complete result.
answer.zh: 不代表。对插两端、密封、堵孔、线径、出线、分支、应力消除与安装方向都会影响完整结果。

question.en: Can you provide a specific IP rating?
question.zh: 可以提供指定IP等级吗？

answer.en: A target can be reviewed when the complete configuration, specimen, test method and acceptance criteria are defined. The category name alone is not an IP claim.
answer.zh: 完整配置、试样、测试方法与验收标准明确后可以审核目标，小类名称本身不构成IP等级承诺。

question.en: What information is needed for development?
question.zh: 开发需要哪些资料？

answer.en: Provide both mating interfaces, pin map, wire and cable diameters, unused cavities, installation direction, exposure, movement, quantity and the required test reference.
answer.zh: 请提供对插两端、针脚、线材与电缆外径、空腔、安装方向、暴露、运动、数量与所需测试依据。

zh: 户外自动化与生产设备
工程与移动机械辅助系统
户外机器人与运动机构

avoidMisidentification.zh: 防水等级必须有完整组件和试验依据
avoidMisidentification.en: Ingress ratings require complete-assembly test evidence

avoidMisidentification.zh: 连接器与线封之外的进水路径需检查
avoidMisidentification.en: Check ingress paths beyond connector and wire seals

avoidMisidentification.zh: 浸水、喷淋与冷凝并非同一种条件
avoidMisidentification.en: Immersion, spray and condensation are different conditions

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。
contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: Low-voltage new-energy harnesses serve auxiliary controllers, sensors, pumps, fans, lighting, communication or diagnostic functions in electric or new-energy equipment. This category does not mean high-voltage traction or battery power cabling.
introVariants.zh: 新能源低压线束用于电动或新能源设备中的辅助控制器、传感器、泵、风扇、照明、通信或诊断功能。本类别不等同于高压动力或电池主回路线束。

introVariants.en: Low-voltage circuits can still combine power, communication and sensitive signals. Connector keying, current path, fuse strategy, grounding, shielding, sealing and routing must match the actual controller and electrical architecture.
introVariants.zh: 低压系统仍可能同时包含供电、通信和敏感信号。接口防错、电流路径、保险策略、接地、屏蔽、密封和布线必须与实际控制器及电气架构匹配。

title.zh: 电动与电气化移动设备

text.en: Supports auxiliary controls, sensing, lighting, communication and service functions outside the high-voltage traction circuit.
text.zh: 支持高压牵引回路之外的辅助控制、传感、照明、通信与服务功能。

text.en: Connects low-voltage controllers, indicators, locks, fans, sensors and communication modules in charging cabinets or interfaces.
text.zh: 连接充电柜或接口中的低压控制器、指示、锁止、风扇、传感器与通信模块。

text.en: Supports low-voltage sensing, BMS communication, service and auxiliary-control branches while the project defines voltage and isolation boundaries.
text.zh: 支持低压传感、BMS通信、服务与辅助控制分支，电压和隔离边界由项目明确。

text.en: Links monitoring boards, fans, indicators, sensors and service interfaces around inverters and control enclosures, excluding their high-energy power paths.
text.zh: 连接逆变器与控制外壳周围的监测板、风扇、指示、传感与服务接口，不包括其高能量动力路径。

text.en: Connects auxiliary power distribution, controls, interlocks, pumps and monitoring in electrified production and process equipment.
text.zh: 连接电气化生产与工艺设备中的辅助配电、控制、互锁、泵与监测。

text.en: Routes sensors, pumps, valves and fans for defined cooling, heating and environmental-control functions.
text.zh: 为明确的冷却、加热与环境控制功能连接传感器、泵、阀与风扇。

title.en: Separate low-voltage scope from high-voltage scope

text.en: Nominal and maximum voltage, isolation boundaries, interfaces and applicable customer rules are confirmed before quotation. High-voltage traction requests enter a separate capability review.
text.zh: 报价前确认标称与最高电压、隔离边界、接口和适用客户规则；高压牵引需求进入独立能力审核。

title.en: Develop from system architecture and pin data
title.zh: 依据系统架构与针脚资料开发

text.en: Controller I/O, power distribution, fuse strategy, loads, communication buses, grounding and service interfaces are converted into a controlled harness drawing.
text.zh: 把控制器I/O、配电、保险策略、负载、通信总线、接地与服务接口转化为受控线束图纸。

text.en: Branch geometry, pair structure, separation, shield termination and reference grounds are arranged so switching circuits do not unnecessarily disturb sensing or communication.
text.zh: 通过分支几何、线对结构、隔离、屏蔽端接与参考地布置，减少开关回路对传感与通信的不必要干扰。

label.zh: 系统低压边界与电压范围
label.en: System low-voltage boundary and voltage range

value.zh: 先区分辅助低压与高压动力系统的边界。
value.en: Separate auxiliary low-voltage and high-voltage power boundaries.

label.zh: BMS采样、电源与控制针脚图
label.en: BMS sensing, power and control pinout

value.zh: BMS采样、供电与控制针位分别定义。
value.en: Define BMS sensing, supply and control pins separately.

label.zh: 线径、保护器件与支路负载
label.en: Wire size, protective devices and branch loads

value.zh: 主干、支路负载和保护器件共同决定导体配置。
value.en: Select conductors from trunk/branch loads and protective devices together.

label.zh: 电池附近温度、振动及隔离要求
label.en: Temperature, vibration and isolation near the battery

value.zh: 按电池附近的热、振动及隔离需求布线。
value.en: Route for heat, vibration and isolation needs near the battery.

label.zh: 电路与版本依据
label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Provide the platform and controller, nominal and maximum voltage, current by circuit, communication type, pin map, connector references, installation zone and applicable customer specification.
value.zh: 需要提供平台与控制器、标称和最高电压、各回路电流、通信类型、针脚图、接口资料、安装区域和客户规范；高压需求必须另行进行能力与合规审核。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: Engineering confirms the low-voltage boundary, interfaces and inspection plan before sampling. The approved sample, pin table, labels and agreed electrical checks become the controlled reference for production.
value.zh: 打样前确认低压范围、接口和检验计划；获批样品、针脚表、标签和约定的电气检查项目作为受控量产依据。

question.en: Does this category include high-voltage battery or traction cables?
question.zh: 这个小类包括高压电池或牵引电缆吗？

answer.en: No. It covers project-defined low-voltage auxiliary power, control, sensing, communication and diagnostic circuits. High-voltage requests require separate capability and compliance review.
answer.zh: 不包括。本小类覆盖项目定义的低压辅助供电、控制、传感、通信与诊断回路，高压需求需要独立能力与合规审核。

question.en: How is the low-voltage boundary defined?
question.zh: 低压边界怎样定义？

answer.en: The customer provides nominal and maximum voltage, platform rules, circuit list and isolation boundaries. The label low voltage is not assumed from connector size or application name.
answer.zh: 由客户提供标称与最高电压、平台规则、回路与隔离边界，不能根据接口大小或应用名称自行判断。

question.en: Can power and communication circuits share one harness?
question.zh: 供电与通信回路可以放在同一线束里吗？

answer.en: They may when current paths, separation, pair structure, shielding, grounding and connector capacity are reviewed for the actual controller architecture.
answer.zh: 可以，但必须结合实际控制器架构审核电流路径、隔离、线对结构、屏蔽、接地与接口容量。

zh: 电动与电气化移动设备

avoidMisidentification.zh: 低压辅助线束与高压动力线束分开定义
avoidMisidentification.en: Define low-voltage auxiliary and high-voltage power harnesses separately

avoidMisidentification.zh: 采样线序、参考地与熔断要求必须核对
avoidMisidentification.en: Verify sensing order, reference ground and fusing

avoidMisidentification.zh: 新能源标签不能证明高压或电池合规
avoidMisidentification.en: A new-energy label does not establish high-voltage or battery compliance

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。
contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: Overmolded cable assemblies encapsulate the connector-to-cable transition with a selected thermoplastic or elastomer to provide defined strain relief, sealing, touch protection, geometry and appearance. The result depends on the complete interface, cable jacket, molding material, insert preparation and process window.
introVariants.zh: 包覆成型电缆组件使用指定热塑性材料或弹性体包覆连接器与线缆的过渡区域，以形成明确的应力消除、密封、触摸防护、几何和外观。最终效果取决于完整接口、线缆护套、包胶材料、嵌件处理与工艺窗口。

introVariants.en: A durable overmold is not simply plastic placed around a connector. Resin compatibility, adhesion or mechanical locking, melt temperature, insert temperature, pressure, venting, wall thickness, cable movement and shrinkage all affect cracks, voids, flash, deformation and bond stability.
introVariants.zh: 可靠包胶并不是简单地在连接器外面注塑。树脂兼容性、粘接或机械锁固、熔体温度、嵌件温度、压力、排气、壁厚、线缆移动与收缩都会影响开裂、气孔、飞边、变形和结合稳定性。

text.en: Overmolding can protect compact interfaces and cable exits on sensors, valves, switches and actuators exposed to handling, vibration or contamination.
text.zh: 包胶可保护传感器、阀、开关与执行器上的紧凑接口和出线，使其适应操作、振动或污染。

text.en: Molded connectors provide repeatable handling and strain relief for equipment modules, fixtures and replaceable station cables.
text.zh: 成型接口为设备模块、工装与可更换工位电缆提供可重复操作和应力消除。

text.en: Defined boots and rigid bodies protect connectors around oil, chips, vibration and frequent technician handling when materials are matched to the exposure.
text.zh: 材料匹配环境后，明确的护套与硬质外壳可保护油污、切屑、振动和频繁操作区域的接口。

text.en: A tuned strain-relief transition can manage repeated cable movement, but flex life still depends on the cable, routing, bend radius and attachment system.
text.zh: 经过调整的应力过渡可以管理重复运动，但弯折寿命仍取决于线缆、路径、弯曲半径与固定系统。

text.en: Molded junctions and plugs can combine touch protection, recognizable geometry, cleanability and repeatable assembly around motors, heaters and controls.
text.zh: 成型接点与插头可在电机、加热和控制连接中结合触摸防护、识别几何、易清洁和可重复装配。

text.en: Custom exits, shield terminations and compact molded bodies support probes, instruments and fixtures when signal requirements and grounding are defined.
text.zh: 在信号与接地明确时，定制出线、屏蔽端接与紧凑成型外壳可支持探头、仪器和测试工装。

title.en: Design from the interface and duty cycle
title.zh: 从接口与工作周期开始设计

text.en: Mating clearance, user handling, cable pull direction, bending, sealing, chemicals and assembly space define the molded envelope before a tool is selected.
text.zh: 插合空间、用户操作、拉线方向、弯折、密封、化学环境与装配空间共同定义成型外形，再决定模具方案。

title.en: Review existing tooling without forcing a fit
title.zh: 审核现有模具但不强行套用

text.en: An existing tool may reduce development work only when insert position, cable diameter, interface clearance, gate, parting line and performance requirements genuinely match.
text.zh: 只有嵌件位置、线径、接口空间、浇口、分型线与性能要求真正匹配时，现有模具才可能减少开发工作。

title.en: Control insert position and cavity filling
title.zh: 控制嵌件位置与型腔填充

text.en: Fixtures support connectors, cables, shields and components against injection movement. Gate and vent locations are arranged to fill thin sections without trapping air or displacing wires.
text.zh: 工装支撑接口、线缆、屏蔽与元件，抵抗注射位移；浇口与排气位置需要让薄壁充分填充，同时避免困气和推移线材。

label.zh: 包胶材料、硬度与线缆护套相容性
label.en: Molding material, hardness and cable-jacket compatibility

value.zh: 材料与护套相容性、硬度和外观一起评估。
value.en: Assess jacket compatibility, hardness and appearance together.

label.zh: 端头3D结构、出线角度与分型线
label.en: End geometry, exit angle and mold parting line

value.zh: 3D端头定义出线角度、过渡段和分型位置。
value.en: Define exit angle, transition and parting positions in the end geometry.

label.zh: 模具方案、注塑工艺窗口与嵌件定位
label.en: Tooling, molding process window and insert location

value.zh: 模具定位与温压条件结合嵌件耐受能力确定。
value.en: Select tooling location and process conditions for insert tolerance.

label.zh: 应力消除与目标密封检验方法
label.en: Strain relief and target sealing test method

value.zh: 拉力、弯折与密封目标分别设定验证方法。
value.en: Set separate validation methods for pull, bend and sealing targets.

label.zh: 电路与版本依据
label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Provide both interfaces, pin map, cable construction, jacket material and diameter, required molded geometry, colour, hardness, environmental exposure, bend direction, pull loads, quantity and validation method.
value.zh: 建议提供两端接口、针脚、线缆结构、护套材料与外径、所需包胶几何、颜色、硬度、环境、弯曲方向、拉力、数量与验证方法。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: Engineering first reviews the electrical assembly and molding feasibility. A drawing defines insert position, datums, parting line, gate-sensitive surfaces and cable exit.
value.zh: 工程首先审核电气组件与包胶可行性。图纸定义嵌件位置、基准、分型线、浇口敏感面与出线方向，再依次确认模具、首件、尺寸与电气检查、约定机械测试和生产控制。

question.en: What is the difference between overmolding and using a separate boot?
question.zh: 包覆成型与安装独立护套有什么区别？

answer.en: Overmolding forms material directly around the insert and cable in a tool, creating a controlled integrated geometry. A separate boot is assembled afterward and may not provide the same retention, sealing or dimensional control.
answer.zh: 包覆成型在模具中直接围绕嵌件与线缆形成材料，得到受控一体几何；独立护套在之后装配，其保持、密封与尺寸控制可能不同。

question.en: Which molding material should be used?
question.zh: 应该使用哪种包胶材料？

answer.en: The choice depends on hardness, flexing, temperature, chemicals, abrasion, flame requirements, colour, cable-jacket compatibility and processing temperature. A material name alone is not enough.
answer.zh: 选择取决于硬度、弯折、温度、化学、耐磨、阻燃、颜色、护套兼容与加工温度，单一材料名称不足以完成选型。

question.en: Can an existing mold be reused?
question.zh: 可以复用现有模具吗？

answer.en: Possibly, after insert position, cable diameter, interface clearance, exit direction, parting line, gate and required performance are compared. Similar appearance does not guarantee fit.
answer.zh: 可以审核，但需要比较嵌件位置、线径、接口空间、出线方向、分型线、浇口与性能要求，外形相似不代表能够适配。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 外观包胶不能证明防水或耐拉等级
avoidMisidentification.en: Molded appearance does not establish ingress or pull ratings

avoidMisidentification.zh: 模流温度和压力对内部件影响需验证
avoidMisidentification.en: Assess molding temperature and pressure effects on internal parts

avoidMisidentification.zh: 线缆护套粘接与机械锁固分别确认
avoidMisidentification.en: Confirm jacket bonding and mechanical retention separately

introVariants.en: Circular connector cable assemblies cover threaded, bayonet, push-pull, panel-mount, inline, sealed and mixed-contact interfaces for power, signal, communication and sensor circuits. Each assembly is defined by its exact connector family, keying, contact arrangement, cable, backshell and installation environment.
introVariants.zh: 圆形连接器电缆组件覆盖螺纹、卡口、推拉、面板安装、线对线、密封与混合针芯接口，可承载电源、信号、通信和传感器回路。每条组件都由准确的连接器系列、键位、针芯排列、线缆、尾壳和安装环境共同定义。

introVariants.en: A similar shell diameter does not prove interchangeability. Coupling geometry, keys, insert layout, contact sex, terminal range, seals and backshell threads must all match the mating interface and cable construction.
introVariants.zh: 外壳直径相似并不能证明可以互换。锁紧几何、键位、绝缘体孔位、接触件性别、端子线径范围、密封件与尾部螺纹都必须匹配对插接口和线缆结构。

text.zh: 按传感器接口与固定距离配置端头和线长。
text.en: Configure ends and length for the sensor interface and fixing distance.

text.zh: 面板厚度、插合方向和锁紧空间共同决定安装结构。
text.en: Panel thickness, orientation and coupling clearance define the mounting.

text.zh: 依据模块针图安排供电、信号和服务接入。
text.en: Arrange power, signals and service access from the module pin map.

text.zh: 接点数量、插拔频率与线缆盘绕决定连接配置。
text.en: Contact count, mating frequency and cable coiling guide the configuration.

text.zh: 供电触点、线径与温升按设备负载审核。
text.en: Review power contacts, wire size and temperature rise for the device load.

text.zh: 前后端出线与开孔固定需配合机壳尺寸。
text.en: Match front/rear exits and cutout fixing to enclosure dimensions.

text.zh: 按具体系列、编码、针位和对插端选接口。
text.en: Select interfaces by exact series, coding, contacts and mating part.

text.en: Match threaded, bayonet or push-pull coupling to operating clearance.

text.en: Set straight/angled ends and length datums for equipment routing.

question.en: Can circular connectors with the same diameter be interchanged?
question.zh: 圆形连接器外径相同就可以互换吗？

answer.en: No. Family, keying, contact arrangement, shell fit, coupling, contacts and seals can differ. Compatibility requires complete interface data and mating verification.
answer.zh: 不可以。系列、键位、针芯排列、壳体配合、锁紧结构、触点和密封都可能不同，必须依据完整接口资料与对插验证确认。

question.en: Does a metal circular connector automatically provide shielding?
question.zh: 金属圆形连接器一定有屏蔽吗？

answer.en: No. Shielding depends on cable shield termination, backshell, shell continuity, panel connection and system grounding. A metal appearance alone proves nothing.
answer.zh: 不一定。有效屏蔽取决于电缆屏蔽端接、尾壳、壳体连续、面板连接与系统接地，金属外观本身不能证明屏蔽性能。

question.en: Are all circular connector assemblies waterproof?
question.zh: 圆形连接器组件都能防水吗？

answer.en: No. Protection depends on the complete mated interface, seals, cavity plugs, backshell, cable diameter, mounting orientation and the defined test configuration.
answer.zh: 不能。防护取决于完整插合接口、密封圈、堵孔件、尾壳、线缆外径、安装方向与规定测试配置。

avoidMisidentification.zh: M系列尺寸相近不能证明编码兼容
avoidMisidentification.en: Similar M-series dimensions do not establish coding compatibility

avoidMisidentification.zh: 针号按插合面和公母分别确认
avoidMisidentification.en: Confirm pin numbering by mating view and gender

avoidMisidentification.zh: 额定值需对应具体插合组合及工况
avoidMisidentification.en: Ratings must identify the mating pair and operating conditions

introVariants.en: D-Sub cable assemblies extend far beyond a single nine-contact serial lead. Standard-density, high-density, mixed power and signal, panel-mount, inline, shielded, breakout and application-specific configurations are developed around the exact equipment interface, pin map, cable structure and installation limits.
introVariants.zh: D-Sub 电缆组件远不止常见的九针串口线。标准密度、高密度、混合电源与信号、面板安装、线对线、屏蔽、一分多及专用配置，都需要围绕准确设备接口、针脚定义、线缆结构和安装限制开发。

introVariants.en: Shell size, contact pattern, contact sex, viewing direction, jackscrews, hood, termination and shielding path all matter. A similar D-shaped interface or equal contact count does not prove interchangeability.
introVariants.zh: 外壳尺寸、触点排列、接触件性别、视图方向、固定螺钉、尾罩、端接方式与屏蔽路径都需要确认。D 形外观相似或针数相同并不能证明可以互换。

text.zh: 逐针确认设备侧定义，避免仅凭DB壳体判断协议。
text.en: Confirm device-side pins rather than identifying protocols from the shell.

text.zh: 将通道编号、屏蔽和公共端落实到针表。
text.en: Record channel numbers, shields and common terminals in the pin table.

text.zh: 按接入位置选配转接、分支和便于拆装的尾罩。
text.en: Select adapters, branches and serviceable hoods for the access points.

text.zh: 锁紧螺钉、尾罩与插合面方向共同定义维护入口。
text.en: Define service access from jackscrews, hood and mating-face orientation.

text.zh: 壳号和针数相同时仍需核对原电路与端接形式。
text.en: Check original circuits and termination even when shell size and pin count match.

text.zh: 用针表保留通道身份并定义各支路测量基准。
text.en: Preserve channel identity in the pin table and set branch datums.
