question.en: Are DB9 and DE-9 the same connector?
question.zh: DB9 和 DE-9 是同一种接口吗？

answer.en: DB9 is a common market name for the nine-contact connector, while DE-9 is the more accurate shell designation. Always confirm the mating face, contact sex, hardware and equipment interface rather than relying on the name alone.
answer.zh: 市场常把九针接口称为 DB9，而 DE-9 是更准确的外壳称呼。应核对插合面、触点性别、固定硬件和设备端接口，不能只依赖名称。

question.en: Can D-Sub cables with the same contact count be interchanged?
question.zh: 针数相同的 D-Sub 电缆可以互换吗？

answer.en: No automatic interchangeability exists. Pin map, contact sex, shell, screw hardware, shielding, cable and hidden components can differ even when the contact count is equal.
answer.zh: 不能直接互换。即使针数相同，针脚、触点性别、外壳、螺钉、屏蔽、线缆和隐藏元件也可能不同。

question.en: What is different about high-density D-Sub?
question.zh: 高密度 D-Sub 有什么不同？

answer.en: It places more contacts into a comparable shell size. Cavity pattern, pitch, terminals, wire range and tooling generally differ from standard-density versions.
answer.zh: 高密度结构在相近壳体尺寸内布置更多触点，其孔位、节距、端子、线径范围与工装通常不同于标准密度版本。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 9针或25针本身不定义通信协议
avoidMisidentification.en: A 9- or 25-position connector does not define a protocol

avoidMisidentification.zh: 高密度与标准排布不可按外形混用
avoidMisidentification.en: Do not interchange standard and high-density layouts by appearance

avoidMisidentification.zh: 锁紧螺纹和线缆出口空间需核对
avoidMisidentification.en: Check jackscrew threads and cable-exit clearance

introVariants.en: USB cable assemblies cover legacy Type-A and Type-B interfaces, Mini and Micro formats, reversible Type-C, panel-mounted extensions, molded leads, charging-only constructions, high-speed data paths and USB-to-equipment interfaces. The connector shape is only the starting point; function, pin map, power duty, cable architecture, shielding, electronics, installation and validation define the finished assembly.
introVariants.zh: USB 电缆组件覆盖传统 Type-A 与 Type-B、Mini 与 Micro、可翻转 Type-C、面板延长、包胶线、仅供电结构、高速数据通道以及 USB 到设备专用接口。接口外形只是起点，功能、针脚、供电负载、线缆架构、屏蔽、内部器件、安装与验证共同定义成品。

introVariants.en: A Type-C plug does not by itself establish data rate, power or video capability. Legacy USB shapes can also conceal charging-only, proprietary or converter circuits.
introVariants.zh: Type-C 插头本身不能证明数据速率、功率或视频能力；传统 USB 外形也可能隐藏仅供电、专用针脚或转换电路。接口、代际、设备角色、内部器件和测试边界需要一起冻结。

text.zh: 接口代际、设备角色与数据任务决定线缆架构。
text.en: Interface generation, device role and data duty define cable architecture.

text.zh: 延长位置同时考虑插入方向、固定和背部空间。
text.en: Set extension positions for insertion, fixing and rear clearance.

text.zh: 供电、识别与设备专用针脚需要同时定义。
text.en: Define power, identification and proprietary pins together.

text.zh: 常见接口仍需按设备版本确定数据、供电或专用回路。
text.en: Confirm data, power or proprietary circuits for the exact device version.

text.zh: 供受电角色、线阻与协商器件需要配套审核。
text.en: Review source/sink roles, wire resistance and negotiation devices together.

text.zh: 临时测试与长期安装的长度、出线和保护边界分别说明。
text.en: Define length, exits and protection separately for test and installed use.

value.en: Engineering freezes the interface, circuits, conductor and differential-pair structure, shield path, internal components, mechanics and labels before the first build. Continuity is followed by project-specific voltage-drop, temperature, negotiation, data-link, mechanical or environmental validation where required.
value.zh: 工程在首件前冻结接口、回路、导体与差分对结构、屏蔽路径、内部器件、机械结构和标识。导通之后，再按项目执行压降、温升、协商、数据链路、机械或环境验证。

question.en: Does every Type-C cable support high-speed data and high power?
question.zh: 所有 Type-C 电缆都支持高速数据和大功率吗？

answer.en: No. Type-C identifies the connector system. Data lanes, power duty, Configuration Channel wiring, electronic marking, directionality and equipment capability determine the usable functions.
answer.zh: 不能。Type-C 只识别接口系统，实际功能取决于数据通道、供电负载、Configuration Channel 接线、电子标记、方向性与双方设备能力。

question.en: Does passing continuity prove a high-speed USB cable is good?
question.zh: 导通合格能证明高速 USB 电缆性能吗？

answer.en: No. Continuity proves point-to-point connection. High-speed performance also depends on impedance, loss, crosstalk, termination, length, bending and the complete channel.
answer.zh: 不能。导通只证明点对点连接，高速性能还取决于阻抗、损耗、串扰、端接、长度、弯曲与完整链路。

question.en: Can you build a charging-only cable?
question.zh: 可以制作仅供电 USB 线吗？

answer.en: Yes, when the required identification, CC or other circuits, current, voltage drop, temperature rise and misuse controls are explicitly defined and approved.
answer.zh: 可以，但必须明确并批准所需识别、CC 或其他回路、电流、压降、温升以及防误用措施。

avoidMisidentification.zh: Type-C外形不证明高速或PD能力
avoidMisidentification.en: Type-C shape does not establish high-speed or PD capability

avoidMisidentification.zh: 充电专用与数据线需区分
avoidMisidentification.en: Distinguish charge-only and data constructions

avoidMisidentification.zh: 电子标记或转换芯片须有器件依据
avoidMisidentification.en: E-markers or converter chips require component evidence

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。
contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: Audio cable assemblies connect microphones, instruments, mixers, amplifiers, loudspeakers, broadcast equipment and installed AV systems. XLR, TRS, TS, RCA, 3.5 mm, multipin and equipment-specific ends can carry balanced or unbalanced analog audio, digital audio, control or combined circuits; the finished cable is defined by the complete signal path, not the connector name alone.
introVariants.zh: 音频电缆组件用于连接麦克风、乐器、调音台、功放、扬声器、广播设备与固定式音视频系统。XLR、TRS、TS、RCA、3.5 mm、多芯及设备专用接口可承载平衡或非平衡模拟音频、数字音频、控制或复合回路；真正定义成品的是完整信号路径，而不只是接口名称。

introVariants.en: Microphone, line, instrument and speaker circuits operate at different levels and impedances. Pair geometry, conductor resistance, capacitance, shield coverage, ground strategy, connector wiring, cable length and installation environment therefore need to be reviewed together.
introVariants.zh: 麦克风、线路、乐器与扬声器回路具有不同的信号电平和阻抗。双绞结构、导体电阻、电容、屏蔽覆盖、接地策略、接口接线、线长与安装环境需要共同审核。

text.zh: 平衡、非平衡与屏蔽配置对应实际输入输出。
text.en: Match balanced/unbalanced wiring and shields to the actual I/O.

text.zh: 盘绕、拉拽和分支位置用于选择护套与应力保护。
text.en: Select jackets and strain protection for coiling, handling and breakouts.

text.zh: 按机柜通道标识和接地方案组织多芯连接。
text.en: Organize multicore connections around rack channel IDs and grounding.

text.zh: 话筒偏置、耳机输出和公共端以设备针图为准。
text.en: Use device pin maps for microphone bias, headphone output and common terminals.

text.zh: 按通道顺序定义分支、屏蔽连续与标签。
text.en: Define branches, shield continuity and labels by channel order.

text.zh: 连接器固定、后部走线和金属接地配合机壳结构。
text.en: Coordinate fixing, rear routing and chassis ground with the enclosure.

title.zh: 音频接口、触点数量与接线标准
title.en: Audio interface, contact count and wiring convention

text.zh: 触点数量与XLR、TRS、TRRS等接线约定配套。
text.en: Match contact count to the XLR, TRS, TRRS or other wiring convention.

title.zh: 平衡或非平衡信号及话筒供电

text.zh: 平衡、非平衡和话筒供电采用各自电路。
text.en: Use distinct circuits for balanced, unbalanced and microphone-power paths.

title.zh: 目标设备输入输出与阻抗条件
title.en: Target device I/O and impedance conditions

text.zh: 设备输入输出、负载与目标距离一起审核。
text.en: Review device I/O, load and connection distance together.

label.en: Audio interface, contact count and wiring convention

value.zh: 触点数量与XLR、TRS、TRRS等接线约定配套。
value.en: Match contact count to the XLR, TRS, TRRS or other wiring convention.

value.zh: 平衡、非平衡和话筒供电采用各自电路。
value.en: Use distinct circuits for balanced, unbalanced and microphone-power paths.

label.en: Shield, pairs and ground connections

value.zh: 屏蔽与信号地、外壳地按音频系统安排。
value.en: Route shields, signal ground and chassis ground for the audio system.

value.zh: 设备输入输出、负载与目标距离一起审核。
value.en: Review device I/O, load and connection distance together.

value.en: Provide both equipment endpoints, connector sex and orientation, signal type and level, balanced or unbalanced wiring, pin map, channel count, length, flexibility, shield and grounding requirements, installation method, quantity and validation boundary.
value.zh: 建议提供两端设备、接口公母与方向、信号类型和电平、平衡或非平衡接线、针脚、通道数、长度、柔软性、屏蔽与接地要求、安装方式、数量和验证边界。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: Engineering freezes the circuit map, cable construction, shield termination, connector hardware, branch lengths, labels and strain relief before the first build. Released production is checked for continuity, shorts, polarity, shield path, dimensions, identification and workmanship, with channel or equipment-level tests added where specified.
value.zh: 工程在首件前冻结回路、线缆结构、屏蔽端接、接口硬件、分支长度、标识与应力消除。量产按要求检查导通、短路、极性、屏蔽路径、尺寸、标识和工艺，并在项目指定时增加通道或设备级测试。

question.en: Does an XLR connector always mean balanced audio?
question.zh: 使用 XLR 接口就一定是平衡音频吗？

answer.en: No. XLR describes a connector family. The equipment circuits, pin assignment, cable pair and shield termination determine whether the path is balanced.
answer.zh: 不一定。XLR 描述的是接口家族，是否平衡取决于设备电路、针脚定义、线对与屏蔽端接。

question.en: Is a TRS cable always stereo?
question.zh: TRS 线一定是立体声吗？

answer.en: No. TRS can carry stereo unbalanced audio, mono balanced audio, insert send/return or a proprietary circuit. Confirm both equipment endpoints and the pin map.
answer.zh: 不一定。TRS 可以承载非平衡立体声、平衡单声道、插入发送/返回或专用回路，必须确认两端设备和针脚。

question.en: Can microphone cable be used for loudspeakers?
question.zh: 麦克风线可以用作扬声器线吗？

answer.en: It should not be assumed. Loudspeaker circuits can require much larger conductors and different current, temperature and connector considerations than low-level microphone paths.
answer.zh: 不能直接假设可以。扬声器回路通常需要更大的导体，并具有不同的电流、温度与接口要求。

avoidMisidentification.zh: TRS、TRRS同外径不能证明线序一致
avoidMisidentification.en: Equal TRS/TRRS diameter does not establish matching wiring

avoidMisidentification.zh: 信号屏蔽与机壳地按系统方案确认
avoidMisidentification.en: Confirm signal shield and chassis ground against the system design

avoidMisidentification.zh: 话筒偏置与幻象供电分别核对
avoidMisidentification.en: Check microphone bias and phantom power separately

introVariants.en: Video cable assemblies connect cameras, displays, switchers, recorders, control rooms, industrial panels and imaging equipment. HDMI, DisplayPort, DVI, VGA, BNC/coaxial and equipment-specific interfaces may look familiar, but bandwidth, impedance, pair geometry, shielding, cable length, power and mechanical installation determine the finished assembly.
introVariants.zh: 视频电缆组件用于连接摄像机、显示器、切换台、录像设备、控制室、工业面板与成像设备。HDMI、DisplayPort、DVI、VGA、BNC/同轴及设备专用接口外形可能很熟悉，但真正定义成品的是带宽、阻抗、线对几何、屏蔽、线长、供电与机械安装。

introVariants.en: A connector family does not prove a resolution, refresh rate or transmission distance. The source, sink, coding mode, cable category, conductor or optical construction, equalization and full installation path must be reviewed as one link.
introVariants.zh: 接口家族并不能单独证明分辨率、刷新率或传输距离。信号源、接收端、编码模式、线缆类别、铜缆或光缆结构、均衡方式与完整安装路径必须作为一条链路共同审核。

text.zh: 摄像头与接收端的制式、距离及供电分别说明。
text.en: Specify format, distance and power for camera and receiver.

text.zh: 分辨率、刷新率与安装长度放在同一链路条件中。
text.en: Define resolution, refresh rate and length within one link condition.

text.zh: 同轴、接口及反复插拔要求按系统任务配置。
text.en: Configure coax, connectors and repeated mating for the system task.

text.zh: 相机、采集端和控制任务共同定义数据与供电路径。
text.en: Use camera, acquisition device and control task to define data/power paths.

text.zh: 接口转接需明确源端和显示端，主动转换另行识别。
text.en: Identify source/display ends and distinguish active conversion in adapters.

text.zh: 固定长度、弯曲与应力保护需避免压迫接口。
text.en: Set length, bends and strain protection without loading the interfaces.

title.zh: 视频接口、信号制式与目标格式
title.en: Video interface, signal system and target format

text.zh: 先定义视频制式和接口，再确定连接结构。
text.en: Define video format and interfaces before selecting the construction.

title.en: Channel count, impedance and cable-loss evidence

text.zh: 同轴或差分路径按阻抗、损耗与通道数配置。

title.en: Shield termination and active conversion components

value.zh: 建议提供两端设备、接口类型与方向、视频协议、目标格式与刷新率、色深或色度采样要求、音频/控制通道、线缆与分支长度、安装路径、弯曲与运动工况、屏蔽或接地限制、数量及验证方法。

label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: Engineering freezes the interface map, cable construction, pair or coax assignment, shield termination, directionality, active components, overmold or backshell, labels and inspection limits before release. Production checks wiring, shorts, shield paths, dimensions and workmanship; agreed link or equipment tests are added where continuity alone is insufficient.
value.zh: 工程在放行前冻结接口映射、线缆结构、线对或同轴分配、屏蔽端接、方向性、有源器件、包胶或后壳、标识与检验限值。生产检查接线、短路、屏蔽路径、尺寸和工艺；当导通不足以证明性能时，再按约定增加链路或设备测试。

question.en: Does an HDMI connector guarantee a particular resolution?
question.zh: 使用 HDMI 接口就能保证某个分辨率吗？

answer.en: No. The cable category and construction, length, source, display, operating mode and every adapter or switch in the path determine the supported link.
answer.zh: 不能。线缆类别与结构、长度、信号源、显示端、运行模式以及路径中的每个转接器或切换设备共同决定链路能力。

question.en: Can continuity testing prove a high-speed video cable?
question.zh: 导通测试能证明高速视频线性能吗？

answer.en: No. Continuity verifies pin routing, opens and shorts. High-speed performance may require representative equipment or defined signal-integrity measurements.
answer.zh: 不能。导通测试用于确认针脚、开路与短路；高速性能可能还需要代表性设备或规定的信号完整性测量。

question.en: Are active optical video cables directional?
question.zh: 有源光纤视频线有方向性吗？

answer.en: Many are. Source and display ends, power requirements, bend limits and service conditions must be confirmed for the selected design.
answer.zh: 很多有方向性。所选设计的信号源端与显示端、供电要求、弯曲限制和维修条件都必须确认。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 接头外形不能证明带宽或分辨率
avoidMisidentification.en: Connector shape does not establish bandwidth or resolution

avoidMisidentification.zh: 无源适配与主动转换必须区分
avoidMisidentification.en: Distinguish passive adaptation from active conversion

avoidMisidentification.zh: 验证需包含实际源端和显示端
avoidMisidentification.en: Validation must include the actual source and display

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。
contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: Power cable assemblies include detachable cord sets, equipment leads, panel connections, industrial power jumpers and low-voltage DC supply cables. The finished assembly is defined by the source, load, voltage, current, grounding, connector system, conductor construction, environment and applicable market requirements—not by plug shape alone.
introVariants.zh: 电源线组件包括可拆卸电源线、设备引线、面板连接线、工业电源跳线和低压直流供电线。成品必须由电源端、负载端、电压、电流、接地、连接器系统、导体结构、使用环境及目标市场要求共同定义，不能只按插头外形判断。

introVariants.en: A safe power path is a coordinated system. Conductor resistance creates voltage drop and heat; contacts add localized resistance; insulation and jacket must suit voltage, temperature and environment; strain relief must keep mechanical loads away from energized terminations.
introVariants.zh: 可靠的供电路径是一套相互配合的系统。导体电阻会产生压降和热量，接触件会引入局部电阻，绝缘与护套必须适应电压、温度和环境，应力消除则要把机械载荷隔离在带电端接之外。

text.zh: 输入制式、接地与机壳安装范围共同审核。
text.en: Review supply format, earth and enclosure installation together.

text.zh: 负载和工作循环影响线径、端头与保护选择。
text.en: Load and duty cycle guide wire, ends and protection.

text.zh: 按被测设备负载和操作路径定义长度与标识。
text.en: Define length and identification for test-device loads and handling.

text.zh: 输入端制式、接地与局部热区按整机要求审核。
text.en: Review input format, earth and local heat against equipment requirements.

text.zh: 分支保护、接点负载与维护标识一起安排。
text.en: Coordinate branch protection, contact loading and service identification.

text.zh: 接口、出线方向和固定方式配合拆装顺序。
text.en: Match interfaces, exit direction and fixing to the removal sequence.

title.zh: 输入输出制式、电压与持续电流
title.en: Input/output format, voltage and continuous current

text.zh: 输入输出及销售地区决定接口与供电制式。
text.en: Define interfaces and supply format from endpoints and destination region.

title.zh: 导体截面、长度和允许压降
title.en: Conductor area, length and allowable voltage drop

text.zh: 导体截面、长度、压降及温升一起评估。
text.en: Assess conductor area, length, voltage drop and temperature rise together.

label.en: Conductor area, length and allowable voltage drop

value.zh: 导体截面、长度、压降及温升一起评估。
value.en: Assess conductor area, length, voltage drop and temperature rise together.

value.en: Match connectors, terminals and protective earth as a complete circuit.

value.zh: 请提供电源端与负载端接口、交流或直流、额定及最高电压、持续与峰值电流、接地与极性、线长、环境及导体温度限制、弯曲与走线工况、销售地区、数量以及所需合规或验证。

Production verifies wiring, polarity, shorts, dimensions and workmanship, with earth continuity, dielectric, insulation, leakage, temperature or equipment tests added only where the project requires them.
value.zh: 工程放行受控回路、导体和软线类别、连接器额定值、接触件与端接工艺、接地、包胶或后壳、标识及检验限值。生产检查接线、极性、短路、尺寸和工艺，并仅在项目要求时增加接地连续性、耐压、绝缘、泄漏、温升或设备运行测试。

question.en: Can wire gauge be selected from current alone?
question.zh: 线径只按电流选择就可以吗？

answer.en: No. Length, allowable voltage drop, ambient and conductor temperature, bundling, duty cycle, insulation rating, terminal range and protective device all affect the selection.
answer.zh: 不可以。长度、允许压降、环境与导体温度、成束、工作循环、绝缘额定值、端子适用范围和保护器件都会影响选择。

question.en: Does a plug that fits have the correct rating?
question.zh: 插头能插上就代表额定值正确吗？

answer.en: No. Connector geometry, current, voltage, grounding, polarization, temperature, environment and regional approval must all match the application.
answer.zh: 不代表。连接器几何、电流、电压、接地、极性、温度、环境及地区认可必须全部匹配应用。

question.en: Can an existing power cord sample be copied?
question.zh: 可以依据现有电源线样品复制吗？

answer.en: A sample helps confirm fit and visible construction, but hidden conductor area, material grade, ratings, approval scope and electrical load still require documentation or testing.
answer.zh: 样品有助于确认装配与可见结构，但隐藏的导体截面积、材料牌号、额定值、认可范围和电气负载仍需资料或测试确认。

avoidMisidentification.en: Match plug format to the destination region

introVariants.en: Battery cable assemblies carry high DC current between batteries, starters, alternators, disconnects, fuse blocks, busbars and grounded structures. They include positive and negative leads, inter-battery links, ground straps, fused branches, charging leads and service jump connections, each engineered around the actual load and installation.
introVariants.zh: 电池电缆组件用于在电池、起动机、发电机、隔离开关、熔断器座、母排与接地结构之间传输大电流直流电。它覆盖正负极引线、电池间连接、接地带、带熔断分支、充电线与维修搭电线，每一种都必须围绕真实负载和安装条件设计。

introVariants.en: High-current DC exposes every milliohm. Cable resistance, crimp interfaces, bolted joints and ground returns all create voltage drop and heat, especially during starting or charging peaks.
introVariants.zh: 在大电流直流回路中，每一个毫欧都不可忽视。电缆电阻、压接界面、螺栓连接与接地回路都会产生压降和热量，在起动或充电峰值时尤其明显。

text.zh: 按电池端子、极性和各连接段长度配置引线。
text.en: Configure leads for battery terminals, polarity and segment lengths.

text.zh: 运动、负载及电缆重量共同影响固定与端头。
text.en: Coordinate fixing and ends with motion, load and cable weight.

text.zh: 供电与回路路径同时计算压降并安排保护。
text.en: Evaluate supply/return voltage drop and protection together.

title.zh: 发电机启动与辅助回路

text.zh: 启动峰值与连续辅助负载分别定义。
text.en: Define starting peaks separately from continuous auxiliary loads.

text.zh: 电池端与设备端料号、保护和极性成套审核。
text.en: Review battery/equipment parts, protection and polarity together.

text.zh: 保留安装孔距与固定点，同时复核旧线受损原因。
text.en: Retain mounting datums while reviewing the cause of old-lead damage.

title.zh: 电池端子孔径、接头与极性
title.en: Battery lug bore, connector and polarity

text.zh: 端子孔径、接头与极性匹配真实电池接口。
text.en: Match lug bore, connector and polarity to the battery interface.

title.zh: 持续及峰值电流、持续时间

text.zh: 持续和峰值电流分别写明时长与工况。
text.en: Specify duration and conditions separately for continuous and peak current.

title.zh: 熔断、绝缘帽与防磨结构
title.en: Fusing, insulating boots and abrasion protection

text.zh: 熔断、绝缘帽和固定分担短路与机械风险。
text.en: Use fusing, insulating boots and support for electrical and mechanical risks.

value.zh: 端子孔径、接头与极性匹配真实电池接口。

label.en: Continuous/peak current and duration

value.zh: 持续和峰值电流分别写明时长与工况。
value.en: Specify duration and conditions separately for continuous and peak current.

label.en: Cable area, length and voltage-drop target

value.zh: 导体材质、截面与线长形成压降基线。
value.en: Use conductor material, area and length to establish voltage-drop calculations.

value.zh: 熔断、绝缘帽和固定分担短路与机械风险。

label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Provide system voltage, continuous and peak current, peak duration and repetition, cable lengths, battery and equipment interfaces, lug-hole sizes and orientations, ground points, fuse or disconnect arrangement, ambient and conductor temperature, fluids, vibration, routing, quantity and required validation.
value.zh: 请提供系统电压、持续与峰值电流、峰值持续时间及重复频率、线长、电池与设备接口、端子孔径和方向、接地点、熔断或隔离布置、环境与导体温度、液体、振动、走线、数量及所需验证。

label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: Engineering releases the circuit, conductor, lugs, boots, seals, branch protection, labels, routing dimensions and process limits. Production controls strip length, strand condition, crimp tooling and orientation, then verifies continuity, polarity, resistance, dimensions and workmanship; pull, section analysis, voltage-drop, thermal, vibration or environmental checks are added when specified.
value.zh: 工程放行回路、导体、线鼻、护套、密封、分支保护、标识、走线尺寸与工艺限值。生产控制剥线长度、线股状态、压接工具与方向，再检查导通、极性、电阻、尺寸和工艺；需要时增加拉力、截面分析、压降、温升、振动或环境验证。

question.en: Can battery cable size be selected from starter current alone?
question.zh: 电池线径只按起动电流选择可以吗？

answer.en: No. Loop length, allowable voltage drop, peak duration and repetition, continuous charging or auxiliary load, temperature, bundling, conductor construction, termination resistance and protection all affect selection.
answer.zh: 不可以。回路长度、允许压降、峰值持续时间及重复频率、持续充电或辅助负载、温度、成束、导体结构、端接电阻与保护都会影响选择。

question.en: Can you build from an existing battery cable sample?
question.zh: 可以依据现有电池线样品开发吗？

answer.en: Yes, a sample helps confirm length, routing and terminal geometry, but conductor area, material grade, electrical duty, joint specification and validation limits still require customer data or engineering confirmation.
answer.zh: 可以，样品有助于确认长度、走线与端子几何，但导体截面积、材料牌号、电气工况、接点规范与验证限值仍需客户资料或工程确认。

question.en: Is a soldered lug better than a crimped lug?
question.zh: 焊接线鼻一定比压接线鼻好吗？

answer.en: Not inherently. A properly engineered crimp provides a controlled mechanical and electrical interface. Solder can wick into strands and create a stiff transition; either process must be specified and validated for the application.
answer.zh: 不一定。正确工程化的压接能够形成受控机械与电气界面。焊锡可能沿线股渗入并形成硬过渡；无论哪种工艺都必须针对应用明确并验证。

zh: 发电机启动与辅助回路

avoidMisidentification.zh: 峰值启动电流与连续载流不能混用
avoidMisidentification.en: Do not substitute peak starting current for continuous current

avoidMisidentification.zh: 铜铝材质和端子压接需依据BOM
avoidMisidentification.en: Confirm conductor material and lug crimp from the BOM

avoidMisidentification.zh: 正负极防错与金属暴露检查
avoidMisidentification.en: Check polarity prevention and exposed metal

introVariants.en: LED cable assemblies connect drivers, controllers, dimmers, switches, distribution points, light engines, strips and luminaires. The category includes simple two-wire power leads, multi-channel RGB or RGBW harnesses, addressable-light power-and-data assemblies, sealed outdoor branches, automotive relay harnesses and equipment-internal lighting looms.
introVariants.zh: LED 线缆组件用于连接驱动电源、控制器、调光器、开关、分配节点、光源模组、灯带与灯具。这一小类覆盖简单两芯供电线、多通道 RGB 或 RGBW 线束、可寻址灯光的电源与数据组件、户外密封分支、汽车继电器灯光线束及设备内部照明线束。

introVariants.en: Stable light output depends on more than a connector. Supply voltage, load current, cable length, return path, channel assignment, PWM or data behavior, connector contact resistance, polarity, sealing and heat all influence brightness, color consistency and reliability.
introVariants.zh: 稳定出光不只取决于连接器。供电电压、负载电流、线长、回流路径、通道分配、PWM 或数据信号、连接器接触电阻、极性、密封与温度都会影响亮度、色彩一致性和可靠性，因此线缆必须作为完整照明回路的一部分进行设计。

text.zh: 按驱动方式、通道和焊盘或插接端定义接线。
text.en: Define wiring from the driver, channels and pad/connector interface.

text.zh: 长支路应考虑末端压降、分段接续和标签。
text.en: Consider end voltage drop, segmented connections and labels on long branches.

text.zh: 将开关、驱动器与灯组连接纳入完整回路。
text.en: Include switches, drivers and lamps in the complete circuit.

text.zh: 分区长度、通道及末端电压按驱动布局配置。
text.en: Configure zone lengths, channels and end voltage for the driver layout.

text.zh: 接头、接续和灯具入口需作为完整进水路径审核。
text.en: Review connectors, splices and lamp entries as complete ingress paths.

text.zh: 颜色或控制通道与电源公共端的定义保持清晰。
text.en: Keep color/control channel and power-common definitions explicit.

title.zh: LED灯具或灯带型号与供电方式
title.en: LED fixture/strip model and supply method

text.zh: 灯具或灯带的驱动与接口决定起始电路。
text.en: Define the circuit from the fixture/strip driver and interface.

text.zh: 调光、颜色通道与数据回路分别映射。
text.en: Map dimming, color channels and data paths separately.

title.zh: 户内外接头与接续防护

text.zh: 接续及接头按室内、潮湿或户外环境配置。
text.en: Configure splices and connectors for indoor, damp or outdoor conditions.

value.en: Define the circuit from the fixture/strip driver and interface.

value.en: Evaluate end voltage drop using trunk and branch loads.

label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Provide the LED type and load, constant-voltage or constant-current architecture, supply and controller models, pin or channel definition, continuous and peak current, cable lengths, allowable voltage drop, dimming or data protocol, connector and mating details, indoor or outdoor environment, movement, mounting, quantity, labeling and validation requirements.
value.zh: 请提供 LED 类型与负载、恒压或恒流架构、电源与控制器型号、针脚或通道定义、持续与峰值电流、线长、允许压降、调光或数据协议、连接器与对插件资料、室内或户外环境、运动与安装条件、数量、标识及验证要求。

label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: Engineering releases the circuit map, conductor sizes, channel colors, connector keying, branches, seals, labels, routing dimensions and process limits. Production controls stripping, crimping or specified soldering, polarity and sealing, then verifies circuit, shorts, dimensions and workmanship; resistance, voltage-drop, load, thermal, flex, vibration or ingress checks are added when specified.
value.zh: 工程放行回路图、导体尺寸、通道颜色、连接器防错、分支、密封、标签、走线尺寸与工艺限值。生产控制剥线、压接或指定焊接、极性与密封，再检验回路、短路、尺寸和工艺；需要时增加电阻、压降、带载、温升、弯曲、振动或防护验证。

question.en: Can LED wire size be selected from wattage alone?
question.zh: LED 线径只按功率选择可以吗？

answer.en: No. Supply voltage, current per channel, run length, complete return path, allowable drop, connector losses, ambient and local temperature, bundling and duty cycle all affect selection.
answer.zh: 不可以。供电电压、各通道电流、线长、完整回流路径、允许压降、连接器损耗、环境与局部温度、成束及工作循环都会影响选择。

question.en: Can one four-pin connector be used for every RGB system?
question.zh: 四针连接器可以通用于所有 RGB 系统吗？

answer.en: No. Systems can differ in voltage, common-anode or common-cathode arrangement, channel order, current, connector keying and control method. The exact pin map and mating device must be confirmed.
answer.zh: 不可以。系统在电压、共阳或共阴、通道顺序、电流、连接器防错与控制方式上都可能不同，必须确认确切针脚图与对接设备。

question.en: Does an IP67 connector make the whole LED harness IP67?
question.zh: 使用 IP67 连接器就代表整条 LED 线束达到 IP67 吗？

answer.en: No. The complete assembly boundary includes cable entry, wire seals, mating interface, branch transitions, splices, end caps and enclosure entries. The agreed test configuration must cover the finished assembly.
answer.zh: 不代表。完整组件边界还包括线缆入口、单线密封、对插界面、分支过渡、接头、端帽与机箱入口，约定测试配置必须覆盖最终成品。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 恒压与恒流驱动不能按接口互换
avoidMisidentification.en: Do not interchange constant-voltage and constant-current drivers by connector

avoidMisidentification.zh: RGB/RGBW线序以灯具定义为准
avoidMisidentification.en: Use the fixture definition for RGB/RGBW wiring

avoidMisidentification.zh: 灯带和线缆防护等级分别确认
avoidMisidentification.en: Confirm strip and cable ingress protection separately

introVariants.en: LVDS cable assemblies carry high-speed differential data between processors, serializers, displays, cameras and control electronics. This category covers internal display looms, panel links, shielded twisted-pair assemblies and application-specific power/control branches—not one universal screen cable.
introVariants.zh: LVDS 电缆组件用于在处理器、串行器、显示屏、摄像头与控制电子之间传输高速差分数据。这一小类覆盖设备内部屏线、面板连接、屏蔽双绞组件及按项目定义的电源/控制分支，并不是一种通用屏线。

introVariants.en: LVDS is an electrical signaling layer rather than a complete connector or display protocol. Cable geometry, differential impedance, pair balance, termination, connector transitions and grounding must match the actual transmitter, receiver and data format.
introVariants.zh: LVDS 是电气信号层，并不等同于某一种连接器或完整显示协议。线缆几何、差分阻抗、线对平衡、端接、连接器过渡与接地必须匹配实际发送端、接收端及数据格式。

text.zh: 显示面板与主板的通道映射及背光分别确认。
text.en: Confirm panel/board channel mapping separately from backlight circuits.

text.zh: 薄型安装空间需要协调弯曲、固定和接口方向。
text.en: Coordinate bends, fixing and interface direction in thin spaces.

text.zh: 以面板资料和实际主板定义信号及供电。
text.en: Define signals and power from panel documentation and the actual board.

text.zh: 连接器高度、插入方向与差分通道同时匹配。
text.en: Match connector height, insertion direction and differential channels.

text.zh: 同针数面板仍需逐项核对供电与信号排列。
text.en: Check power and signal assignments even for equal-pin-count panels.

text.zh: 短距离折弯、夹持与屏蔽过渡应避免端头受力。
text.en: Avoid termination strain in short bends, clamps and shield transitions.

title.zh: 面板、主板接口与完整针脚表
title.en: Panel/board interfaces and complete pin table

text.zh: 屏端与板端以完整接口型号和针图对应。
text.en: Map panel and board ends by full interface references and pin tables.

text.zh: 差分通道、极性与供电分配分开定义。
text.en: Define differential channels and polarity separately from power assignments.

text.zh: 线对结构、屏蔽和长度按传输路径选配。
text.en: Select pair construction, shielding and length for the transmission path.

value.en: Map panel and board ends by full interface references and pin tables.

value.en: Define differential channels and polarity separately from power assignments.

value.zh: 背光、使能与调光配置遵循面板资料。
value.en: Follow panel documentation for backlight, enable and dimming.

value.zh: 线对结构、屏蔽和长度按传输路径选配。
value.en: Select pair construction, shielding and length for the transmission path.

label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Confirm transmitter and receiver part numbers; connector drawings and pin map; pair count and lane assignment; target differential impedance; data rate and clock; cable length and routing; power/backlight circuits; shield and ground strategy; mechanical movement; sample and validation limits.
value.zh: 需要确认发送端与接收端型号、连接器图纸和针脚表、线对数量与通道分配、目标差分阻抗、数据速率与时钟、线长和走线、电源/背光回路、屏蔽接地策略、机械运动、样品及验证限值。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: After interface and signal requirements are frozen, engineering reviews the interconnect stack, prepares controlled samples, verifies electrical continuity and the agreed high-speed performance, then releases drawings, BOM, tooling and inspection points for repeat production.
value.zh: 接口与信号要求冻结后，工程团队审核完整互连链路，制作受控样品，确认电气导通与约定的高速性能，再放行图纸、BOM、工具和检验点用于重复生产。

question.en: Is every display cable an LVDS cable?
question.zh: 所有显示屏线都是 LVDS 线吗？

answer.en: No. Displays may use LVDS, eDP, MIPI, FPD-Link, GMSL or proprietary parallel/serial interfaces. Connector appearance alone cannot identify the electrical interface.
answer.zh: 不是。显示系统可能使用 LVDS、eDP、MIPI、FPD-Link、GMSL 或专用并行/串行接口，仅凭连接器外观无法判断电气接口。

question.en: Can the cable be built from an old sample?
question.zh: 可以依据旧样品开发吗？

answer.en: A sample helps with connector, length and routing, but data rate, pin map, pair assignment, impedance, termination, shield grounding, power circuits and acceptance limits still require equipment data or engineering confirmation.
answer.zh: 样品有助于确认连接器、长度与走线，但数据速率、针脚表、线对分配、阻抗、端接、屏蔽接地、电源回路与接收限值仍需设备资料或工程确认。

question.en: Does 100-ohm cable guarantee a good LVDS link?
question.zh: 使用 100Ω 线缆就一定能保证 LVDS 链路正常吗？

answer.en: No. Connector and board transitions, pair balance, length, loss, termination, stubs, grounding, crosstalk and the actual transmitter/receiver also affect the complete channel.
answer.zh: 不能。连接器与板端过渡、线对平衡、长度、损耗、端接、支路、接地、串扰及实际收发器都会影响完整通道。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 同针数屏接口可能具有不同供电针位
avoidMisidentification.en: Equal pin count can conceal different power assignments

avoidMisidentification.zh: LVDS与eDP不能按外形归同
avoidMisidentification.en: Do not identify LVDS and eDP as equivalent by shape

avoidMisidentification.zh: 高速线对和背光电源分开核对
avoidMisidentification.en: Check high-speed pairs and backlight power separately

introVariants.en: RF and coaxial cable assemblies carry radio-frequency, microwave, video, timing and antenna signals through a controlled-impedance path. This category includes flexible, low-loss, miniature, semi-rigid, panel-mount and application-specific assemblies—not one universal coax lead.
introVariants.zh: RF 与同轴电缆组件通过受控阻抗路径传输射频、微波、视频、时钟与天线信号。这一小类覆盖柔性、低损耗、微型、半刚性、面板安装及按应用定义的组件，并不是一种通用同轴线。

introVariants.en: Coaxial performance belongs to the whole channel: conductor geometry, dielectric, shield, connector interface, termination, cable length and installed routing. Connector names alone do not define impedance, usable frequency, power, loss or environmental capability.
introVariants.zh: 同轴性能属于整条通道：导体几何、介质、屏蔽、连接器界面、终端、线长与安装路由需要一起定义。仅有连接器名称不能确定阻抗、可用频率、功率、损耗或环境能力。

text.zh: 频段、接头极性及实际安装距离决定同轴选择。
text.en: Select coax for frequency, connector polarity and installation distance.

text.zh: 测量频段、损耗与校准边界需写入验证要求。
text.en: Specify bands, loss and calibration boundaries for validation.

text.zh: 紧凑布线时核对弯曲、屏蔽过渡和接头支撑。
text.en: Check bends, shield transitions and connector support in tight routes.

text.zh: 面板厚度、穿壳接口及接地与射频路径一起定义。
text.en: Define panel thickness, feedthrough and grounding with the RF path.

text.zh: 频繁插拔和携带弯曲需要合适接头支撑。
text.en: Provide connector support for frequent mating and handling bends.

text.zh: 小型接点与软缆选择要对应模块接口和安装半径。
text.en: Match miniature contacts and cable to the module interface and bend radius.

title.zh: 同轴电缆型号、阻抗与频率范围
title.en: Coaxial cable type, impedance and frequency range

text.zh: 同轴型号、阻抗与频率共同确定传输基础。
text.en: Define the transmission basis from coax type, impedance and frequency.

title.zh: 两端连接器系列、性别与反极性
title.en: End connector series, gender and reverse polarity

text.zh: 系列、公母及反极性按中心接点核对。
text.en: Check series, gender and reverse polarity at the center contacts.

title.zh: 压接工具、剥线尺寸与弯曲半径
title.en: Crimp tools, strip dimensions and bend radius

text.zh: 剥线、压接、端头与弯曲配合具体电缆。
text.en: Match stripping, crimping, ends and bend limits to the cable.

label.zh: 同轴电缆型号、阻抗与频率范围
label.en: Coaxial cable type, impedance and frequency range

value.zh: 同轴型号、阻抗与频率共同确定传输基础。
value.en: Define the transmission basis from coax type, impedance and frequency.

label.zh: 两端连接器系列、性别与反极性
label.en: End connector series, gender and reverse polarity

value.zh: 系列、公母及反极性按中心接点核对。
value.en: Check series, gender and reverse polarity at the center contacts.

label.zh: 长度、插损与回损验收条件
label.en: Length, insertion-loss and return-loss conditions

value.zh: 插损、回损与长度写明测量频段和方法。
value.en: Specify measurement bands and methods for loss and length.

label.zh: 压接工具、剥线尺寸与弯曲半径
label.en: Crimp tools, strip dimensions and bend radius

value.zh: 剥线、压接、端头与弯曲配合具体电缆。
value.en: Match stripping, crimping, ends and bend limits to the cable.

label.zh: 电路与版本依据
label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Provide both mating interfaces, standard or reverse polarity, impedance, frequency band, power and DC bias, maximum insertion loss and return-loss/VSWR target, cable length and phase requirement, shielding or PIM requirement, routing and bend radius, panel sealing, environment, quantity and agreed test method.
value.zh: 请提供两端对接界面、标准或反极性、阻抗、频段、功率与直流偏置、最大插入损耗和回波损耗/VSWR 目标、线长与相位要求、屏蔽或 PIM 要求、走线与弯曲半径、面板密封、环境、数量及约定测试方法。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: Engineering first freezes the channel definition and mechanical envelope, then builds controlled samples. Released production can include connector gauging, visual and dimensional inspection, continuity and the RF measurements explicitly agreed for the project; limits and fixtures are recorded with the result.
value.zh: 工程团队先冻结通道定义与机械包络，再制作受控样品。放行生产可包括连接器量规、外观与尺寸、导通，以及项目明确约定的 RF 测量；限值与夹具与结果一同记录。

question.en: Can an RF cable be selected from connector photos?
question.zh: 可以只凭连接器照片选择 RF 电缆吗？

answer.en: No. Photos help identify a family, but exact interface, gender, polarity, impedance, frequency, cable type, length and environment still require drawings, part numbers or equipment data.
answer.zh: 不可以。照片只有助于识别系列，精确界面、性别、极性、阻抗、频率、线缆类型、长度与环境仍需图纸、型号或设备资料。

question.en: What is the difference between 50-ohm and 75-ohm coax?
question.zh: 50Ω 与 75Ω 同轴线有什么区别？

answer.en: They use different conductor and dielectric geometry and serve different systems. Fifty ohms is common in RF and test equipment; 75 ohms is common in video and broadcast. The cable and both interfaces must match the equipment impedance.
answer.zh: 它们使用不同导体与介质几何，服务于不同系统。50Ω 常见于 RF 与测试设备，75Ω 常见于视频与广播；线缆和两端界面都必须匹配设备阻抗。

question.en: Does a higher-frequency connector guarantee the complete cable rating?
question.zh: 使用更高频率连接器就能保证整条电缆频率吗？

answer.en: No. The usable assembly band is limited by the cable, both connectors, termination quality, transitions, length, routing and acceptance limits. The complete assembly must be reviewed and, where required, measured.
answer.zh: 不能。组件可用频段受线缆、两端连接器、端接质量、过渡、长度、路由与接收限值共同限制，需要审核完整组件，必要时进行测量。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 50欧与75欧不可凭接头外形混用
avoidMisidentification.en: Do not mix 50-ohm and 75-ohm systems by connector shape

avoidMisidentification.zh: SMA与反极性SMA需查看中心接点
avoidMisidentification.en: Check center contacts for SMA and reverse-polarity SMA

avoidMisidentification.zh: 射频性能需组件测试或经确认依据
avoidMisidentification.en: RF performance requires assembly tests or approved evidence

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。
contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: Aerospace project cable assemblies connect avionics, sensors, actuators, power distribution, communication equipment and ground-support interfaces. This is a project-defined family spanning aircraft, unmanned systems, test rigs and spacecraft-related equipment—not a claim that one generic harness is flight-qualified.
introVariants.zh: 航空航天项目电缆组件用于连接航电设备、传感器、执行器、配电、通信设备与地面保障接口。这是覆盖飞机、无人系统、试验台及航天相关设备的项目定义类别，并不表示某一种通用线束天然具备飞行资格。

introVariants.en: The assembly is governed by the released drawing and flowed-down requirements. Electrical load, signal integrity, mass, routing, derating, vibration, temperature, pressure, fluids, flammability, outgassing, shielding, workmanship and traceability can all change the construction.
introVariants.zh: 组件应以放行图纸和逐级下达的要求为准。电气负载、信号完整性、重量、走线、降额、振动、温度、压力、液体、阻燃、放气、屏蔽、工艺与追溯都可能改变其结构。

text.zh: 按客户批准图纸配置材料、接口与安装路径。
text.en: Configure materials, interfaces and routes to customer-approved drawings.

text.zh: 接点、锁止、屏蔽和质量约束作为一套结构审核。
text.en: Review contacts, locking, shielding and mass limits as one structure.

text.zh: 测试连接与装机组件分别定义用途和文件范围。
text.en: Define the purpose and documents separately for test and installed assemblies.

text.zh: 信号、屏蔽和固定按客户受控接口资料定义。
text.en: Define signals, shields and fixing from controlled customer interface data.

text.zh: 台架验证用途与装机认可范围需分别记录。
text.en: Record bench-test use separately from installed-approval scope.

text.zh: 版本、材料替代和客户放行需保留一致对应。
text.en: Keep revisions, substitutions and customer release aligned.

title.zh: 项目图纸、适用规范与版本
title.en: Project drawing, applicable specifications and revision

text.zh: 图纸、项目规范和批准版本决定设计边界。
text.en: Use drawings, project specifications and approved revisions to define scope.

title.zh: 连接器、线缆及材料批准清单
title.en: Approved connector, cable and material list

text.zh: 连接器、线材及替代权限按批准BOM管理。
text.en: Control connectors, wire and substitution permission through the approved BOM.

title.zh: 检验、追溯与客户放行要求
title.en: Inspection, traceability and customer release requirements

text.zh: 文件、检验和客户放行按项目范围约定。
text.en: Agree documents, inspection and customer release for the project scope.

value.en: Control connectors, wire and substitution permission through the approved BOM.

value.zh: 屏蔽、质量与安装约束结合设备区域处理。
value.en: Address shielding, mass and installation limits for the equipment zone.

value.zh: 文件、检验和客户放行按项目范围约定。
value.en: Agree documents, inspection and customer release for the project scope.

value.en: Provide the platform and installation zone, applicable drawing and revision, mating connector part numbers, circuit and shield schedule, voltage/current/signal data, wire and component specifications, length and branch datum, mass or space limits, environmental profile, workmanship standard, prohibited processes, inspection hold points, serialization and acceptance test plan.
value.zh: 请提供平台与安装区域、适用图纸及版本、对插件型号、回路与屏蔽表、电压/电流/信号数据、线材和器件规范、长度与分支基准、重量或空间限制、环境谱、工艺标准、禁用工艺、检验停点、序列化和验收测试计划。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: We review aerospace-related work project by project. Materials, personnel or process approvals, special tooling, samples, qualification evidence and customer source inspection are agreed before production.
value.zh: 航空航天相关工作按项目逐项审核。材料、人员或工艺批准、专用工具、样品、鉴定证据与客户源检要求需在生产前约定。

question.en: Does this page mean Super Smile is an approved flight-hardware supplier?
question.zh: 这个页面是否表示超斯迈尔已经是获批飞行硬件供应商？

answer.en: No. The page describes a category available for project review. Customer, platform, quality-system, personnel, process and part approvals must be defined and completed before any flight-use claim.
answer.zh: 不是。本页面说明该类别可进入项目审核。客户、平台、质量体系、人员、工艺与零件批准必须另行定义和完成，之后才能作出任何飞行用途声明。

question.en: Can you build from an existing aerospace harness sample?
question.zh: 可以依据现有航空线束样品开发吗？

answer.en: A sample supports dimensional and interface study, but it cannot reveal all conductor specifications, derating, shield topology, prohibited materials, hidden splices or qualification history. Approved drawings and engineering confirmation remain necessary.
answer.zh: 样品有助于尺寸与接口研究，但不能揭示全部导体规范、降额、屏蔽拓扑、禁用材料、隐藏接续或鉴定历史，仍需批准图纸与工程确认。

question.en: Are MIL-DTL-38999-style connectors enough to make a harness aerospace grade?
question.zh: 使用类似 MIL-DTL-38999 的连接器就足以称为航空级线束吗？

answer.en: No. Connector approval, exact part number and source are only part of the system. Wire, accessories, routing, workmanship, documentation, testing and platform approval also apply.
answer.zh: 不足。连接器批准、准确型号与来源只是系统的一部分；线材、附件、走线、工艺、文件、测试与平台批准同样适用。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 航空用途描述不等于适航或体系批准
avoidMisidentification.en: An aerospace description does not establish airworthiness or system approval

avoidMisidentification.zh: 材料文件必须对应供应批次和具体料号
avoidMisidentification.en: Material documents must match the supply batch and exact part

avoidMisidentification.zh: 设计权责与第三方测试范围先确定
avoidMisidentification.en: Agree design responsibility and third-party testing scope first

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。
contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: Medical equipment cable assemblies connect sensors, patient-monitoring accessories, diagnostic instruments, therapy equipment, laboratory systems and internal electronics. The category includes many electrical and mechanical constructions; suitability is defined by the device manufacturer, intended use and released specification—not by a generic ‘medical cable’ label.
introVariants.zh: 医疗设备电缆组件用于连接传感器、患者监护附件、诊断仪器、治疗设备、实验室系统与设备内部电子部件。该小类包含多种电气和机械结构；是否适用应由设备制造商、预期用途与放行规范共同确定，而不能仅凭“医疗线缆”这一通用名称判断。

introVariants.en: A cable can carry low-level physiological signals, digital data, power, pneumatic tubing or several functions in one hybrid assembly. Patient proximity, applied-part classification, cleaning chemistry, flexing, connector touch-proofing, EMC, leakage-current paths and service life can change the design.
introVariants.zh: 一根组件可能传输低电平生理信号、数字数据、电源、气路，或在混合结构中同时承担多种功能。患者接近程度、应用部分分类、清洁化学品、弯折、连接器防触电、EMC、漏电流路径与使用寿命都会改变设计。

text.zh: 按设备隔离、信号和固定要求定义内部组件。
text.en: Define internal assemblies for device isolation, signals and fixing.

text.zh: 设备端、电极或传感器端及接触边界分别明确。
text.en: Define device, electrode/sensor ends and contact boundaries separately.

text.zh: 材料与结构需结合清洁介质和使用循环验证。
text.en: Evaluate materials and construction for cleaning media and use cycles.

text.zh: 固定、插拔及清洁边界结合机壳与操作者使用方式。
text.en: Define fixing, mating and cleaning boundaries for enclosure and operator use.

text.zh: 辅助供电与测量回路按设备隔离要求分开处理。
text.en: Separate auxiliary power and measurement paths to device isolation requirements.

text.zh: 替换设计需保留设备型号、材料和验收条件。
text.en: Preserve device model, materials and acceptance conditions in replacement designs.

title.zh: 医疗设备用途与患者接触边界

text.zh: 先划分设备内部、外部和患者接触边界。
text.en: Separate internal, external and patient-contact boundaries first.

title.zh: 接口、电路隔离与供电要求
title.en: Interfaces, circuit isolation and power requirements

text.zh: 接口、隔离与供电服从医疗设备设计定义。
text.en: Follow the device design for interfaces, isolation and power.

title.zh: 生物相容或设备标准所需证据

text.zh: 材料与生物相容证据对应实际接触范围。
text.en: Match material and biocompatibility evidence to the actual contact scope.

value.zh: 先划分设备内部、外部和患者接触边界。
value.en: Separate internal, external and patient-contact boundaries first.

label.en: Interfaces, circuit isolation and power requirements

value.zh: 接口、隔离与供电服从医疗设备设计定义。
value.en: Follow the device design for interfaces, isolation and power.

label.zh: 清洁消毒方式及材料接触时间
label.en: Cleaning/disinfection method and material exposure time

value.zh: 清洁、消毒或灭菌需记录介质、时间和循环。
value.en: Record media, duration and cycles for cleaning, disinfection or sterilization.

label.zh: 生物相容或设备标准所需证据
label.en: Required biocompatibility or device-standard evidence

value.zh: 材料与生物相容证据对应实际接触范围。
value.en: Match material and biocompatibility evidence to the actual contact scope.

label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Provide the device and intended-use description, patient-contact boundary, mating interfaces and keying, circuit and shield schedule, signal levels and bandwidth, voltage/current, cable geometry, cleaning or disinfection method, flex and pull duty, environmental limits, material restrictions, labeling, traceability, sample quantity and the approved verification plan.
value.zh: 请提供设备与预期用途说明、患者接触边界、对插接口与防错方式、回路和屏蔽表、信号电平与带宽、电压/电流、线缆几何、清洁或消毒方法、弯折与拉力工况、环境限值、材料限制、标签、追溯、样品数量及批准的验证计划。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.zh: 按确认图纸制作样品，检查安装、针脚、材料与约定验证项目。患者接触、清洁及整机批准按设备项目分别确认。
value.en: Build samples to the confirmed drawing and check fit, pin mapping, materials and agreed tests. Patient contact, cleaning and device approval are defined separately within the device project.

question.en: Does ‘medical cable’ mean the assembly is already approved for patient use?
question.zh: “医疗线缆”是否表示组件已经获批用于患者？

answer.en: No. It describes an application category. Intended use, patient-contact boundary, device risk controls, materials, manufacturing records and verification must be defined by the legal manufacturer and applicable regulatory route.
answer.zh: 不是。它只是应用类别。预期用途、患者接触边界、器械风险控制、材料、制造记录与验证必须由法定制造商和适用法规路径确定。

question.en: Can you make ECG, SpO₂ or temperature lead sets from a sample?
question.zh: 可以依据样品制作 ECG、SpO₂ 或体温导联吗？

answer.en: A sample supports interface and dimensional study, but device model, pinout, signal requirements, electrode or sensor interface, materials, cleaning method and acceptance criteria still require written confirmation.
answer.zh: 样品可支持接口与尺寸研究，但设备型号、针脚、信号要求、电极或传感器接口、材料、清洁方法与验收准则仍需书面确认。

question.en: Which jacket material is best for reusable medical cables?
question.zh: 可重复使用医疗线缆最适合哪种护套？

answer.en: There is no universal answer. Flex, abrasion, skin proximity, disinfectant chemistry, temperature, sterilization or cleaning cycle, color and processing all matter. Candidate materials are screened, then evaluated in the finished construction.
answer.zh: 没有统一答案。弯折、耐磨、皮肤接近、消毒剂化学、温度、灭菌或清洁循环、颜色与加工都需考虑。候选材料先筛选，再在成品结构中评价。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 设备内部线不自动具有患者接触适用性
avoidMisidentification.en: Internal device wiring is not automatically suitable for patient contact

avoidMisidentification.zh: 可擦拭、可消毒与可灭菌是不同要求
avoidMisidentification.en: Wipe cleaning, disinfection and sterilization are different requirements

avoidMisidentification.zh: 医疗外观不证明医疗认证
avoidMisidentification.en: Medical appearance does not establish medical certification

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。
contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: Military-spec project cable assemblies connect power, controls, sensors, communications and mission equipment in ground, naval, airborne and deployable systems. The term describes a controlled requirement set—not a universal quality grade.
introVariants.zh: 军规项目电缆组件用于连接地面、舰载、机载及可部署系统中的电源、控制、传感器、通信与任务设备。“军规”代表一套受控要求，而不是通用质量等级；每个项目都必须明确组件准确型号、批准来源、工艺、环境、检验与接收证据。

introVariants.en: A military drawing may invoke one or many specifications covering connectors, wire, contacts, accessories, identification, workmanship, environmental methods or documentation. A component that conforms to one specification does not make the complete assembly qualified.
introVariants.zh: 军用图纸可能同时引用连接器、线材、触点、附件、标识、工艺、环境方法或文件管理等多项规范。某个元件符合一项规范，并不代表整套组件已经合格；适用范围、版本、等级、分规范、配置与鉴定状态必须结合审核。

text.zh: 依据项目规范及批准BOM定义可供制造的配置。
text.en: Define manufacturable configurations from project specifications and approved BOMs.

text.zh: 屏蔽、接地和接口锁止配合设备安装要求。
text.en: Match shielding, grounding and locking to equipment installation.

text.zh: 样件用途、检验范围和后续版本需清晰区分。
text.en: Distinguish sample use, inspection scope and later revisions.

text.zh: 布线与环境条件需依据具体项目文件，不按外观认定资格。
text.en: Use project documents for routing/environment, without inferring qualification from appearance.

text.zh: 接点、信号和屏蔽端接与批准配置对应。
text.en: Match contacts, signals and shield termination to the approved configuration.

text.zh: 测试连接的使用边界与正式装机组件分别说明。
text.en: Distinguish service-test boundaries from installed assemblies.

title.en: Customer military drawing and specification revision

text.zh: 适用图纸与军规版本以客户项目文件为准。
text.en: Use customer project documents for drawings and specification revisions.

title.zh: 批准材料、连接器与替代权限

text.zh: 批准材料、接头和替代权限逐项对应。
text.en: Map approved materials, connectors and substitution permissions.

title.zh: 批次追溯、报告与质量文件要求
title.en: Lot traceability, reports and quality-document requirements

text.zh: 批次、报告与质量文件按约定范围追溯。
text.en: Trace lots, reports and quality documents within the agreed scope.

value.en: Create an acceptance plan with environmental conditions and criteria.

value.zh: 批次、报告与质量文件按约定范围追溯。
value.en: Trace lots, reports and quality documents within the agreed scope.

label.zh: 电路与版本依据
label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Provide platform and installation zone, drawing and revision, contract data requirements, exact connector and accessory PINs, approved manufacturer or QPL constraints, circuit and shield schedule, current and signal characteristics, environmental profiles, routing and support, maintenance concept, marking, traceability, lot size, source inspection and required acceptance or qualification procedures.
value.zh: 请提供平台与安装区域、图纸及版本、合同数据要求、连接器与附件准确型号、批准制造商或 QPL 限制、回路与屏蔽表、电流和信号特性、环境谱、走线与支撑、维修方案、标识、追溯、批量、源检及所需验收或鉴定程序。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: Military-related projects are accepted only after capability, information-control, sourcing and compliance review. We can manufacture samples and controlled production assemblies to an agreed technical data package.
value.zh: 军规相关项目仅在完成能力、信息控制、采购来源与合规审核后承接。我们可依据约定技术数据包制作样品与受控量产组件；除非准确产品、适用范围与当前证据能够支持，否则不会宣称零件已取得军用鉴定、平台批准或列入 QPL。

question.en: Does ‘military-spec’ mean the complete assembly is qualified?
question.zh: “军规”是否表示整套组件已经获得鉴定？

answer.en: No. Qualification applies to the exact product, specification, class, source and scope supported by current evidence. A project assembly must separately satisfy its drawing, contract, workmanship, inspection and platform approval requirements.
answer.zh: 不是。鉴定只适用于当前证据覆盖的准确产品、规范、等级、来源与范围。项目组件仍需单独满足图纸、合同、工艺、检验和平台批准要求。

question.en: Can you build with MIL-DTL-38999 connectors?
question.zh: 可以使用 MIL-DTL-38999 连接器制作吗？

answer.en: Projects using this family can be reviewed when the exact series, class, slash-sheet PIN, insert, contact, keying, backshell, mating half and approved-source requirement are supplied. The connector name alone is not enough.
answer.zh: 在提供准确系列、等级、分规范型号、孔位、触点、键位、尾罩、对插件与批准来源要求后，可进行项目审核；只有连接器名称还不够。

question.en: Can an existing sample be reverse engineered?
question.zh: 可以依据现有样品进行开发吗？

answer.en: A sample supports dimensions and interface study, but it may not reveal wire designation, derating, shield topology, hidden splices, sealing materials, approved sources or qualification history. Released engineering data and authority are still required.
answer.zh: 样品有助于尺寸和接口研究，但可能无法揭示线材牌号、降额、屏蔽拓扑、隐藏接续、密封材料、批准来源或鉴定历史，仍需放行工程资料与授权。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 军绿色或军规接口不等于认证产品
avoidMisidentification.en: Military colors or interfaces do not establish qualification

avoidMisidentification.zh: 供应商器件认证不能自动转移到组件
avoidMisidentification.en: Component qualification does not automatically transfer to the assembly

avoidMisidentification.zh: 任何试验声明需对应实际范围和报告
avoidMisidentification.en: Test claims must match the actual scope and report

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。
contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: Solar cable assemblies carry DC power between PV modules, string circuits, combiner equipment, inverters and project-specific interfaces. The category includes extension leads, module leads, branch harnesses, flying leads and pre-terminated runs; voltage, current, cable family, connector identity, route and environmental exposure must be defined together.
introVariants.zh: 太阳能电缆组件用于在光伏组件、组串、汇流设备、逆变器及项目接口之间传输直流电力。该小类覆盖延长线、组件引线、分支线束、飞线与预端接线路；系统电压、电流、线材体系、连接器身份、走线路径和环境暴露必须一并定义。

introVariants.en: PV cable and PV connector standards address different products and scopes. IEC 62930 covers specified single-core cross-linked PV cables up to 1.5 kV DC, while IEC 62852 addresses connectors for DC photovoltaic circuits.
introVariants.zh: 光伏线材与光伏连接器标准分别覆盖不同产品和范围。IEC 62930 涵盖规定的 1.5 kV DC 及以下单芯交联光伏电缆，IEC 62852 则针对光伏直流回路连接器。

text.zh: 两端接口来源及极性按准确件号确认。
text.en: Confirm interface sources and polarity from exact part numbers.

text.zh: 支路负载、线长与保护器件一起定义。
text.en: Define branch loads, lengths and protection together.

text.zh: 逆变或辅助设备接口需遵循设备文件。
text.en: Follow equipment documents for inverter or auxiliary interfaces.

text.zh: 温度、日照、磨擦与固定点需对应实际路线。
text.en: Match temperature, sunlight, abrasion and fixing to the actual route.

text.zh: 接口来源与电气路径逐项核对，不能只看壳体相似。
text.en: Verify interface source and circuitry beyond similar housings.

text.zh: 操作、绝缘保护与测试用途按系统程序定义。
text.en: Define handling, insulation protection and test use from system procedures.

title.zh: 组件、电缆与光伏接口完整料号
title.en: Module, cable and PV connector part numbers

text.zh: 组件、电缆和接口完整料号成套核对。
text.en: Check complete module, cable and connector part numbers together.

title.zh: 系统直流电压、电流与极性
title.en: System DC voltage, current and polarity

text.zh: 直流电压、电流、极性与分支负载分别定义。
text.en: Define DC voltage, current, polarity and branch loads separately.

text.en: Use specified tooling, crimp and mating requirements for assembly.

value.en: Provide the module, inverter or combiner interfaces; exact connector manufacturer and part numbers; maximum system voltage; string open-circuit voltage at the design minimum temperature; operating and fault current; conductor size and cable designation; route, length and voltage-drop target; installation zone; branch and protection arrangement; quantity; labels; packaging; and required inspection or test method.
value.zh: 请提供组件、逆变器或汇流设备接口；连接器制造商与准确型号；最大系统电压；设计最低温度下的组串开路电压；工作及故障电流；导体截面积与线材牌号；走线、长度和压降目标；安装区域；分支与保护方案；数量；标签；包装以及所需检验或测试方法。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: We review the released electrical architecture and component compatibility before sampling. Custom length, color, marking, branch geometry and equipment-side termination can then be frozen in a drawing and bill of materials.
value.zh: 打样前先审核已放行的电气架构与元件兼容性，再把定制长度、颜色、标识、分支几何和设备端端接冻结到图纸与物料表。只有当准确材料、组件配置与当前证据均覆盖时，才对认证、防护、阻燃、耐候或寿命作出相应声明。

question.en: Is every black double-insulated cable suitable for PV use?
question.zh: 所有黑色双层绝缘电缆都适合光伏使用吗？

answer.en: No. Cable suitability depends on its complete designation, voltage, conductor construction, materials, certification or listing scope, temperature, sunlight and wet-location properties, flame behavior and the intended installation rules. Appearance alone is not evidence.
answer.zh: 不是。线材适用性取决于完整牌号、电压、导体结构、材料、认证或列名范围、温度、耐日光与潮湿特性、阻燃表现及预期安装规则，外观本身不是证据。

question.en: Can two ‘MC4-compatible’ connectors from different brands be mated?
question.zh: 两个不同品牌的“兼容 MC4”连接器可以直接混插吗？

answer.en: Cross-mating is accepted only when the exact connector combination is authorized and supported by applicable certification, listing or engineering evidence. Similar appearance and nominal dimensions are insufficient.
answer.zh: 只有准确连接器组合获得授权，并有适用认证、列名或工程证据支持时才可接受混插；外观相似与名义尺寸相近并不充分。

question.en: What determines solar extension-cable length and conductor size?
question.zh: 太阳能延长线的长度和截面积如何确定？

answer.en: Use the complete positive and negative route, operating and fault current, ambient and grouping derating, connector limits, protection, allowable voltage drop, mechanical route and applicable installation rules. A catalog current number alone is not enough.
answer.zh: 需要结合正负极完整路径、工作及故障电流、环境与成束降额、连接器限值、保护、允许压降、机械走线和适用安装规则，不能只看目录中的单一电流数字。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 外形相似的光伏接头不得默认混插
avoidMisidentification.en: Do not assume cross-mating of similar PV connectors

avoidMisidentification.zh: 连接器与线缆直流额定分别确认
avoidMisidentification.en: Confirm connector and cable DC ratings separately

avoidMisidentification.zh: 户外或太阳能名称不能证明认证
avoidMisidentification.en: Outdoor or solar labels do not establish certification

contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

name.zh: 工业以太网与RJ45电缆组件

introVariants.en: Industrial Ethernet and RJ45 cable assemblies link PLCs, remote I/O, switches, vision equipment and service ports. We build RJ45 patch leads, M12 D/X-to-RJ45 transitions, panel extensions and equipment tails to a specified pair map, shield plan, route and acceptance target.
introVariants.zh: 工业以太网与 RJ45 电缆组件连接 PLC、远程 I/O、工业交换机、视觉设备与维护端口。可按指定线对映射、屏蔽方案、走线路径及验收目标，制作 RJ45 引线、M12 D/X 编码转 RJ45、面板延长线和设备尾线。

introVariants.en: The link is a complete transmission path, not two identical plugs on a length of cable. Pair count and assignment, cable category, conductor construction, shield termination, connector design, installation route and agreed test limit must work together.
introVariants.zh: 这类组件是一条完整的传输路径，不是在线材两端装上外形相同的插头。线对数量与分配、线缆等级、导体结构、屏蔽端接、连接器设计、安装路径和约定测试限值必须协同。

text.zh: 速率、协议及屏蔽接地按网络架构配置。
text.en: Configure rate, protocol and shielding for the network architecture.

text.zh: 接续与面板接口同时纳入信道验证范围。
text.en: Include joints and panel interfaces in channel validation.

text.zh: 数据传输与供电热条件分别审核。
text.en: Review data transmission separately from power thermal conditions.

text.zh: 采用运动安装时需另行确认线缆动态条件。
text.en: Confirm cable dynamic-duty conditions separately for moving installation.

text.zh: 目标速率、设备接口和可用信道长度共同定义。
text.en: Define target rate, interfaces and usable channel length together.

text.zh: 面板跳接和中间接点需纳入完整链路审核。
text.en: Include panel patching and intermediate contacts in the link review.

title.en: Ethernet speed, category and application protocol

text.zh: 接口、速率、类别和协议写明各自范围。
text.en: Define interface, speed, category and protocol scopes separately.

title.en: RJ45 wiring, shielding and straight/crossover map

text.zh: 直通、交叉、线对顺序与屏蔽路径按系统确认。
text.en: Confirm straight/crossover wiring, pair order and shield path for the system.

text.en: Use the applicable patch-cord, permanent-link or channel test method.

value.en: Use the applicable patch-cord, permanent-link or channel test method.

label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Send the network protocol and target data rate, exact device ports and connector part numbers, two- or four-pair requirement, pin map, cable category and length, fixed or moving route, shield and bonding plan, PoE load where relevant, oil/temperature/washdown exposure, exit direction, labels, quantity and required verification or certification limit.
value.zh: 请提供网络协议与目标速率、设备端口及连接器准确型号、两对或四对线要求、针脚表、线缆等级与长度、固定或运动走线、屏蔽及接地方案、相关 PoE 负载、油污/温度/冲洗环境、出线方向、标签、数量，以及所需线序核查或等级认证限值。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: We review the drawing, sample or interface schedule before selecting a cable and termination system. The approved sample should freeze both ends, pair map, length datum, shield handling, boot or overmold geometry, marking and acceptance method.
value.zh: 选线与确定端接体系前，先审核图纸、样品或接口表。批准样品应冻结两端接口、线对映射、长度基准、屏蔽处理、护套或包覆成型几何、标识与验收方法。

question.en: Can an RJ45-looking plug guarantee Gigabit Ethernet?
question.zh: 外形像 RJ45 的插头就能保证千兆以太网吗？

answer.en: No. The complete cable and connector construction, active pairs, pin map, length and measured link performance matter. Agree the required data rate and test limit before production.
answer.zh: 不能。完整线材与连接器结构、有效线对、针脚映射、长度和实测链路性能都有关。生产前应约定目标速率与测试限值。

question.en: Can M12 D-coded and X-coded connectors be swapped?
question.zh: M12 D 编码与 X 编码能互换吗？

answer.en: No. Their mating geometry and intended pair arrangements differ. Select the exact device-side coding and release the mapping to the modular side.
answer.zh: 不能。两者对插几何和预期线对布局不同，应确认设备端准确编码，并放行到模块化接口一侧的映射。

question.en: Does a shielded cable need a shielded plug?
question.zh: 用了屏蔽线就一定需要屏蔽插头吗？

answer.en: That depends on the system bonding and EMC design. If a continuous screened path is specified, the plug, shell and termination must support it; a shielded jacket alone cannot establish continuity.
answer.zh: 取决于系统接地与电磁兼容方案。若要求连续屏蔽路径，插头、外壳和端接必须共同支持；只有屏蔽线材不能形成完整路径。

name.zh: 复合动力与数据电缆组件

introVariants.en: Hybrid power and data cable assemblies bring separately defined supply and data elements through one purpose-made cable structure, then split them to the specified equipment interfaces.
introVariants.zh: 复合动力与数据电缆组件在一款专门制造的线缆结构内布置已分别定义的供电和数据单元，再按设备接口要求进行端部分支。

introVariants.en: Core groups, conductor section, insulation, pair geometry, shielding and jacket must be checked against the exact cable data sheet. A shared sheath does not itself prove electrical separation, channel performance or motion life.
introVariants.zh: 芯线分组、导体截面、绝缘、线对几何、屏蔽和外护套须对照准确的线缆数据表审核。共护套本身不能证明电气隔离、通道性能或运动寿命。

text.zh: 动力和信号的分区、屏蔽及端接需要协同。
text.en: Coordinate power/signal allocation, shielding and termination.

text.zh: 在有限接口空间中按通道配置接点与护套。
text.en: Allocate contacts and jackets by channel within limited interface space.

text.zh: 可拆模块的供电、通信和安装边界一起定义。
text.en: Define power, communication and mounting boundaries for removable modules.

text.zh: 接点分区、面板开孔和尾部空间共同定义。
text.en: Define contact allocation, cutout and rear clearance together.

text.zh: 共护套结构需对应弯曲、扭转和固定条件。
text.en: Match the shared-jacket construction to bends, torsion and fixing.

text.zh: 为动力与数据分别定义测量接入和验收边界。
text.en: Define measurement access and acceptance boundaries separately for power/data.

text.zh: 按动力、数据和辅助功能划分通道。
text.en: Allocate channels by power, data and auxiliary functions.

title.zh: 混合接点额定与绝缘间隔
title.en: Hybrid contact ratings and insulation spacing

text.zh: 混合接点与绝缘间隔结合电流和电压评估。

introVariants.en: Switch cable assemblies join a specified switch, its contacts and an equipment-side interface as one installable unit. Pushbutton, rocker, toggle, snap-action and limit-switch leads vary by operating form, load and installation geometry.
introVariants.zh: 开关电缆组件把指定开关、触点与设备侧接口组合成可安装单元。按钮、摇臂、拨动、微动及限位开关引线，会随动作方式、负载与安装几何而变化。

introVariants.en: Contact logic must be read from the exact switch data sheet and approved circuit. COM, NO and NC identify different paths in the unoperated state; illuminated switches may add a separate lamp circuit.
introVariants.zh: 触点逻辑必须依据准确的开关数据表与已批准回路判读。COM、NO、NC 代表未动作状态下不同的路径；带灯开关还可能具有独立的指示灯回路。

text.zh: 常开常闭、保持或复位动作与设备逻辑匹配。

text.zh: 灯具或电机负载的浪涌影响端接和保护。

text.zh: 开关动作、线长与操作环境需对应实际控制逻辑。

introVariants.en: Oil and gas equipment cable assemblies connect specified sensors, valves, pumps and control interfaces where fluid exposure, routing and maintenance conditions need close review. The assembly is defined by the actual equipment and installed zone, not by an industry label alone.
introVariants.zh: 油气设备电缆组件连接指定传感器、阀门、泵和控制接口，需细致审核液体暴露、布线路径与维护工况。组件由实际设备及安装区域定义，不能只凭行业名称选型。

introVariants.en: Oil and chemical resistance depends on the named fluid, concentration, temperature, exposure time and cable material. Connector seals, glands and jacket transitions must be reviewed as an installed system.
introVariants.zh: 耐油与耐化学性能取决于具体介质、浓度、温度、暴露时间及线材。连接器密封、格兰头和护套过渡须按安装后的整体结构审核。

introVariants.en: Automotive diagnostic and OBD harnesses connect a vehicle diagnostic link connector to scan tools, vehicle communication interfaces, data loggers, telematics devices, test fixtures and service adapters. The category includes short extensions, right-angle leads, Y splitters, legacy-vehicle adapters, DB-style interfaces, RJ45 or USB-side assemblies and custom equipment tails; connector shape alone does not define pinout, protocol, power path or intended duty.
introVariants.zh: 汽车诊断与 OBD 线束用于连接车辆诊断接口与诊断仪、车辆通信接口、数据记录器、车联网设备、测试工装及维修转接器。该小类覆盖短延长线、直角引线、Y 型分支、老车型转接线、DB 接口、RJ45 或 USB 设备端组件及定制设备尾线；连接器外形本身不能定义针脚、协议、供电路径或预期工况。

introVariants.en: SAE J1962 and ISO 15031-3 define requirements for the standardized diagnostic connection between the vehicle and external test equipment, including connector design, contact allocation and related electrical circuits. The standardized shell can carry different physical layers and manufacturer-discretionary circuits.
introVariants.zh: SAE J1962 与 ISO 15031-3 规定车辆与外部测试设备之间标准化诊断连接的要求，包括连接器设计、触点分配及相关电路。相同标准外壳中可能承载不同物理层和制造商自定义回路，因此线束必须保持已放行的针脚映射、屏蔽、线对结构、接地、供电能力与设备端接口，而不能只把外形匹配的壳体连在一起。

text.zh: 准确车型、工具与任务共同决定接线配置。
text.en: Use the exact vehicle, tool and task to define wiring.

text.zh: 分支长度、供电与网络影响需同时审核。
text.en: Review stub length, power and network effects together.

text.zh: 延长位置应保留插接空间并避免干扰车辆操作。
text.en: Preserve mating clearance without interfering with vehicle operation.

text.zh: 取电位置、保护和车辆休眠影响应在项目中核对。
text.en: Review power pickup, protection and vehicle-sleep effects in the project.

text.zh: DB9、RJ45等端口的针脚必须依据准确工具。
text.en: Use the exact tool for DB9, RJ45 or other port pin assignments.

text.zh: 台架供电和模拟负载与实车使用边界分别说明。
text.en: Define bench power/simulation separately from vehicle-use boundaries.

question.en: Does every 16-pin OBD connector have the same wiring?
question.zh: 所有 16 针 OBD 接口的线路都一样吗？

answer.en: No. The standardized connector defines controlled functions and leaves some contacts for manufacturer discretion. Vehicle generation, market, protocol and target task still determine the released pin map.
answer.zh: 不一样。标准化接口定义受控功能，同时保留部分制造商自定义触点；车辆代际、市场、协议和目标任务仍决定最终针脚表。

question.en: Can you make a full 16-core male-to-female extension?
question.zh: 可以制作全针 16 芯公对母延长线吗？

answer.en: Yes, after confirming connector type, orientation, all pin-to-pin circuits, conductor sizes, length, exit direction and intended use. A fully populated extension can also pass manufacturer-specific circuits, so the application still matters.
answer.zh: 可以，但需确认连接器类型、方向、全部针对针回路、导体截面积、长度、出线与用途。全针延长线也会传递制造商自定义回路，因此仍需明确应用。

question.en: Will an OBD-to-DB9 or OBD-to-RJ45 cable work with any tool?
question.zh: OBD 转 DB9 或 OBD 转 RJ45 线能兼容任何设备吗？

answer.en: No. DB9 and RJ45 describe connector families, not a universal diagnostic contact assignment. The exact tool model and approved device-side pinout are required.
answer.zh: 不能。DB9 与 RJ45 只是连接器家族，并不代表通用诊断针脚；必须提供准确设备型号和批准的设备端针脚。

avoidMisidentification.zh: OBD接口不保证全部协议或车型支持
avoidMisidentification.en: An OBD interface does not guarantee all protocols or vehicles

avoidMisidentification.en: Passive adaptation cannot convert protocols

avoidMisidentification.en: Validate function with the specified vehicle and tool

introVariants.en: ECU and DCU service harnesses provide controlled access between electronic control units, domain or distribution controllers, vehicle networks, power supplies, sensors, actuators, bench fixtures and diagnostic equipment. The category covers repair pigtails, breakout harnesses, Y interfaces, programming leads, controller adapters, test looms and project-specific replacement assemblies.
introVariants.zh: ECU 与 DCU 维修线束用于在电子控制单元、域控制器或配电控制器、车载网络、电源、传感器、执行器、台架工装与诊断设备之间建立受控连接。该小类覆盖维修尾线、测试引出线束、Y 型接口、编程引线、控制器转接线、台架测试线束及项目专用替换组件。

introVariants.en: An ECU or DCU connector can combine battery and ignition feeds, grounds, regulated sensor supplies, analogue and digital inputs, low-side or high-side outputs, communication buses, shields and reserved circuits. Connector identity is only the first layer.
introVariants.zh: 一个 ECU 或 DCU 连接器可能同时包含蓄电池与点火供电、接地、稳压传感器电源、模拟与数字输入、高边或低边输出、通信总线、屏蔽及预留回路。连接器身份只是第一层；放行线束还必须保持孔位编号、端子体系、线径、线对结构、接续拓扑、保护、密封、分支位置以及每个连接负载的电气限值。

text.zh: 电源、唤醒、通信及保护采用明确控制器资料。
text.en: Use controller documents for power, wake, communication and protection.

text.zh: 在目标维修位置定义接口、支路和操作空间。
text.en: Define interfaces, branches and handling space at the service location.

text.zh: 测试接入边界需要保持原回路行为清晰。
text.en: Define measurement access while preserving the intended circuit behavior.

text.zh: 接口版本变化需要同步更新针图和测试要求。
text.en: Update pin maps and tests with interface revisions.

text.zh: 线缆适配与编程、标定或安全权限分别确认。
text.en: Confirm cable fit separately from programming, calibration or security access.

text.zh: 供电限流、极性和操作顺序按控制器要求定义。
text.en: Define current limiting, polarity and handling sequence for the controller.

title.en: Full ECU/DCU model and hardware revision

text.zh: ECU/DCU型号及硬件版本决定接口基线。
text.en: Use ECU/DCU model and hardware revision as the interface baseline.

title.zh: 台架或车上维修接线模式
title.en: Bench or in-vehicle service wiring mode

text.zh: 台架、车上或开发访问采用不同连接范围。
text.en: Use separate connection scopes for bench, vehicle and development access.

title.zh: 工具接口、通信路径与限流保护
title.en: Tool interface, communication paths and current limiting

text.zh: 工具通信与限流保护结合目标任务确认。
text.en: Confirm tool communication and current limiting for the task.

label.en: Full ECU/DCU model and hardware revision

value.en: Use separate connection scopes for bench, vehicle and development access.

label.en: Power, wake, ignition and ground pins

value.zh: 供电、唤醒、点火和地按控制器资料接线。
value.en: Wire power, wake, ignition and ground from controller documentation.

label.zh: 工具接口、通信路径与限流保护
label.en: Tool interface, communication paths and current limiting

value.zh: 工具通信与限流保护结合目标任务确认。
value.en: Confirm tool communication and current limiting for the task.

label.zh: 电路与版本依据
label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Provide controller manufacturer and exact part number; vehicle or equipment platform and model year; connector housings, terminals, seals and backshells; mating-face views; released pin schedule; supply voltage and load current; network type; sensors and actuators; branch and splice drawing; installation zone; length datums; protection; quantity; labels; and the required bench, vehicle or environmental validation.
value.zh: 请提供控制器制造商与准确型号；车辆或设备平台及年份；连接器壳体、端子、密封与尾壳；对插面视图；已放行针脚表；供电电压和负载电流；网络类型；传感器与执行器；分支和接续图；安装区域；长度基准；保护方案；数量；标签以及所需台架、实车或环境验证。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: We translate approved interface data into a controlled drawing, bill of materials, circuit table and test program. Samples are checked for connector fit, keying, wire and seal compatibility, pin mapping, dimensions and the agreed electrical functions before repeat production.
value.zh: 我们把批准的接口资料转化为受控图纸、物料表、回路表与测试程序。样品在重复生产前核对连接器匹配、防错、线材与密封相容、针脚映射、尺寸及约定电气功能。

question.en: Is an ECU or DCU harness defined by the connector housing?
question.zh: ECU 或 DCU 线束可以只按连接器壳体定义吗？

answer.en: No. The exact controller, cavity schedule, terminal and seal system, wire specifications, branches, loads, network topology, protection and mounting zone define the assembly.
answer.zh: 不能。准确控制器、孔位表、端子与密封体系、线材规格、分支、负载、网络拓扑、保护与安装区域共同定义组件。

question.en: Can you build from an existing damaged sample?
question.zh: 可以依据损坏的现有样品制作吗？

answer.en: A sample can support geometry and connector identification, but hidden splices, materials, shielding and earlier repairs require independent confirmation. Electrical data and the intended function are still needed.
answer.zh: 样品有助于确认几何与连接器，但隐藏接续、材料、屏蔽和既往维修仍需独立确认，同时仍需电气资料与预期功能。

question.en: Can a Y harness keep the ECU connected while measurements are taken?
question.zh: Y 型线束可以在保持 ECU 连接时进行测量吗？

answer.en: Yes, when the branch topology, stub length, instrument loading, shielding, exposed-point protection and connected-state test method are approved for the target circuits.
answer.zh: 可以，但需针对目标回路批准分支拓扑、支线长度、仪器负载、屏蔽、裸露测点保护与连接状态测试方法。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 维修接线与完整车辆功能并不等同
avoidMisidentification.en: Service wiring is not equivalent to full vehicle operation

avoidMisidentification.zh: 错误供电或唤醒可能损伤控制器
avoidMisidentification.en: Incorrect power or wake wiring can damage a controller

avoidMisidentification.zh: 刷写支持取决于工具和软件权限
avoidMisidentification.en: Programming support depends on tools and software permissions

contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: J1939 heavy-duty harnesses connect service tools, telematics devices, data loggers, displays, gateways and vehicle controllers to the communication and power interfaces used across trucks, buses, trailers, construction machines, agricultural equipment and vehicle-derived stationary systems.
introVariants.zh: J1939 重卡线束用于把维修工具、车联网设备、数据记录器、显示终端、网关和车辆控制器连接到卡车、客车、挂车、工程机械、农业设备及车辆衍生固定设备的通信与供电接口。

introVariants.en: J1939 is a family of SAE documents for heavy-duty vehicle networking, not the name of one universal cable. A released assembly must identify the applicable connector, keying, populated cavities, network channel, bit rate, power path, shielding or twisted-pair construction, topology, device-side interface and operating environment.
introVariants.zh: J1939 是面向重型车辆网络的一组 SAE 文件体系，而不是某一种通用线缆的名称。可放行组件必须明确适用连接器、防错键位、已装孔位、网络通道、速率、供电路径、屏蔽或双绞结构、拓扑、设备端接口及使用环境。

text.zh: 接口版本与工具侧针图一起确认。
text.en: Confirm interface version together with the tool-side pin map.

text.zh: 分支引出、设备负载与终端配置放入拓扑。
text.en: Include stubs, device loading and termination in the topology.

text.zh: 记录端供电与CAN路径分开定义。
text.en: Define logger power separately from CAN paths.

text.zh: 平台接口、支路及环境按具体网络确认。
text.en: Confirm interfaces, stubs and environment for the particular network.

text.zh: 网络路径与泥水、振动等安装条件一起审核。
text.en: Review network paths with mud/water, vibration and installation.

text.zh: 保留准确接头键位和网络边界，避免复制未知终端。
text.en: Preserve keying/network boundaries without copying unknown termination.

title.en: Vehicle/equipment platform and J1939 interface version

text.zh: 先确定平台、接口版本与目标网络。
text.en: Identify platform, interface version and target network.

text.zh: 颜色、键位与针图组合识别接头。
text.en: Identify connectors from color, keying and pin maps together.

title.en: Supply voltage, ground and shield grounding

text.zh: 设备供电、信号地与屏蔽路径分开定义。
text.en: Define device power, signal ground and shielding separately.

label.en: Vehicle/equipment platform and J1939 interface version

value.en: Identify platform, interface version and target network.

label.en: 9-pin or other interface coding and pin table

value.zh: 颜色、键位与针图组合识别接头。
value.en: Identify connectors from color, keying and pin maps together.

label.en: CAN trunk, stub lengths and termination

value.zh: 主干、支路与终端纳入网络拓扑审核。
value.en: Review trunk, stubs and termination within the network topology.

label.zh: 电源电压、地与屏蔽接地
label.en: Supply voltage, ground and shield grounding

value.zh: 设备供电、信号地与屏蔽路径分开定义。
value.en: Define device power, signal ground and shielding separately.

label.zh: 电路与版本依据
label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Provide the vehicle or equipment maker, model and year; engine and controller identifiers; connector color and mating-face photographs; released pin map; required network channel and speed; tool or device interface; whether the lead is for diagnostics, logging, telematics or permanent installation; cable length and branch datums; sealing, abrasion, temperature and chemical exposure; quantity; labels; and the required electrical and communication checks.
value.zh: 请提供车辆或设备制造商、型号与年份；发动机及控制器信息；连接器颜色和对插面照片；已批准针脚表；所需网络通道与速率；工具或设备端接口；诊断、记录、车联网或永久安装用途；线长与分支基准；密封、磨损、温度及化学暴露；数量、标签以及所需电气和通信检查。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: We convert approved interface and network information into controlled drawings, connector and terminal BOMs, cable definitions, branch dimensions, molding or backshell requirements, identification and test programs. Production checks can verify construction and pin mapping; live J1939 communication requires the specified vehicle, controller, simulator or approved network fixture and an agreed functional scope.
value.zh: 我们把批准的接口和网络资料转化为受控图纸、连接器与端子物料表、线缆定义、分支尺寸、包胶或尾壳要求、标识与测试程序。生产检查可以核实结构和针脚映射；实际 J1939 通信仍需指定车辆、控制器、模拟器或批准的网络工装，并明确功能验证范围。

question.en: Does every nine-pin heavy-duty connector provide the same J1939 access?
question.zh: 所有九针重型车辆接口都提供相同 J1939 访问吗？

answer.en: No. Keying, connector generation, populated cavities, power arrangement and available network channels can differ. The exact equipment and released pin definition must be checked.
answer.zh: 不是。防错、连接器代次、装针、供电安排和可用网络通道都可能不同，必须核对准确设备与放行针脚定义。

question.en: What is the difference between black Type 1 and green Type 2 interfaces?
question.zh: 黑色 Type 1 与绿色 Type 2 接口有什么区别？

answer.en: They use different keying associated with different J1939 physical-layer generations. A color observation supports identification but does not replace confirmation of the vehicle network, speed and actual pin population.
answer.zh: 两者使用与不同 J1939 物理层代次相关的防错结构。颜色观察有助于识别，但不能替代对车辆网络、速率和实际装针的确认。

question.en: Can one splitter support a diagnostic tool and telematics unit at the same time?
question.zh: 一根分支线可以同时连接诊断仪和车联网设备吗？

answer.en: Sometimes, but only after reviewing branch length, device loading, termination, traffic, power draw, ground paths and the vehicle's permitted connected state.
answer.zh: 有时可以，但必须审核支线长度、设备负载、终端、通信流量、取电、接地路径及车辆允许的连接状态。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 9针接头颜色和键位需实际核对
avoidMisidentification.en: Verify 9-pin connector color and keying

avoidMisidentification.zh: 电缆接口不证明数据速率或工具支持
avoidMisidentification.en: Cable interfaces do not establish data rate or tool support

avoidMisidentification.zh: 终端电阻位置需按网络拓扑确认
avoidMisidentification.en: Confirm termination positions against the network topology
