introVariants.en: Truck harnesses distribute power, ground, lighting, control and network circuits through the cab, powertrain, chassis and rear equipment of light-, medium- and heavy-duty commercial vehicles. The category covers complete vehicle looms as well as cab, chassis, engine, transmission, lighting, power-distribution, body-builder and trailer-interface sub-harnesses.
introVariants.zh: 卡车线束把电源、接地、照明、控制与网络回路分配到轻型、中型及重型商用车的驾驶室、动力总成、底盘和车尾设备。该小类既覆盖整车主线束，也覆盖驾驶室、底盘、发动机、变速器、照明、配电、上装及挂车接口等分线束。

introVariants.en: A truck harness is a vehicle architecture rather than a generic bundle of wires. Cab and chassis zones have different exposure, service access and mechanical movement.
introVariants.zh: 卡车线束是一套车辆电气架构，而不是通用导线的捆扎。驾驶室与底盘区域的暴露、维修可达性和机械运动各不相同，因此每条放行支路都要关联回路功能、负载、保护、连接器体系、路径、固定间距、弯曲余量、接续位置、环境分区与验证方法。

text.zh: 按配置版本组织显示、操作与维修分支。
text.en: Organize display, control and service branches by configuration.

text.zh: 道路飞溅、运动及长距离回路共同影响防护。
text.en: Coordinate protection for road spray, motion and long circuits.

text.zh: 发动机和变速器区域按局部热与液体选材。
text.en: Select materials for local heat and fluids near engine/transmission.

text.zh: 拖挂或上装负载及连接边界分别定义。
text.en: Define trailer/body loads and connection boundaries separately.

text.zh: 取电、回路保护和接地按准确车辆图规划。
text.en: Plan power pickup, protection and grounds from vehicle drawings.

text.zh: 原件版本和损伤区域需与新配置区分。
text.en: Distinguish the original revision and damaged areas from the new configuration.

label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Provide vehicle maker, platform, model year and cab or wheelbase configuration; system voltage; equipment and controller part numbers; circuit and pin tables; load current and protection; connector BOM; zone and routing photographs; branch datums; clips, grommets and coverings; articulation or service loops; body-builder and trailer interfaces; labels; quantity; and the required electrical, mechanical or environmental checks.
value.zh: 请提供车辆制造商、平台、年份及驾驶室或轴距配置；系统电压；设备与控制器型号；回路与针脚表；负载电流及保护；连接器物料表；分区和走线照片；分支基准；卡扣、护圈与覆盖层；铰接或维修余量；上装与挂车接口；标签、数量以及所需电气、机械或环境检查。

label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: We convert approved vehicle information into controlled drawings, circuit schedules, connector and terminal BOMs, splice maps, route dimensions, covering instructions, labels and test programs. Sample fit is reviewed on the specified vehicle or fixture before repeat production.
value.zh: 我们把批准的车辆资料转化为受控图纸、回路表、连接器与端子物料表、接续图、走线尺寸、覆盖工艺、标签及测试程序。重复生产前在指定车辆或工装上审核样品装配；导通与工艺检查确认线束制造结果，完整整车行为仍属于系统级验证，除非项目明确包含准确车辆、负载与验收计划。

question.en: Is truck harness one standard product?
question.zh: 卡车线束是一种标准产品吗？

answer.en: No. It is a broad category that includes many complete and zone-specific assemblies. Vehicle platform, year, wheelbase, cab, powertrain, installed options and body equipment determine the released configuration.
answer.zh: 不是。它是包含整车线束与多种区域分线束的大类，车辆平台、年份、轴距、驾驶室、动力总成、选装与上装共同决定放行配置。

question.en: Can a harness be copied from an existing sample?
question.zh: 可以按照现有样品复制线束吗？

answer.en: A sample is useful for geometry, connector and circuit tracing, but hidden materials, damaged areas, field repairs, option content and electrical intent still need documentation or controlled validation.
answer.zh: 样品有助于还原几何、连接器和回路，但隐藏材料、损伤区域、现场维修、选装内容与电气意图仍需文件或受控验证。

question.en: Can 12 V and 24 V truck harnesses use the same design?
question.zh: 12 V 与 24 V 卡车线束可以共用同一设计吗？

answer.en: Not by assumption. Load current, device rating, fuse strategy, wire size, relay or controller behavior, connector limits and voltage-drop budget must be reviewed for the actual system.
answer.zh: 不能直接假设。必须针对实际系统审核负载电流、设备额定值、保险策略、线径、继电器或控制器行为、连接器限制与压降预算。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 相似车型不同年款可能采用不同针序
avoidMisidentification.en: Similar truck models can use different wiring by year

avoidMisidentification.zh: 外部料号需与客户原件交叉确认
avoidMisidentification.en: Cross-check external part numbers with the customer's original part

avoidMisidentification.zh: 底盘活动和维修拆卸空间需验证
avoidMisidentification.en: Validate chassis motion and service removal clearance

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。

introVariants.en: Construction vehicle harnesses distribute power, control, sensor and communication circuits across excavators, loaders, cranes, bulldozers, graders, compactors, aerial platforms and other self-propelled work machines. The category includes complete machine looms and cab, engine, chassis, boom, hydraulic-control, lighting and attachment sub-harnesses.
introVariants.zh: 工程车辆线束为挖掘机、装载机、起重机、推土机、平地机、压路机、高空作业平台及其他自行式作业机械分配电源、控制、传感与通信回路。该小类覆盖整机主线束以及驾驶室、发动机、底盘、臂架、液压控制、照明与属具分线束。

introVariants.en: Off-road machines combine mobile-vehicle wiring with industrial actuators, hydraulic systems and exposed articulation. Harness design must follow the actual machine zone, movement envelope, duty cycle and service method.
introVariants.zh: 非道路机械把移动车辆布线、工业执行器、液压系统与裸露铰接结构结合在一起。线束设计必须服从实际机器分区、运动包络、工作循环与维修方式；单靠连接器密封无法弥补错误走线、无支撑重量、积水、分支过硬或端子与线封组合不匹配。

text.zh: 阀组、传感器和驱动回路按设备图分配。
text.en: Allocate valve, sensor and drive circuits from machine drawings.

text.zh: 手柄、显示与开关支路兼顾维护接近性。
text.en: Keep joystick, display and switch branches serviceable.

text.zh: 按完整行程安排余量、夹持和防磨。
text.en: Provide slack, clamps and abrasion protection for full travel.

text.zh: 天线、数据及供电采用各自接口定义。
text.en: Use separate interface definitions for antennas, data and power.

text.zh: 电流、保护与发动机周边热区一起审核。
text.en: Review current, protection and engine thermal zones together.

text.zh: 按设备序列和原样件恢复尺寸，再核对电路。
text.en: Recover dimensions by serial range/sample and verify circuits separately.

question.en: Is a construction vehicle harness a single standard loom?
question.zh: 工程车辆线束是一根标准线束吗？

answer.en: No. It is a broad family covering complete machines and many cab, engine, chassis, boom, valve, lighting, attachment and service assemblies. Platform, serial range and options determine the released version.
answer.zh: 不是。它是覆盖整机以及驾驶室、发动机、底盘、臂架、阀组、照明、属具与维修组件的广泛家族，平台、序列号范围与选装决定放行版本。

question.en: Can the same harness be used on an excavator and loader?
question.zh: 挖掘机与装载机可以共用同一线束吗？

answer.en: Only if their approved interfaces, circuits, loads, movement, environment and geometry are actually identical. Similar controllers or connectors do not establish interchangeability.
answer.zh: 只有当批准接口、回路、负载、运动、环境与几何确实相同时才可能共用；相似控制器或连接器不能证明互换。

question.en: What must be checked at a boom or articulation point?
question.zh: 臂架或铰接点必须检查什么？

answer.en: Fixed and moving ends, full travel, twist, bend radius, support spacing, unsupported mass, rub points, hydraulic-hose interaction and service positions should all be reviewed.
answer.zh: 需要审核固定端与运动端、完整行程、扭转、弯曲半径、支撑间距、无支撑重量、摩擦点、与液压管相互作用及维修位置。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 同机型序列段变更需核对
avoidMisidentification.en: Check changes across machine serial ranges

avoidMisidentification.zh: 液压软管与线束磨擦路径分开安排
avoidMisidentification.en: Separate harness routing from hydraulic-hose abrasion

avoidMisidentification.zh: 维修接口与运行接口不得混淆
avoidMisidentification.en: Distinguish service interfaces from operating interfaces

introVariants.en: Trailer harnesses connect the towing vehicle with semi-trailers, utility trailers, equipment carriers, dump trailers, campers, boat trailers and agricultural trailers. The category includes front interface leads, complete chassis looms, lighting branches, brake and ABS/EBS circuits, axle leads, breakaway and battery circuits, liftgate or hydraulic power branches, reefer connections and rear-door assemblies.
introVariants.zh: 拖车线束连接牵引车与半挂车、通用拖车、设备运输拖车、自卸拖车、露营拖车、船用拖车及农业拖车。该小类覆盖前端连接线、完整底盘主线束、灯光分支、制动与 ABS/EBS 回路、车轴引线、脱离制动与蓄电池回路、尾板或液压动力分支、冷藏机组连接及后门组件。

introVariants.en: A trailer harness is not one universal cable. Connector family, regional interface, system voltage, circuit count, trailer length, axle and brake architecture, installed equipment and exposure determine the released design.
introVariants.zh: 拖车线束不是一根通用电缆。连接器家族、地区接口、系统电压、回路数量、拖车长度、车轴与制动架构、安装设备及暴露环境共同决定放行设计。

text.zh: 按地区制式和牵引车回路区分灯光功能。
text.en: Separate lighting functions by regional format and tow-vehicle circuits.

text.zh: 制动、传感器及运动空间分别定义。
text.en: Define braking, sensors and motion clearance separately.

text.zh: 充电、尾板或设备负载需要各自保护预算。
text.en: Give charging, liftgate and equipment loads separate protection budgets.

text.zh: 余量和防磨按打开、关闭与滑动全过程安排。
text.en: Provide slack and protection through opening, closing and sliding travel.

text.zh: 辅助负载及控制回路需要独立供电预算。
text.en: Give auxiliary loads and controls their own power budgets.

text.zh: 地区制式、工具和实际针序共同确定接口。
text.en: Define interfaces from regional format, tools and actual pinout.

question.en: Is a trailer harness a universal product?
question.zh: 拖车线束是通用产品吗？

answer.en: No. It is a broad family of tow-interface, chassis, lighting, brake, axle, auxiliary and equipment harnesses. Market, connector, voltage, trailer geometry, loads and installed options determine the released version.
answer.zh: 不是。它是由牵引接口、底盘、灯光、制动、车轴、辅助与设备线束组成的广泛家族，市场、连接器、电压、拖车几何、负载与安装选项共同决定放行版本。

question.en: Can two seven-pin trailer plugs use the same pinout?
question.zh: 两个七针拖车插头一定使用相同针脚定义吗？

answer.en: Not by assumption. Seven-position interfaces can belong to different standards and vehicle classes. Mating family, viewing direction, pin assignment, voltage, current and circuit function must be verified.
answer.zh: 不能直接假设。七位接口可能属于不同标准与车辆级别，必须核对对插家族、视图方向、针脚定义、电压、电流与回路功能。

question.en: Does a sealed connector make the complete harness waterproof?
question.zh: 使用密封连接器就能让整根线束防水吗？

answer.en: No. Housing, terminal, seal, cavity plug, mating part, cable exit, splice construction, covering, drainage, routing and assembly quality must work together under a defined exposure and test condition.
answer.zh: 不能。壳体、端子、线封、堵头、对插件、出线、接续结构、覆盖层、排水、走线与装配质量必须在规定暴露和测试条件下共同工作。

avoidMisidentification.en: 7- or 13-pin format does not establish regional wiring

avoidMisidentification.zh: 制动灯转向共线或分线需确认
avoidMisidentification.en: Confirm combined or separate brake/turn circuits

avoidMisidentification.zh: 无源转接不补充不存在的制动控制功能
avoidMisidentification.en: Passive adapters do not add missing brake-control functions

introVariants.en: Vehicle lighting harnesses distribute protected power, grounds and control signals to headlamps, daytime running lamps, fog lamps, front and rear combination lamps, side markers, licence lamps, interior lamps, work lamps and illuminated accessories. The category includes lamp pigtails, front-end and rear-body sub-harnesses, relay-and-fuse looms, LED driver leads, tailgate and door branches, test adapters and complete lighting kits.
introVariants.zh: 汽车灯线束向前照灯、日间行车灯、雾灯、前后组合灯、侧标志灯、牌照灯、车内灯、工作灯与发光附件分配受保护的电源、接地和控制信号。该小类覆盖灯具尾线、前端与后车身分线束、继电器保险线束、LED 驱动引线、尾门与车门分支、测试转接线及完整灯光套件。

introVariants.en: A lighting harness is not defined by a bulb socket alone. Lamp technology, optical function, circuit current, switching method, body controller, diagnostics, connector keying, route, thermal zone, sealing and destination-market requirements determine the released assembly.
introVariants.zh: 汽车灯线束不能只凭灯泡插座定义。灯具技术、光学功能、回路电流、开关方式、车身控制器、诊断、连接器防错、走线、热区、密封与目标市场要求共同决定放行组件。

text.zh: 左右侧与功能回路按灯具定义布置。
text.en: Arrange side and functional circuits from the lamp definition.

text.zh: 负载、开关和继电器纳入完整供电路径。
text.en: Include loads, switches and relays in the full supply path.

text.zh: 车门、尾门或保险杠走线兼顾固定与拆装。
text.en: Coordinate fixing and service access on doors, tailgates or bumpers.

text.zh: 接口老化或损伤位置与原灯具针图共同审核。
text.en: Review aged/damaged interfaces with the original lamp pinout.

text.zh: PWM、总线或直接开关由设备文件区别。
text.en: Distinguish PWM, bus and direct switching from device documents.

text.zh: 接头固定、拆装和道路暴露作为一套布线条件。
text.en: Treat fixing, service and road exposure as one routing condition.

question.en: Is a vehicle lighting harness a universal product?
question.zh: 汽车灯线束是通用产品吗？

answer.en: No. It is a broad family of lamp pigtails, front and rear sub-harnesses, protected power looms, control leads and complete kits. Vehicle, market, lamp technology, pinout, load, controller and route determine the released version.
answer.zh: 不是。它是灯具尾线、前后分线束、受保护电源线束、控制引线与完整套件组成的广泛家族，车辆、市场、灯具技术、针脚、负载、控制器与走线共同决定放行版本。

question.en: Can a matching lamp connector prove compatibility?
question.zh: 灯具连接器能插合就能证明兼容吗？

answer.en: No. Connector keying does not prove pin assignment, terminal rating, ground strategy, lamp load, PWM, diagnostics or LIN compatibility. These must be verified against the actual lamp and vehicle system.
answer.zh: 不能。连接器防错不能证明针脚定义、端子额定值、接地策略、灯具负载、PWM、诊断或 LIN 兼容性，必须结合真实灯具与车辆系统核对。

question.en: Can you build harnesses for halogen, HID and LED lamps?
question.zh: 可以制作卤素、HID 与 LED 灯线束吗？

answer.en: Yes, when lamp, ballast or driver data and the vehicle control architecture are defined. Their current, heat, switching and diagnostic behaviour differ, so the same wire and relay assumptions do not apply to every technology.
answer.zh: 可以，但需要明确灯具、镇流器或驱动器资料及车辆控制架构。不同技术的电流、热、开关和诊断行为不同，不能全部套用同一线径与继电器假设。

avoidMisidentification.zh: LED替换不保证车机监测兼容
avoidMisidentification.en: LED replacement does not guarantee vehicle-monitoring compatibility

avoidMisidentification.zh: 灯具与线束防护分别核对
avoidMisidentification.en: Review lamp and harness protection separately

avoidMisidentification.zh: 灯色与线色不能替代针脚定义
avoidMisidentification.en: Lamp or wire color cannot replace pin assignments

introVariants.en: Engine harnesses connect the ECU, protected power distribution, sensors, injectors, ignition components, throttle and air controls, pumps, valves, aftertreatment devices and the vehicle-side interface around the power unit. The category includes compact on-engine looms, engine-bay sub-harnesses, injector and ignition branches, sensor leads, transmission and aftertreatment branches, generator-set harnesses and complete engine-to-body assemblies.
introVariants.zh: 发动机线束连接 ECU、受保护配电、传感器、喷油器、点火部件、节气门与进气控制、泵、阀、后处理设备以及动力单元周边的车身侧接口。该小类覆盖紧凑型发动机本体线束、发动机舱分线束、喷油与点火分支、传感器引线、变速箱与后处理分支、发电机组线束及完整发动机到车身组件。

introVariants.en: An engine harness is a coordinated power, signal, communication and mechanical routing system, not a bundle copied from connector appearance. Engine family, controller, sensor and actuator set, firing order, transmission, emissions equipment, system voltage, thermal map, vibration, fluids, service route and vehicle interface determine the released design.
introVariants.zh: 发动机线束是一套协调供电、信号、通信与机械走线的系统，不能依据连接器外观简单复制。发动机家族、控制器、传感器与执行器组合、点火顺序、变速箱、排放设备、系统电压、热分布、振动、油液、维修路径和整车接口共同决定放行设计。

text.zh: 参考地、信号与电磁环境采用独立审核。
text.en: Review reference ground, signals and electromagnetic exposure separately.

text.zh: 缸序、驱动形式及热区共同决定接线。
text.en: Use firing order, drive type and thermal zones to define wiring.

text.zh: 断开点配合装配、维修及相对运动。
text.en: Coordinate disconnects with assembly, service and relative motion.

text.zh: 传感器、执行器及高温路线按系统资料区分。
text.en: Separate sensors, actuators and hot routes from system documentation.

text.zh: 台架任务、供电和测试端口与装车版本分别记录。
text.en: Record bench tasks, power and test ports separately from installed versions.

text.zh: 不能仅复制旧件尺寸，还需核对损伤及电路定义。
text.en: Review damage and circuit definitions in addition to copying old dimensions.

question.en: Is an engine harness a universal product?
question.zh: 发动机线束是通用产品吗？

answer.en: No. It is a broad family of on-engine, injector, ignition, sensor, aftertreatment, transmission and body-interface assemblies. Engine, controller, emissions equipment, vehicle configuration and route determine the released version.
answer.zh: 不是。它是发动机本体、喷油、点火、传感、后处理、变速箱及车身接口组件组成的广泛家族，发动机、控制器、排放设备、车辆配置与走线共同决定放行版本。

question.en: Can a matching connector prove that two engine harnesses are compatible?
question.zh: 连接器能插合就能证明两根发动机线束兼容吗？

answer.en: No. Keying does not prove pin assignment, terminal rating, cylinder order, reference ground, shielding, communication, load current or controller compatibility. These must be verified against the actual system.
answer.zh: 不能。防错不能证明针脚定义、端子额定值、气缸顺序、参考接地、屏蔽、通信、负载电流或控制器兼容性，必须结合真实系统核对。

question.en: Can you build gasoline, diesel and industrial engine harnesses?
question.zh: 可以制作汽油机、柴油机和工业发动机线束吗？

answer.en: Yes, when the engine, controller, circuit information, interfaces, environment and validation requirements are defined. Each project is reviewed for its actual fuel system, ignition or injection, aftertreatment, voltage and equipment duty.
answer.zh: 可以，但需要明确发动机、控制器、回路信息、接口、环境和验证要求。每个项目都按真实燃油系统、点火或喷射、后处理、电压与设备任务审核。

avoidMisidentification.en: Match connectors and protection materials to thermal zones

introVariants.en: Custom relay and fuse-box harnesses connect protected power feeds, switching circuits and vehicle loads in a serviceable assembly.
introVariants.zh: 继电器与保险丝盒线束连接受保护馈线、开关控制回路与车辆负载，组成便于安装和维护的配电组件。

introVariants.en: Fuse selection, contact duty, conductor capacity, coil suppression and enclosure temperature must be coordinated.
introVariants.zh: 熔断器、触点任务、导体容量、线圈抑制与盒内温度需要协调设计。

text.zh: 导体、保险丝和负载以回路方式配合。
text.en: Coordinate conductors, fuses and loads as circuits.

text.zh: 线圈驱动与开关触点分别定义针脚。
text.en: Define coil-drive pins separately from switched contacts.

text.zh: 附件负载与整车取电位置共同审核。
text.en: Review accessory loads with the vehicle power-takeoff location.

text.zh: 灯具浪涌与继电器触点、熔断曲线协调。
text.en: Coordinate lamp inrush with relay contacts and fuse curves.

text.zh: 触点开断与线圈抑制采用准确器件方案。
text.en: Use defined component schemes for switching and coil suppression.

text.zh: 保险座、端子和线径应匹配原保护设计。
text.en: Match holders, contacts and wire range to the protection design.

question.en: Can you build both a relay pigtail and a complete fuse-box harness?
question.zh: 能制作继电器尾线和完整保险丝盒线束吗？

answer.en: Yes. The scope can include a pre-wired socket, fused single branch, dual-relay kit or multi-circuit distribution assembly. Drawings, load data, interfaces and installation requirements define the build.
answer.zh: 可以，范围可包括预接插座、带熔断单路分支、双继电器套件或多回路配电组件，具体结构由图纸、负载资料、接口与安装要求定义。

question.en: Can the same assembly work on 12 V and 24 V?
question.zh: 同一组件可以同时用于 12 V 和 24 V 吗？

answer.en: Only when every affected component and operating condition supports both systems. Relay coil voltage, suppression, fuse voltage rating, electronics and load behavior require explicit review.
answer.zh: 只有相关元件与工况均支持两种系统时才可以，继电器线圈电压、抑制器件、熔断器额定电压、电子部件与负载行为都需明确审核。

question.en: Does a larger fuse solve repeated fuse failures?
question.zh: 反复烧保险丝可以直接换更大的吗？

answer.en: Not without reviewing the fault, load, conductor and holder. A larger fuse can leave a smaller branch inadequately protected. Investigate shorts, overload, inrush, poor contact and thermal conditions first.
answer.zh: 不能未经审核直接加大规格，更大保险丝可能使小线径分支保护不足。应先检查短路、过载、浪涌、接触不良和热条件。

question.en: Are permanent battery leads and jumper cables the same?
question.zh: 永久安装的电瓶线与救援跨接线一样吗？

answer.en: No. Mounting, insulation, terminations and operating duty differ. A temporary clamp connection is not a substitute for a released permanent installation.
answer.zh: 不一样。固定、绝缘、端接和工作周期不同，临时夹钳连接不能替代已确认的永久安装方案。

question.en: Can current capacity be selected from AWG alone?
question.zh: 只看 AWG 就能确定载流能力吗？

answer.en: No. Review conductor material and area, length, ambient temperature, bundling, voltage drop, connections and the continuous or intermittent duty.
answer.zh: 不能。还需核对导体材料与截面、长度、环境温度、成束状态、压降、连接点以及连续或间歇工作要求。

question.en: Can you match a drawing or existing cable?
question.zh: 可以按图纸或现有样品定制吗？

answer.en: Yes. Provide dimensions, terminal references, polarity, installation photographs, electrical duty, quantity and required inspection. A sample establishes geometry but not every hidden requirement.
answer.zh: 可以。请提供尺寸、端子资料、极性、安装照片、电气工况、数量及检验要求。样品能提供几何参考，但不包含全部隐藏要求。

value.en: High-voltage projects require engineering and validation review before quotation.
value.zh: 高压项目报价前需完成工程与验证条件审核，本页不是带电维修操作指南。

value.zh: 生产放行前确认物料来源、工装、图纸、样件及验证范围。

question.en: Does orange insulation prove an 800 V rating?
question.zh: 橙色绝缘就代表可以用于 800 V 吗？

answer.en: No. Identification color is separate from voltage rating. Confirm the cable and connector variants, insulation coordination and the project's verification requirements.
answer.zh: 不是。识别颜色与额定电压是不同概念，需要确认线材和接头变型、绝缘配合及项目验证要求。

question.en: Can the same harness serve every EV platform?
question.zh: 同一套线束可以适配所有电动车平台吗？

answer.en: No. Current duty, interfaces, control functions, route and environment change by platform. A similar-looking connector does not establish interchangeability.
answer.zh: 不能。电流任务、接口、控制功能、走线和环境随平台变化，外观相似的接头并不代表可以互换。

question.en: What should be supplied for engineering review?
question.zh: 工程审核需要提供哪些资料？

answer.en: Provide system voltage, current profile, circuit and interface drawings, route dimensions, environmental requirements, quantity and the required test or approval documents.
answer.zh: 请提供系统电压、电流曲线、回路与接口图、路线尺寸、环境要求、数量以及所需试验或批准文件。

avoidMisidentification.en: Validate interlock continuity separately from the power circuit

avoidMisidentification.en: Release high-voltage claims only after engineering and safety-process confirmation

introVariants.zh: 车辆定位安装同时涉及射频、供电与数据路径，这几种回路的线缆、接头和验证要求不能混用。

question.en: Does one GPS harness fit every 12 V vehicle?
question.zh: 一套 GPS 线束适配所有 12 V 车辆吗？

answer.en: No. Supply voltage alone does not define connector pinout, ignition behavior, vehicle data access or installation geometry. Confirm the exact platform and tracker.
answer.zh: 不适配。供电电压不能单独确定针脚、点火逻辑、车辆数据访问或安装形状，需要确认具体车型与定位器。

question.en: Does a longer antenna cable improve reception?
question.zh: 天线线缆越长，接收就越好吗？

answer.en: Only if relocation improves the antenna environment enough to justify the added loss. Length itself does not amplify the signal; verify the receiver and antenna link budget.
answer.zh: 只有改善天线位置带来的收益足以抵消新增损耗时才可能有帮助。长度本身不会放大信号，需要审核接收器与天线的链路预算。

question.en: Can the harness convert CAN data into GPS reports?
question.zh: 线束能把 CAN 数据自动转换成 GPS 报告吗？

answer.en: A passive harness cannot. Data interpretation and reporting require compatible gateway electronics, software and authorized access.
answer.zh: 无源线束不能。数据解释与上报需要兼容的网关电子设备、软件和授权访问。

question.en: Are FAKRA and automotive LVDS the same thing?
question.zh: FAKRA 和车载 LVDS 是同一个概念吗？

answer.en: No. FAKRA describes a coaxial connector family, while LVDS describes signaling. Determine whether the equipment requires coax, HSD differential wiring or another interface.
answer.zh: 不是。FAKRA 描述同轴接头系列，LVDS 描述信号方式。应确认设备需要同轴、HSD 差分连接还是其他接口。

question.en: Does matching color prove compatibility?
question.zh: 颜色一致就代表兼容吗？

answer.en: No. Confirm coding, contact interface, cable type and the electrical function on both sides. Color is an aid, not a complete specification.
answer.zh: 不代表。还需确认两端编码、接触界面、线缆类型和电气功能。颜色只是辅助识别，不是完整规格。

question.en: Can a passive adapter convert a camera protocol?
question.zh: 无源转接线可以转换摄像头协议吗？

answer.en: No. Protocol conversion requires compatible electronics. A cable adapter changes a physical connection and must preserve the required channel.
answer.zh: 不能。协议转换需要兼容的电子设备，线缆转接改变物理连接，并需保持所要求的通道特性。

text.zh: 长度增加后需复核固定、压降和热区路线。
text.en: Review fixing, voltage drop and thermal routing when extending length.

text.zh: 执行器版本和对插端一致后再确定替换配置。

question.en: Can the same harness fit every VGT or VNT actuator?
question.zh: 同一线束能适配所有 VGT 或 VNT 执行器吗？

answer.en: No. Match the exact actuator, mating connector, circuit assignment and installation. A family name or similar housing is only a starting point.
answer.zh: 不能。需要匹配准确执行器、对插件、回路分配和安装条件，系列名称或相似壳体只是识别起点。

question.en: Does replacing the lead remove the need for calibration?
question.zh: 更换连接线就不需要标定了吗？

answer.en: No such assumption should be made. Wiring repair and actuator calibration are different operations; follow the equipment-specific service procedure.
answer.zh: 不能这样推断。接线维修与执行器标定是不同操作，应遵循具体设备的维修程序。

question.en: Can you make a cable from an existing sample?
question.zh: 可以按现有样品制作连接线吗？

answer.en: Yes, subject to authorization and confirmation of the interfaces, circuit, materials, dimensions and inspection requirements. Unknown pin functions need documentation.
answer.zh: 可以，但需具备使用授权，并确认接口、回路、材料、尺寸和检验要求。未知针脚功能仍需文件依据。

introVariants.en: Agricultural and tractor wiring harnesses cover cab controls, engine and chassis circuits, lighting, sensors, implements and field-service connections. We develop each main loom or replaceable branch from the actual machine, interface schedule and working environment—not a generic tractor outline.
introVariants.zh: 农机与拖拉机线束覆盖驾驶室控制、发动机与底盘回路、照明、传感器、农具以及田间维修接口。主线束或可更换分支均依据具体机型、接口表和作业环境开发，不按一张通用拖拉机轮廓图生产。

introVariants.en: A tractor harness is a family of zone-specific assemblies rather than one universal part. Cab, powertrain, chassis and implement branches face different vibration, mud, spray, UV, temperature and service loads.
introVariants.zh: 拖拉机线束是由多个区域组件构成的产品家族，不是一种通用零件。驾驶室、动力总成、底盘与农具分支面对的振动、泥水、喷淋、紫外线、温度和维修载荷不同。

text.en: Use distinct branch environments for cab, powertrain and chassis.

text.zh: 牵引、提升和铰接行程影响支路余量。

text.en: Coordinate support/protection for dust, vibration and moving mechanisms.

value.en: Select protection for agrochemicals, dust, mud/water and vibration.

label.zh: 铰接或机具提升行程与分支固定
label.en: Articulation/implement lift motion and branch fixing

value.zh: 铰接及提升行程决定松弛量和固定位置。
value.en: Use articulation and lift travel to set slack and fixing positions.

label.zh: 电路与版本依据
label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: For quotation, provide machine make, model and revision, voltage, circuit and pin schedules, mating connector part numbers, loads and fusing, CAN/ISOBUS topology if used, branch lengths and installation photographs, movement and exposure zones, quantity, labels and the agreed inspection scope.
value.zh: 报价请提供设备品牌、型号与版本、电压、回路和针脚表、对插连接器料号、负载与保险配置、涉及的 CAN/ISOBUS 拓扑、分支尺寸和安装照片、运动与暴露区域、数量、标签及约定检验范围。

label.zh: 样品与制造配置
label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: The approved drawing and first article freeze connector orientation, cavity map, branch datum, covering transitions, clips, service loops and test points. Routine continuity, shorts, dimensional and visual checks are recorded to the agreed plan.
value.zh: 经批准的图纸与首件应冻结连接器方向、孔位映射、分支基准、包覆过渡、卡扣、检修余量及测试点。常规导通、短路、尺寸和外观检查按约定方案记录；密封、振动、弯曲、热和整机功能验证属于另行定义的项目测试，不能由线序合格推定。

question.en: Is this one universal tractor harness?
question.zh: 这是一款通用拖拉机线束吗？

answer.en: No. It is a category covering cab, engine, chassis, lighting, sensor and implement assemblies. Machine model, options, pin map, voltage and installation define the actual part.
answer.zh: 不是。这是涵盖驾驶室、发动机、底盘、照明、传感器和农具组件的小类，具体零件取决于机型、选装、针脚表、电压与安装条件。

question.en: Does an ISOBUS connector guarantee implement compatibility?
question.zh: 有 ISOBUS 接头就能保证农具兼容吗？

answer.en: No. Mating hardware is only the physical layer. ISO 11783 network design, controller software, power allocation and the required AEF functions must be checked for the tractor and implement combination.
answer.zh: 不能。对插硬件只是物理层；还要针对拖拉机和农具组合核对 ISO 11783 网络设计、控制器软件、供电分配和所需 AEF 功能。

question.en: Can a worn sample be used to make a replacement?
question.zh: 能按磨损的旧样制作替换线束吗？

answer.en: It can establish some dimensions and interfaces, but damage, field repairs, hidden wire specifications and machine-option differences need separate confirmation before the first article is approved.
answer.zh: 旧样可帮助确认部分尺寸和接口，但损伤、现场维修、隐藏线材规格与机型选装差异须分别确认后才能批准首件。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 拖拉机与机具接口责任分开确认
avoidMisidentification.en: Separate tractor and implement interface responsibilities

avoidMisidentification.zh: ISOBUS插座不能证明功能兼容
avoidMisidentification.en: An ISOBUS socket does not establish functional compatibility

avoidMisidentification.zh: 机具运动全过程需检查松紧与干涉
avoidMisidentification.en: Check slack and interference over the full implement movement

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。
contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: Fuel-system harnesses connect controllers with pump modules, injectors, pressure and temperature sensors, metering valves and related devices. Custom options include tank-module leads, pump branches, gasoline or diesel injector looms, sensor pigtails and repair assemblies.
introVariants.zh: 燃油系统线束在车辆控制器、燃油泵模块、喷油器、压力与温度传感器、计量阀及相关接口之间传送电源与控制信号。这个定制小类包括油箱模块引线、外置泵分支、汽油喷油器线束、柴油共轨分支、传感器短引线和维修组件。

introVariants.en: Fuel delivery architectures differ across port-injected gasoline, gasoline direct injection and diesel common rail. A matching connector body does not establish the correct pin map, injector driver, pump current, sensor reference or environmental rating.
introVariants.zh: 歧管喷射汽油机、汽油直喷和柴油共轨的供油电气架构并不相同。接头外壳能对插，不代表针脚表、喷油驱动、泵电流、传感器参考电压或环境等级正确。

text.zh: 驱动负载与连接位置确定导体和保护。
text.en: Select conductors/protection from drive load and connection location.

text.zh: 缸序与控制器驱动方式共同定义回路。
text.en: Define circuits from cylinder order and controller drive method.

text.zh: 低电平反馈与泵电流路径分开处理。
text.en: Separate low-level feedback from pump-current paths.

text.zh: 传感器参考地与泵供电不可随意合并。
text.en: Do not arbitrarily combine sensor reference ground with pump power.

text.zh: 控制器版本、缸序和驱动定义应相互对应。
text.en: Align controller revision, cylinder order and drive definitions.

text.zh: 接头、密封和局部介质接触需共同检查。
text.en: Review connector, sealing and local media exposure together.

title.zh: 燃油泵、喷油器或压力传感器型号

text.zh: 燃油泵、喷油器与传感器按准确型号区分。
text.en: Distinguish fuel pumps, injectors and sensors by exact model.

title.zh: 驱动电压、电流与反馈针脚

text.zh: 驱动、反馈、供电与参考地分开接线。
text.en: Wire drive, feedback, power and reference ground separately.

title.zh: 密封、温度、接地与安全要求
title.en: Sealing, temperature, grounding and safety requirements

text.zh: 密封、温度与安全要求对应实际安装区。
text.en: Match sealing, temperature and safety requirements to the installation zone.

label.en: Fuel-pump, injector or pressure-sensor model

value.zh: 燃油泵、喷油器与传感器按准确型号区分。
value.en: Distinguish fuel pumps, injectors and sensors by exact model.

label.zh: 驱动电压、电流与反馈针脚
label.en: Drive voltage/current and feedback pins

value.zh: 驱动、反馈、供电与参考地分开接线。
value.en: Wire drive, feedback, power and reference ground separately.

label.zh: 燃油或蒸气接触部位及介质
label.en: Fuel/vapor contact locations and media

value.zh: 介质接触位置明确为飞溅、蒸气或浸泡。
value.en: Define exposure locations as splash, vapor or immersion.

label.zh: 密封、温度、接地与安全要求
label.en: Sealing, temperature, grounding and safety requirements

value.zh: 密封、温度与安全要求对应实际安装区。
value.en: Match sealing, temperature and safety requirements to the installation zone.

label.en: Circuit and revision reference

value.en: Send vehicle and engine identity, controller family, system voltage, pump and injector part numbers, mating connectors and cavity views, circuit and pin tables, sensor outputs, route dimensions, clips, heat and fuel exposure, sample or drawing, quantity and agreed inspection requirements.
value.zh: 请提供车辆与发动机身份、控制器家族、系统电压、泵和喷油器料号、对插件与孔位视图、回路及针脚表、传感器输出形式、走线尺寸、卡扣、热与燃油暴露条件、样品或图纸、数量和约定检验要求。

label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: Approved inputs become controlled drawings, a pin and circuit map, BOM, branch datums, termination and protection instructions, labels and inspection criteria. A first article is reviewed for mating, reach, routing and electrical identity before repeat build; powered function, ingress, thermal and chemical tests require separately agreed methods and limits.
value.zh: 批准的输入转化为受控图纸、针脚与回路图、物料表、分支基准、端接和防护工艺、标签及检验准则。重复制作前，首件核对对插、可达、走线和电气身份；上电功能、防护、热与化学测试须另行约定方法和限值。

question.en: Is a fuel-system harness the same as a fuel line?
question.zh: 燃油系统线束等同于燃油管吗？

answer.en: No. The harness carries electrical power and signals to pumps, injectors, valves and sensors. Hoses, rails and pipes carry fuel and require separate fluid-system engineering and verification.
answer.zh: 不等同。线束向泵、喷油器、阀和传感器输送电源与信号；软管、油轨和管路输送燃油，需另行开展流体系统设计与验证。

question.en: Can a connector that fits an injector be used directly?
question.zh: 喷油器插头能插上就可以直接用吗？

answer.en: No. Confirm the injector and controller part numbers, cavity view, driver strategy, circuit assignment, terminal system and installed environment. A shared shell shape does not prove electrical compatibility.
answer.zh: 不能。还需确认喷油器与控制器料号、孔位视图、驱动策略、回路分配、端子体系和安装环境。外壳形状相同不证明电气兼容。

question.en: Does a sealed connector make the whole harness fuel-resistant?
question.zh: 密封接头能让整根线束耐燃油吗？

answer.en: No. Fuel exposure must be defined by liquid, vapor or mist, duration and temperature. Wire insulation, seals, protection and the mated connector all need suitable material evidence and an agreed test if a resistance claim is required.
answer.zh: 不能。应明确是液体、蒸气还是油雾，以及接触时长和温度。若需耐受声明，线材绝缘、密封、防护及对插连接器均需对应材料证据和约定试验。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 耐油护套不自动适合浸泡燃油
avoidMisidentification.en: Oil-resistant jackets are not automatically suitable for fuel immersion

avoidMisidentification.zh: 泵驱动与传感器低电平回路分开核对
avoidMisidentification.en: Review pump drive separately from low-level sensor circuits

avoidMisidentification.zh: 涉及油箱内部应用需明确专用验证
avoidMisidentification.en: Tank-internal applications require explicit dedicated validation

contentScope.zh: 小类专业支持知识与定制方向；不是单个示例的固定规格或已验证适配。
contentScope.en: Category-level engineering support and customization directions, not fixed example specifications or validated compatibility.

introVariants.en: Dashboard and instrument-cluster harnesses link the cluster, cockpit switches, HVAC controls, display, body controller and junctions specified for a vehicle. We build full cross-car looms, cluster jumpers, center-console branches and repair pigtails.
introVariants.zh: 仪表台与仪表盘线束按具体车型连接组合仪表、座舱开关、空调控制、显示或主机、车身控制器及配电接口。可定制横跨仪表台的总线束、仪表盘短引线、中控分支、开关尾线或受控替换件。

introVariants.en: The visible display is only one endpoint of a vehicle electrical architecture. Power, grounds, illumination, CAN or LIN and sometimes other data links may reach the cluster through dedicated connectors; exact circuits vary by platform.
introVariants.zh: 可见的显示界面只是整车电气架构的一个端点。电源、接地、照明、CAN 或 LIN，以及其他数据链路可能通过专用接口到达组合仪表；具体回路随平台改变。

text.zh: 供电、数据与照明分配遵循准确仪表配置。
text.en: Follow the exact cluster configuration for power, data and lighting.

text.zh: 接口、动作与辅助模块按控制图对应。
text.en: Map interfaces, actions and auxiliary modules to the control diagram.

text.zh: 骨架、风道和维修顺序共同限定走线。
text.en: Frame, ducts and service sequence constrain the route together.

text.zh: 数据、音频与辅助供电采用各自电路定义。
text.en: Define data, audio and auxiliary-power circuits separately.

text.zh: 接口位置和拆装顺序需避免影响其他安全模块。
text.en: Place interfaces and removal steps clear of other safety modules.

text.zh: 相同外形仪表仍需核对功能、针位及软件边界。
text.en: Review function, pins and software boundaries despite similar cluster appearance.

title.zh: 仪表盘型号、年款与配置版本
title.en: Cluster model, year and configuration revision

text.zh: 仪表型号、年款与配置版本共同识别。
text.en: Identify the cluster by model, year and configuration.

text.zh: 照明、供电、通信和独立信号分别列出。
text.en: List illumination, power, communication and discrete signals separately.

title.en: Display, calibration and immobilizer function boundaries

text.zh: 显示、标定或防盗功能另按系统范围处理。
text.en: Handle display, calibration or immobilizer functions within system scope.

value.zh: 请提供车型平台与年款、配置变型、左右舵布局、回路与孔位表、对插件料号、仪表与控制器资料、走线图或样品、卡扣、分支基准、预计数量和约定检验项；涉及 SRS 等安全关键接口须单独标识。

label.en: Sample and manufacturing configuration

value.en: Approved information becomes a controlled drawing, connector and pin matrix, BOM, branch geometry, labels and inspection plan. First-article review checks mating, reach, terminal seating, clip positions, clearance and circuit identity.
value.zh: 批准资料转化为受控图纸、连接器与针脚矩阵、物料表、分支几何、标签和检验计划。首件核对对插、可达、端子入位、卡扣位置、间隙及回路身份。

question.en: Is a cluster pigtail the same as a complete dashboard harness?
question.zh: 仪表盘短引线等同于整套仪表台线束吗？

answer.en: No. A pigtail covers a defined cluster interface; a cross-car harness can include switches, HVAC, displays, junctions and body-controller branches. Specify the exact breakpoints and vehicle variant.
answer.zh: 不等同。短引线只覆盖指定仪表接口；横向总线束可能包含开关、空调、显示、配电与车身控制器分支。应明确断开点及车型变型。

question.en: Can matching cluster plugs be interchanged?
question.zh: 仪表插头能对插，就可以互换吗？

answer.en: No. Confirm cavity view, pin map, power domains, network protocol, cluster and controller references, and software configuration. Plug fit alone does not prove displayed information or warning behavior.
answer.zh: 不能。还需确认孔位视图、针脚表、供电域、网络协议、仪表与控制器料号以及软件配置。能插上不能证明显示或警示行为正确。

question.en: Can you reproduce an airbag or SRS branch from an old sample?
question.zh: 可以按旧样复制安全气囊或 SRS 分支吗？

answer.en: Not from a sample alone. SRS circuits are safety critical and require OEM-approved drawings, component traceability, controlled process and separately defined validation. We would first review whether that scope is appropriate for the project.
answer.zh: 不能只凭旧样。SRS 回路属于安全关键部件，需要整车方批准图纸、元件追溯、受控工艺和单独验证。我们会先审核项目范围是否适合承接。

avoidMisidentification.en: Connector adaptation does not establish cluster coding or immobilizer matching

introVariants.en: Transmission harnesses carry power, commands and feedback between a transmission control unit, mechatronic assembly, solenoids, speed or position sensors, range selector and the vehicle-side loom. The category includes external gearbox leads, sealed through-case interfaces and, where specified, oil-wet internal branches.
introVariants.zh: 变速箱线束在变速箱控制单元、机电液模块、电磁阀、转速或位置传感器、挡位选择器与整车线束之间传输电源、指令和反馈。本小类包括箱体外部引线、穿壳密封接口，以及按项目要求制作的油浸式内部支路。

introVariants.en: A transmission controller interprets sensor signals and drives the relevant actuators; it may be integrated into a module, attached to the transmission or housed separately. A harness therefore needs a controlled pin map and an explicit boundary between oil-wet, through-wall and vehicle-side environments.
introVariants.zh: 变速箱控制单元读取传感器信号并驱动相应执行器；它可能集成在模块中、安装于变速箱上，也可能独立布置。因此线束必须有受控针脚表，并明确油浸区、穿壳区和整车外侧环境的边界。

text.zh: 接口与线长配合控制器和车辆安装位置。
text.en: Match interfaces and length to controller and vehicle positions.

text.zh: 油液接触、温度和驱动分别定义。
text.en: Define fluid exposure, temperature and drive circuits separately.

text.zh: 贯穿密封与信号参考需要分别审核。
text.en: Review feedthrough sealing separately from signal references.

text.zh: 信号、参考地和屏蔽按控制器定义区分。
text.en: Distinguish signals, references and shielding from controller data.

text.zh: 工具端与箱体端针图分别审核，避免误供电。
text.en: Review tool/transmission pinouts separately to prevent incorrect power.

text.zh: 油液飞溅、热与震动需结合端头固定处理。
text.en: Address fluid splash, heat and vibration with termination fixing.

value.zh: 批准资料转化为回路矩阵、连接器物料表、分支图、材料记录与首件检验计划。可核对孔位与线号、端子入位、锁止、分支尺寸、对插及约定电气项目。

question.en: Is an external transmission lead the same as an internal mechatronic harness?
question.zh: 箱外变速箱引线等同于箱内机电液线束吗？

answer.en: No. They have different installation, fluid exposure, connector and cleanliness requirements. Define the breakpoints and whether a through-case interface belongs to the assembly.
answer.zh: 不等同。安装位置、油液暴露、连接器和洁净度要求都可能不同。必须明确断开点，以及穿壳接口是否属于供货范围。

question.en: Can a matching gearbox plug prove interchangeability?
question.zh: 变速箱插头能对插就能互换吗？

answer.en: No. Compare transmission and controller references, cavity view, circuit assignment, terminal system, sealing parts and software variant. A mating shell does not validate shifting behavior.
answer.zh: 不能。还要比较变速箱与控制器料号、孔位视图、回路分配、端子体系、密封件与软件变型。能插上不等于换挡行为正确。

question.en: Does continuity testing prove the feedthrough will not leak?
question.zh: 导通测试能证明穿壳接口不漏油吗？

answer.en: No. Continuity tests electrical mapping. Fluid containment needs the correct approved seals and installation, followed by the project-specific leak or pressure test.
answer.zh: 不能。导通只检查电气映射。油液密封需要正确的批准密封件和安装，并按项目规定进行渗漏或压力试验。

avoidMisidentification.zh: 内置线束的油浸条件需有材料依据
avoidMisidentification.en: Internal harness oil-immersion conditions need material evidence

avoidMisidentification.zh: 变速箱同系列不同代次可能针序不同
avoidMisidentification.en: Transmission generations within one family can use different pinouts

avoidMisidentification.zh: 线束供货不含控制策略标定
avoidMisidentification.en: Harness supply does not include control-strategy calibration
